_verifiedMetadata.name: Eyes
_verifiedMetadata.description: Tina Sebastian, a police officer investigates disturbing cases involving women. As the investigation progresses, mental health professionals join forces with the police to understand the psychology of stalkers, identify warning signs and prevent situations from escalating.

videos.title: The Threat Returns
videos.overview: When actor Ritika gets a renewed threat from her stalker, Milan, she reaches out to EYES, a team specifically devoted to protecting victims of stalkers. She is disappointed to know that the team that had made her feel protected was no longer operational.

videos.title: The Case That Broke Us
videos.overview: After helping the police to successfully nab Milan, EYES is persuaded to restart their mission. The team first has to confront the reality of the case that had caused them to falter the first time – the case of Varsha and Hemant.

videos.title: The Other Side
videos.overview: Having restarted their work in protecting victims and helping stalkers overcome their issues, the EYES team has to go back to their old cases and make up for any lapses in their understanding – for instance, Sajin Zachariah’s side of the story his wife has said about him.

videos.title: Nothing Is As It Seems
videos.overview: As a team of mental health professionals working side by side with the police, the EYES team has to be sure of the truth of a story before they can help the victim or the stalker. In some cases, like the one between Sajin and Shobhita, the truth is not what it seems at first glance.

videos.title: Why We Stay
videos.overview: Unexpected setbacks from within and outside the team lead EYES to once again question what they are doing and why. But they know there is only one way to go – forward.

videos.title: Trust No One
videos.overview: A team member’s actions puts the fate of EYES in jeopardy. Another’s doubt proves vital in setting a wrong right. Slowly but surely, the team moves closer to its goals.

videos.title: The Ones Being Hunted
videos.overview: When the protectors turn the hunted and long-hidden truths emerge, Team EYES proves beyond doubt that the mission is safe in their hands.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Heart Beat
_verifiedMetadata.description: RK Multispeciality Hospital is a beacon of hope and healing. Its doctors are resilient even when they have to deal with medical and personal challenges.

videos.title: Doubt and Denial in the Shadows

_verifiedMetadata.name: Least Eligible Bachelor
_verifiedMetadata.description: A bachelor struggling to find a bride because of his looks moves to Hyderabad for a fresh start, only to discover that his potential match is his colleague at work.

videos.title: Aa Okkati Adakku
videos.overview: Determined to see his son, Teja, wed, Nivasa Rao takes a friend's advice and sends him to Hyderabad, hoping a job will make him a more suitable match.

videos.title: Pellichoopulu
videos.overview: Teja lands a job at a software company, unaware his new boss, Madhu, is the woman his father has secretly chosen as his prospective bride.

videos.title: Tom and Jerry
videos.overview: Teja and Madhu agree to live together for six months before deciding on marriage, but she insists they keep it secret from their coworkers.

videos.title: Kirrak Party
videos.overview: A celebration at Teja's house takes an awkward turn when guests discover Madhu's belongings and start teasing him, leaving her embarrassed.

videos.title: Premiukula Roju
videos.overview: On their Vagamon getaway, Gopi makes a bold move with the mysterious "model girl" as Teja and Madhu begin to develop feelings for each other.

videos.title: Life Is Beautiful
videos.overview: With Madhu preparing to leave for America, Teja struggles to celebrate his birthday and finally confides in Gopi about his growing feelings for her.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Prince of Mollywood
_verifiedMetadata.description: Firoz has one dream: become a Pan-Indian superstar. But everyone around him has other plans. His friends are experts at ruining things. Vappa Mammali turns producer hoping one flop will send him straight back to the family business. Umma is busy finding him a bride on matrimony sites. And then there's his girlfriend.

videos.title: The Dreamer
videos.overview: Bitten by the movie bug, Firoz dreams of becoming a film actor. Till then he makes do with album-song shoots. During a 90th birthday celebration, he gets an opportunity.

videos.title: The Hero, The Villain
videos.overview: Firoz arrives at the film shoot with his friends and asks the director for a chance. Will Firoz's dreams finally come true?

videos.title: The Escape
videos.overview: Mammali gives Firoz an ultimatum that he better marry his friend's daughter and live according to him. But Firoz has another trick up his sleeve.

videos.title: First Sight
videos.overview: Firoz is shocked by the surprise Mammali had in store for him at the house. His mother, worried about him, recruits his friends to help him find a girl to fall in love with.

videos.title: The Wrong Salma
videos.overview: Firoz is absolutely enthralled by Salma, for all the wrong reasons. Meanwhile, Ali becomes a stumbling block in Midukkan and Charlie's plan, and he sends them to the wrong house.

videos.title: The Plan is On
videos.overview: Midukkan and Charlie try their best to get Firoz to "run into" Salma. However, Salma and her friends find such serendipity suspicious.

videos.title: The Deal
videos.overview: Firoz and his friends bribe Ali to make him work for them in their plan to woo Salma. Will Ali genuinely help Firoz, or will he take him on a merry ride?

videos.title: The Bus Ride
videos.overview: Firoz desperately follows Salma onto a bus but, instead of getting in, ends up clinging to it outside. Just then, Mammali and Sainaba spot him.

videos.title: Too Late
videos.overview: Firoz and his friends visit Salma’s house with a marriage proposal. However, Firoz is heartbroken when he learns that Salma’s wedding has already been fixed with Thaju.

videos.title: Operation Thajudeen
videos.overview: Firoz's mother investigates whether Thaju, the man whose marriage to Salma has been arranged, has another love interest. How will Firoz's friends help him?

videos.title: The New Girl
videos.overview: Ali tells Mammali that it was Firoz who brought Sneha to make Thaju fall in love with her. Sneha and Thaju become acquainted and their relationship begins to grow.

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: Mammali hides Sneha after she arrives at his house. Seeing this, his wife Sainaba becomes suspicious that something is going on.

videos.title: The Birthday Trap
videos.overview: Firoz and his friends learn from Salma's friends that it is her birthday. They plan to trick Mammali and buy a ring for Salma.

videos.title: The Ring
videos.overview: Firoz and his friends finally realise which Salma's family they've been chasing so far. Infuriated, they call Ali and find out something that increases their anger.

videos.title: Five Lakhs
videos.overview: At the police station, Firoz promises to pay ₹5 lakh that Thajudeen claims to have lost. Grandma assures Firoz that if Salma accepts the ring, she will fall for him.

videos.title: Love or Cinema?
videos.overview: At the coffee shop, Salma finally openly confesses her love to Firoz. However, Mammali gives Firoz an ultimatum.

videos.title: The Double Dream
videos.overview: After Salma says yes to Firoz, he worries that choosing her means giving up his dream. Seeing Firoz caught between love and cinema, Charlie and Midukkan come up with a plan.

videos.title: The Unexpected Boyfriend
videos.overview: Firoz, Charlie and Midukkan head to the hospital to meet Aliya and threaten her. However, Firoz faces a dire situation and an unpleasant surprise.

videos.title: A New Agreement
videos.overview: Following Firoz's plan, Aliya agrees to get engaged within a month and marry after a year. When he decides to tell Salma everything, his friends warn him.

videos.title: The Fake Engagement
videos.overview: While Firoz produces an album for Salma, he and Aliya go through with their fake engagement. Everything goes according to plan until an uninvited guest crashes the ceremony.

videos.title: The Trap
videos.overview: Salma witnesses Firoz and Aliya's engagement, which breaks her heart. Firoz later discovers that Ali deliberately brought Salma to the auditorium, leaving him angry.

videos.title: The Revelation
videos.overview: Ali reveals why Salma witnessed Firoz and Aliya's engagement. Firoz takes Ali to a café to reveal the truth to Salma, but when she arrives, she is with a handsome man.

videos.title: The Suspicion
videos.overview: Firoz, his family and friends visit Aliya's house for lunch. During the gathering, Laljith arrives to meet Aliya. Mammali notices the two of them talking, raising his suspicions.

videos.title: In Trouble
videos.overview: Firoz and his friends go to meet the man who was with Salma at the café. But when they reach his house, things take an unexpected turn.

videos.title: The Missing Man
videos.overview: Firoz and his friends go to Noushik’s shop and kidnap him. What happens next leaves the gang facing an unexpected and dangerous situation.

videos.title: The Convincing Skill
videos.overview: After learning that Noushik is safe and unharmed, Firoz and his friends move ahead with their plan. They go to Salma’s house, hoping to convince her and clear the misunderstanding.

videos.title: The Truth
videos.overview: After the tragic event, Aliya meets Salma and reveals the truth about the engagement. She also tells Salma that Firoz truly loves her.

videos.title: The Unexpected Visit
videos.overview: The fake Salma unexpectedly arrives at Charlie’s house. Puzzled, Charlie, Firoz and Midukkan try to figure out the reason for her visit and decide what to do next.

_verifiedMetadata.name: #Love
_verifiedMetadata.description: The pragmatic creator of a dating app and her adventurous competitor test their theories about love in a 60-day challenge to find their ideal partner.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Aakali Rajyam
_verifiedMetadata.description: Three friends, one fresh start, and a life full of unexpected challenges. As job struggles, money problems, and personal battles push them to the edge, can their friendship and a bold new dream change their lives?

videos.title: Episode 01
videos.overview: Meet Ramesh, Akshay, and Aruna as they navigate friendship, work, family, and the struggles of everyday life. What happens when their comfort zone is suddenly put to the test?

videos.title: Episode 02
videos.overview: With pressure building and new opportunities on the horizon, the trio finds themselves making choices that could change everything. But can they keep it all together?

videos.title: Episode 03
videos.overview: Friendship faces its first real test as things don't go quite as planned. Will the trio find a way through the chaos and discover a new path forward?

videos.title: Episode 04
videos.overview: A fresh beginning comes with its own set of challenges as the friends step into unfamiliar territory. Can their big idea survive the realities standing in its way?

videos.title: Episode 05
videos.overview: As personal struggles pull the friends in different directions, their dream faces another setback. Can they stay together when life starts pulling them in different directions?

videos.title: Episode 06
videos.overview: When their dreams seem out of reach, an unexpected opportunity brings fresh hope. Can the trio finally turn their idea into a future of their own?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Hunkkaar: The Roar
_verifiedMetadata.description: When a teenager accuses a revered cult leader of sexual assault, it sparks a national conflict. As the truth unravels, the line between faith and justice blurs.

videos.title: Aarambh
videos.overview: Seventeen-year-old Meenu Rawat accuses spiritual leader Baapji of sexual assault. Newly appointed ACP Jasleen Singh Soin takes charge of the case, and her uphill battle begins.

videos.title: Aastha
videos.overview: Despite resistance and rising violence, Jasleen arrests Baapji. Advocate Bhalerao steps in to represent Meenu. But before the bail hearing, Meenu's father lands in trouble.

videos.title: Shakti
videos.overview: At the bail hearings, the defence attacks Meenu's credibility, claiming she's a habitual liar. Outside, tensions rise as Baapji's son Kashyap gains control.

videos.title: Arth
videos.overview: While exposing the disappearance of a child devotee, Amitabh's career is jeopardised. Jasleen uncovers proof of a ritual, which is in fact an industrial-scale abuse.

videos.title: Yudh
videos.overview: Kashyap mysteriously dies in custody, and Baapji takes advantage of it. Outraged by the orchestrated media narrative, Amitabh helms a movement, appealing to the survivors.

videos.title: Nyaya
videos.overview: The defence presents one last witness to exonerate Baapji, which shocks Meenu. Finally, she takes the stand for the last time, recounting her assault with unflinching courage.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Bigg Boss Malayalam: Agnipareeksha
_verifiedMetadata.description: Bigg Boss Agnipariksha is a Malayalam reality television spin-off that airs on JioHotstar as a prequel to Bigg Boss Malayalam. The series follows a group of 40 ordinary contestants who face physical, mental and social challenges to earn a coveted spot inside the Bigg Boss Malayalam house. Throughout the competition, the contestants are tested on their resilience, teamwork, leadership, adaptability and decision-making under pressure. Each challenge forces them to prove their personality, determination and ability to handle the intense environment associated with the Bigg Boss format. As the competition progresses, only the strongest and most deserving participants will get the chance to become official contestants in the upcoming season of Bigg Boss Malayalam.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Onam Celebrations and Fun Games

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: The Judges Walkout

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Friendships Put to Test
videos.overview: The contestants are pushed to their limits when competition takes precedence over friendship. Unexpected reactions and explosive moments builds on the drama

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: The Circle of Trust

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Guests Arrive with Mystery Boxes
videos.overview: Kidilam Firoz and Poli Firoz enter with mysterious surprise boxes and exciting twists unfold. Intense drama and hilarious moments bring thrilling suspense in the house.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Wild Talent Meet Extreme Tasks

_verifiedMetadata.name: The Court
_verifiedMetadata.description: A young lawyer, brilliant with case details, struggles to find her place within the legal fraternity. Her two opponents: her celebrated father and her stammer.

videos.title: Black Coats
videos.overview: Yazhini faces rejection due to her stutter, Deva loses his chamber and Veni enters the Bar Association election. However, an ATM robbery gives them a new ray of hope.

videos.title: Same Case, Different Reasons
videos.overview: Yazhini secretly investigates the ATM robbery while working for Mahesh, and Deva charms the bank manager to secure the same case. Will this case change their fortunes?

videos.title: Crossed
videos.overview: While Veni fights for an evicted tea-stall vendor, Yazhini uncovers a crucial clue in the ATM robbery. How will Mahesh and Deva handle this new discovery?

videos.title: The Wrong Interview
videos.overview: Veni spots Pandiyaraj's campaign posters and gets infuriated. Deva finally manages to get a chamber, although shared, and hijacks Yazhini's interview, which forces a choice on her.

videos.title: The Choice
videos.overview: Torn between Veni's experience and Deva's ambition, Yazhini chooses the chamber where she wants to build her future. But on her first day in court, she draws Muthu's ire.

videos.title: Undone
videos.overview: Yazhini races to secure anticipatory bail for Joe. However, things go wrong when the tampered petition is rejected and Yazhini faces the blame.

videos.title: Redemption
videos.overview: Determined to free Joe, Yazhini strikes a bargain with the registrar. But later, she confronts Veni with proof of Muthu's sabotage.

videos.title: Legacy
videos.overview: Deva challenges Veni to represent her client's son, turning their rivalry into a contest. While Yazhini feels conflicted about her boss' actions, Raja Sekar arrives and greets her.

videos.title: Old Wounds
videos.overview: When Yazhini's identity as Raj Sekar's daughter becomes public, Deva questions her choices. Meanwhile, the top lawyer's courtroom appearance uncovers old wounds.

videos.title: Vantage Point
videos.overview: Shailaja asks her dad why Yazhini can't join their firm. Yazhini finds out from Veni the conflict between Raj Sekar and Sathyan and gets a breakthrough in the drunk-driving case.

videos.title: Groundwork
videos.overview: It's the day Maari decides who will fight for his son's drunk-driving case. Veni's team feels the case is airtight. But Yazhini secures the evidence needed to challenge them.

videos.title: Alone
videos.overview: Before the drunk-driving case hearing begins, Deva is forced to leave, compelling Yazhini to take over. She begins confidently until an unexpected witness is brought in.

videos.title: Do I Belong?
videos.overview: Maari brings his goons to threaten Deva. Just as Yazhini begins questioning her choice of profession, she comes across a desperate woman with a case that nobody wants.

videos.title: Courage
videos.overview: Yazhini moves into a new home, and who her roommate is shocks her. Despite Deva and Veni's refusal and her father's disapproval, she commits to fight Anitha's case.

videos.title: Hustle
videos.overview: Yazhini and Deva discover that the ATM robbery may not be done by everyday thieves. Determined to help Anitha, she follows a disturbing trail leading to a surrogacy clinic.

videos.title: Counterattack
videos.overview: Armed with a new strategy, Yazhini enters court to fight for the abandoned special-needs child. When the defence tries to bury the truth, Yazhini turns their evidence against them.

videos.title: Hangover
videos.overview: After her first victory, Yazhini struggles with her father's absence. When an ailing Deva collapses before Kumaran's hearing, she is forced to take his place in court.

videos.title: The Grind
videos.overview: While Deva recuperates, Yazhini struggles to find a paying client. Meanwhile, Shailaja takes on a high-stakes corporate espionage case.

videos.title: No Money, No Honey
videos.overview: Veni prepares to take on Pandiyaraj in the Bar Association election. As Yazhini discovers the true cost of fighting Arun's case, a shocking demand leaves her trapped.

videos.title: Reckoning
videos.overview: At the court, Pandiyaraj plays dirty and threatens Sathyan. When Yazhini returns home for her mother's death anniversary, although the day goes well, the dinner goes downhill.

videos.title: Renewed Hope
videos.overview: Determined to prove herself, Yazhini embraces Deva's methods and begins searching for a high-value client. Veni finds out why Sathyan didn't tell her about Pandiyaraj's party.

videos.title: First Catch
videos.overview: While Veni finds a new way to revive her campaign, Viswa takes an early lead in the client challenge. Just as Yazhini begins to lose hope, an unexpected call changes everything.

videos.title: Hidden
videos.overview: Shailaja confides a long-kept secret with Yazhini. Deva's past returns with a case. Meanwhile, an overlooked clause threatens to turn Yazhini's first major client against her.

videos.title: Hunger
videos.overview: Muthu gets violent when a creditor harasses Keerthana for money. At court, Viswa and Keerthana fight for a humiliated delivery worker, and outside, Yazhini rescues Sheeba's case.

videos.title: The Stranger
videos.overview: Deva and Yazhini begin a confidential audit after the bank uncovers an insider's role in the ATM robbery. Meanwhile, a stranger's arrival leaves Deva shaken and Amreen humiliated.

videos.title: Collateral
videos.overview: As Yazhini uncovers suspicious collateral-free loans during the audit, Deva makes a painful sacrifice to meet the stranger's demand. On the other side, Muthu faces a crisis.

videos.title: Rejections
videos.overview: Along with the bank audit that uncovers a dubious ex-employee, Deva and Yazhini pursue a high-stakes corporate case. Will they succeed, or will it be another rejection?

videos.title: Head On
videos.overview: The bank's audit uncovers a network of shell companies and more secrets. When Thivi's Annual Day function begins, Deva receives a call, and he races to settle a dangerous debt.

videos.title: Scammed
videos.overview: While Yazhini's audit exposes a ₹300-crore loan scam, Velmurugan's signatures place him under suspicion. However, Pandiyaraj pressures Deva to abandon the case.

videos.title: Collateral
videos.overview: Yazhini wins three days to strengthen the bank case, but Velmurugan pays a personal price. Learning what Pandiyaraj did to a young lawyer, she prepares for a dangerous fight.

videos.title: Trial
videos.overview: Armed with the loan documents, Yazhini and Deva face Pandiyaraj in court. Can their unexpected evidence protect Velmurugan and expose the conspiracy behind the fraudulent loans?

videos.title: Do or Die
videos.overview: The team surprises Veni on her birthday. Karunakaran offers Deva a life-changing deal but refusing it could put their entire chamber at risk.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Part-Timers
_verifiedMetadata.description: Two roommates, worlds apart, barely stay together. But these two women share one grand dream: a start-up.

videos.title: The Unlikely Beginning
videos.overview: Sindhu battles a conservative family, while Teju secretly drives a cab to prove her independence. After a chaotic first meeting, the two strangers unexpectedly become roommates.

videos.title: Two Worlds, One Address
videos.overview: Teju's job as a cab driver is exposed when she returns a lost bag to a passenger at a hotel where she spots her parents. A small mistake shatters Teju and Sindhu's new bond.

videos.title: Life: No Refunds
videos.overview: Teju rejects her dad's offer to fund a restaurant business. Sindhu hosts an office party at her flat. Teju berates her for paying her pending dues and demands that she move out.

videos.title: Winner Winner Upma Dinner
videos.overview: The neighbours confront Teju and defend Sindhu's right to stay in the flat. To settle scores, Teju's team and Vijaya's gang agree to play a game.

videos.title: Terms & Conditions Apply
videos.overview: Exercising the terms of her victory, Sindhu enforces strict rules and chores on Teju. While Teju faces pressure to accept a marriage proposal, Sindhu gets praised at her workplace

videos.title: Life has no GPS
videos.overview: Teju arrives at a wealthy client's house for an outstation driving job while Sindhu befriends a local cafe owner Joy. Vicky uses Sindhu’s key to enter the flat with his girlfriend

videos.title: Who Took the Wheel?
videos.overview: Teju has a confrontation with her hyper passenger Ramesh regarding speed. During the late-night drive, Ramesh opens up to Teju about a painful family rift, earning her empathy.

videos.title: Recalculating…
videos.overview: Teju is elated as Ramesh is reunited with his estranged wife. While Sindhu’s mother reveals her uncle’s plan to get her married to Naveen, she comes face to face with the problem.

videos.title: Connections: Loading...
videos.overview: Work pressure and office deadlines force Sindhu to silence Joy's repeated calls. At Joy's coffee stall, Teju meets Naveen, who offers her his investor expertise.

videos.title: A Good Cook Could Cook Good
videos.overview: Sindhu works tirelessly to build a critical project deck while navigating a cold interaction with Joy. Back at the flat, Sindhu and Teju meet Vicky's girlfriend, Meenu.

videos.title: The First Date
videos.overview: Sindhu gets good news when the US project gets green-lit. Overjoyed, she visits Joy's stall, where she gets a date request. Meanwhile, Teju goes on a food tour with Naveen.

videos.title: New Mess, Same Us
videos.overview: Sindhu returns home and sees her apartment set up for a marriage proposal. After a magical date with Joy, when she helps Teju with her pitch deck, the core idea alarms her.

videos.title: Mission: Hide the Truth
videos.overview: Sindhu realises that her promotion comes with responsibility. Naveen discusses the pitch deck with Teju. Sindhu is stunned when Teju and Vicky reveal the complete plan to her.

videos.title: New Cabin, New Problems
videos.overview: Joy and Naveen argue about compromising on quality of coffee. Teju gets tense about the pitch deck. Ramya mocks Sindhu for her pending tasks. Joy shares his concerns with Sindhu.

videos.title: The Cost of Silence
videos.overview: Sindhu leaves abruptly while working on the pitch deck. Ramana asks an angry Teju if Sindhu truly agreed to help her. Sindhu, indirectly, confides in Joy. Teju spots them together.

videos.title: Ambitions and Emotions
videos.overview: After Sindhu informs Teju of her inability to help her with the deck, Teju decides to work on it herself. Sindhu tries to stop Teju from submitting the deck, but in vain.

videos.title: Catalyst and Escape
videos.overview: While Teju eagerly awaits the result for her startup pitch, Sindhu has a potluck mishap. Moreover, she gets cornered by Naveen at work with marriage pressure.

videos.title: Confrontation and Comfort
videos.overview: Joy welcomes Sindhu to the wedding and endearingly styles her for the Haldi ceremony. Back home, a humiliated Teju isolates herself.

videos.title: Audacity and Choices
videos.overview: As Sindhu grows closer to Joy at Kavya's wedding, Teju is challenged to prove her startup as she pitches her idea directly to Dev.

videos.title: Resolutions and Reckoning
videos.overview: Teju and Naveen secretly use Joy's café to run a successful coffee kiosk dry. Meanwhile Sindhu tearfully confesses the deck betrayal to Joy during their ride back.

videos.title: Fresh Plan, Fresh Trouble
videos.overview: Sindhu’s mother gives her an ultimatum after spotting her with Joy. Teju and Naveen clash over the kiosk, while Sushma’s accidental idea leads Teju to claim she has a boyfriend.

videos.title: Fake Boyfriend
videos.overview: One mistake makes Naveen Teju’s fake boyfriend, creating a dangerous overlap with Sindhu’s marriage talks. As troubles grow, Naveen is forced to play along.

videos.title: No More Secrets
videos.overview: Naveen plays Teju’s boyfriend before her parents, while Joy’s cafe draws investor interest. Sindhu meets Naveen and Joy is devastated when he learns about their marriage.

videos.title: The Truth Hurts
videos.overview: Teju makes cab driver Ramana act as Naveen’s fake father. Sindhu faces a distraught Joy. Later, amongst the chaos, Sindhu encounters Naveen in her house meeting Teju’s parents.

videos.title: The Fake Boyfriend Act!
videos.overview: Teju admits to Sindhu that her boyfriend act was staged to avoid marriage, only to discover Naveen is Sindhu’s prospective groom. Teju pitches her kiosk business to Dev.

videos.title: The Photo That Reveals All
videos.overview: To celebrate the end of her fake-boyfriend drama, Teju has a party. Dev yells at Teju for her thoughts on business. Vijaya secretly captures Teju and Naveen hugging each other.

videos.title: The Truth Behind the Silence
videos.overview: Naveen struggles with his growing feelings for Teju, who officially joins Dev’s company. Meanwhile, the long-awaited audit finally begins in Sindhu’s office.

videos.title: Trouble at Office
videos.overview: Sindhu is questioned after the team’s credential-sharing violation is discovered. Meanwhile, on her first day at Dev’s company, Teju observes its unusual workplace culture.

videos.title: The Hidden Hand
videos.overview: Sindhu refuses to let Jagan take the blame. Nithya's video exposes Ramya's role in targeting the team. With evidence in hand, Suman and the others now have a chance to fight back.

videos.title: The Sacrifice
videos.overview: Ramya blackmails the team over their secret part-time jobs. At the audit meeting, Suman‘s unexpected decision leaves the entire team stunned.

videos.title: More Than an Act
videos.overview: Suman reveals why he sacrificed his job to protect Sindhu. Naveen's sincere words about Teju give Sindhu hope and she begins to see his feelings as a way out.

videos.title: One Last Question
videos.overview: Sindhu returns home as marriage pressure mounts. Believing Naveen loves Teju, she asks her family to confirm with him again and hopes he will withdraw as he has feelings for Teju.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Shaque: Trust No One
_verifiedMetadata.description: A mother receives yearly photos of her missing child. After nine years of searching, she discovers the truth about the abduction lies not far away, but hidden among her closest circle.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Cousins and Kalyanams
_verifiedMetadata.description: A 26-year tale of six cousins in Kerala whose lives and relationships revolve around seven weddings.

videos.title: The Grand Plan
videos.overview: On the eve of Manu's wedding with Veena, he and Diya decide to elope with the help of their four close confidante cousins.

videos.title: The Kiss
videos.overview: At Manu’s wedding, the cousins search for a missing Diya. She arrives and kisses Manu on stage, shocking the families and creating chaos at the wedding, revealing hidden history.

videos.title: Back Together
videos.overview: The cousins reunite at another wedding after ten years. Though Manu feels out of place, the others pull him back into the group and slowly try to rebuild their frayed bond.

videos.title: The Beach Story
videos.overview: Manu insists Diya show him the beach. A casual beach outing turns dangerous when Manu nearly drowns, and Diya is forced to rescue him.

videos.title: Ashwathy's CD
videos.overview: Ashwathy gets a mysterious CD that sparks Diya's curiosity. What begins as a secret plan to watch it alone creates chaos when the cousins find out, turning into a comic showdown.

videos.title: The Hard Goodbye
videos.overview: As the wedding celebrations end, the cousins face an emotional goodbye. Manu's attempt to confess his feelings to Diya goes awry, leaving them to part ways on uncertain terms.

videos.title: Four Years Later
videos.overview: At another wedding, adulthood reshapes identities. Old feelings resurface when Manu meets Diya again. New rival Prajith enters, determined to impress her and disrupt emotions.

videos.title: Disco Diya
videos.overview: A playful mishap sparks old childhood memories. As Prajith boldly pursues Diya, Manu finds himself torn between confidence and self-doubt over his feelings.

videos.title: The Family Video
videos.overview: The cousins collaborate on a wedding video project. Prajith manipulates the elders to present himself as Diya’s ideal match, intensifying rivalry as Manu silently grows uneasy.

videos.title: Onam Games
videos.overview: Festive games revive childhood chemistry. Prajith tries to impress Diya but fails when he cheats. Manu’s calm composure earns Diya’s admiration, melting the emotional distance.

videos.title: Marriage Talks
videos.overview: The elders subtly push Prajith as Diya’s groom. Family interviews unexpectedly expose old property disputes, revealing unresolved generational tensions beneath celebrations.

videos.title: Old Photos
videos.overview: Family conflicts escalate but resolve through emotional conversations. Manu and Diya share an honest discussion about life, marking a turning point in emotional openness.

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: While Sanskriti seeks answers about Manu, Prajith tries to open up to Diya about his feelings. Will their search for the truth bring them closer or strain their relationships?

videos.title: The Roast Disaster
videos.overview: After Prajith hacks Chandu's computer, a roast video plays during the wedding, sparking a major family feud. As tensions rise, Megha boldly confronts the elders.

videos.title: Silent Rift
videos.overview: Chandu and Ashwathy clash over personal matters, driving a wedge between them. On the other hand, Manu is disheartened when he notices Prajith and Diya together.

videos.title: Confession Plan
videos.overview: Manu's plans to confess his love take a dramatic turn when Diya uncovers the truth about the two-timing. Elsewhere, Nima is left shaken after learning the truth about Chandu.

videos.title: Cousins Who Meet at Weddings
videos.overview: Diya tells Manu they should stay like cousins who meet at weddings. The fractured group drifts apart, but Chandu comforts Manu, promising things will mend by the next wedding

videos.title: The Problem Wedding
videos.overview: The cousins return for the next wedding, older now and carrying the weight of things life has taught them. But, this gathering feels different, a threat looms over the celebration.

videos.title: Old Wounds, New Love
videos.overview: Manu's old wounds with his mother reopen as she arrives for the wedding. Meanwhile, Diya stays glued to her phone with Jay, her new lover, as Manu watches in silence.

videos.title: Love Coach Chandu
videos.overview: Manu can't bear losing Diya. Chandu steps in as his love coach, training him Chandu-style to win her back. Meanwhile Prajith returns and is back to his old antics.

videos.title: Two Slaps and a Brawl
videos.overview: Chandu's coaching backfires. At the mall, Megha slaps Joshy for harassing the girls. When Manu defends Megha, his mother slaps him to avoid another family rift, and he storms out.

videos.title: The Walk Back
videos.overview: Diya finds Manu alone at a shop. When he opens up about his loneliness and beliefs in marriage, she silences a call from Jay. They share a tender evening under the stars.

videos.title: Unsettled
videos.overview: While Manu and Diya find a new rhythm, Megha drifts away from the cousins, as she gets blamed for Manu's walkout. Meanwhile, the antagonists quietly regroup to stop the wedding.

videos.title: In Her Defence
videos.overview: Diya defends Ashwathy when a relative's wedding proposal sparks a sharp remark from her. Meanwhile, Chandu falls for Roshini, and Megha quietly makes peace.

videos.title: Highs and Loss
videos.overview: A surprise terrace party leads to emotional confessions while Manu and Chandu dodge chores. Things take an unexpected turn when an intoxicated Diya pulls Manu towards her.

videos.title: A Ride to Remember
videos.overview: Diya persuades Manu to take her to Nakshathra Thadakam. Amidst an exchange of heartfelt conversations, Manu is suddenly jolted by an unexpected call from Sanoop.

videos.title: Police Chaos
videos.overview: Diya and Manu engage in a deep conversation about Manu's family. Tensions rise as Chandu's group and the groom set to marry the next morning are arrested for drunk driving.

videos.title: D-Day Duels
videos.overview: Fun chaos breaks at the registrar office on the wedding day while Manu teases Diya that she said she likes him. Chandu then learns a shocking revelation about the girl he likes.

videos.title: Wedding Night
videos.overview: The roadblock turns into a celebratory convoy of relatives. Sanoop's first-night preparations descend into hilarious chaos as his cousins relentlessly tease him.

videos.title: The Full Stop
videos.overview: As Sanoop's wedding celebrations wind down, everyone begins to leave. At the bus stand, Manu finally confesses his feelings to Diya, but she rejects him in favour of Jay.

videos.title: End of Days and Rays of Hope
videos.overview: Prajith is preparing to get married but faces a significant challenge, Covid. Despite the restrictions, guests arrive to celebrate him while following safety precautions.

videos.title: Social Distancing
videos.overview: Prajith's lockdown wedding spirals into socially distanced chaos and masked photos. Just as Manu plans an early escape, an unexpected twist gives him a reason to stay.

videos.title: Quarantine 'Tharavadu'
videos.overview: Locked in the ancestral house, the cousins turn quarantine into a reality show under Prabhakaran's command. A late-night confession round brings long-buried heartbreaks to light.

videos.title: Ceasefires
videos.overview: As Manu and Diya call an uneasy truce, Megha's secret relationship raises alarm among the cousins. Meanwhile, a prank on Aswathy's online class pushes her to a breaking point.

videos.title: The Escape
videos.overview: Ashwathy finds her fire again. Restless in quarantine, Chandu, Manu and Diya sneak out for a night in town. But the adventure spirals into a police chase through empty streets.

videos.title: The Ambulance Ride
videos.overview: Stranded after a curfew, Manu and Diya find an unlikely ride home in an ambulance. As they laugh through the fear, the old walls between them finally begin to crumble.

videos.title: The Balcony Confession
videos.overview: A football injury leaves Diya hurt and humiliated. On a quiet balcony at night, Manu finally opens his heart to her and a single moment changes their relationship forever.

videos.title: A New Day
videos.overview: Free of her past, Diya embraces a new beginning and helps Megha break away from Shaan. But as quarantine nears its end, she realises that she isn't ready to let this world go.

videos.title: The Full Stop
videos.overview: On their last night together, the cousins celebrate. Manu and Diya share a dance to remember. But one conversation the next morning threatens to end their story before it begins.

videos.title: The Return
videos.overview: Three years on, life has moved forward for everyone except Diya, who seems withdrawn since her mother's death. Coaxed to attend a wedding, she comes face-to-face with Manu again.

videos.title: Old Wounds
videos.overview: Manu and Diya navigate an awkward reunion while old family tensions resurface. As Haldi preparations begin, secrets simmer beneath the cousins' laughter and chaos.

videos.title: Stealing the Show
videos.overview: Veena's Haldi ceremony turns into a battle of egos as the cousins scramble to save face. Diya's unexpected performance stirs up feelings no one saw coming.

videos.title: Juice and Judgment
videos.overview: A prank meant to embarrass Veena spirals into public humiliation. Manu finds himself torn between duty and feelings he can't quite bury.

videos.title: The Ultimatum
videos.overview: Fallout from the prank threatens to unravel the wedding, forcing Manu into a confrontation that tests just how far he'll go to keep the peace.

videos.title: Cracks Before the Sangeet
videos.overview: As the sangeet nears, tensions rise over Megha's troubled relationship and old rivalries. A devastating message pushes Manu closer to a dangerous breaking point.

videos.title: Breaking Point
videos.overview: As celebrations continue, family conflicts boil over and Manu spirals further into heartbreak, leaving the cousins scrambling to hold things together.

videos.title: The Long Way Home
videos.overview: A raw, unfiltered night on the road forces Manu and Diya to finally confront everything left unsaid between them… and everything they still can't say.

videos.title: Second Thoughts
videos.overview: In the dead of night, Diya makes a decision that could change everything; one that puts her, Manu, and the family's fragile peace on the line.

videos.title: The Elopement
videos.overview: A daring plan sets the cousins into motion as Diya and Manu chase one last chance at the life they never got to have.

videos.title: Back to the Kiss
videos.overview: Diya's world comes crashing down as the day takes a turn no one could have predicted and the cousins are left to pick up the pieces.

videos.title: Three Years Later
videos.overview: With the past behind her, Diya has built a quiet life away from everyone. But a familiar face and a cousin gathering bring old memories rushing back.

videos.title: Old Photographs, New Beginnings
videos.overview: An old photograph reopens wounds Diya thought she had buried. Amid a lively shopping spree for Megha's wedding, the cousins reunite, with Diya eventually joining them for dinner.

videos.title: One Night, Not Yet Ready
videos.overview: As Megha's big day draws closer, a tearful reunion and a tense family meet test just how ready Diya really is to let this family back into her life

videos.title: Athirappilly
videos.overview: The cousins gather for another wedding. Old wounds and new beginnings collide against the stunning backdrop of Athirappilly.

videos.title: Family Ties
videos.overview: Family loyalties are tested as old grudges resurface and a shocking threat forces the cousins to close ranks around one of their own.

videos.title: Confronting the Truth
videos.overview: The cousins confront a painful truth head-on, in a night that tests just how far they'll go to protect their family.

videos.title: Truths Revealed
videos.overview: Long-buried secrets finally come to light as the celebrations reach a fever pitch, and a surprising revelation changes everything for Manu.

videos.title: A Prickly Conscience
videos.overview: On the day of the wedding, a hidden truth from the past surfaces, sending Diya on a search that could change the course of her life.

videos.title: Above the Falls
videos.overview: At the waterfalls, Manu and Diya finally say the things they have carried in their hearts for years… and make a choice that will define them.

videos.title: Full Circle
videos.overview: As one journey ends, the cousins send off one of their own in true chaotic fashion. Just then, an old story finds its way back to where it began.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Brothers and Sisters
_verifiedMetadata.description: Bound by love and unspoken truths, Shanmuga Sundaram and his devoted family's lives revolve around shared rituals... till hidden cracks begin to surface.

videos.title: The House of SS
videos.overview: Meet the family of SS and his devoted wife, along with their beautiful children. In Bengaluru, their first daughter Jayshree's live-in boyfriend goes missing.

videos.title: Jayshree's Second Chance
videos.overview: Priyan saves Jayshree after her drastic decision. SS and his family are unable to contact her. Meanwhile, Siddharth opens up to his mother about his feelings for Harini.

videos.title: Priyan Guides Jayshree
videos.overview: As Jayshree struggles to cope, Priyan makes her face reality and persuades her to return to the warmth of her family. Back at home, Meera gives SS a makeover.

videos.title: Harini vs Jayshree's Secret
videos.overview: Jayshree returns home and manages to hide her secret. However, Harini begins to sense that something is wrong and suspects that she is hiding a problem.

videos.title: Harini Stands by Jayshree
videos.overview: SS rejects Ponmalar's brother Azhagar's marriage proposal for Jayshree. Meanwhile, Harini takes Jayshree for counseling to help her feel better.

videos.title: Harini Meets Siddharth's Mother
videos.overview: SS gets the jewels from Ponmalar to secure funds for Girija's investment in a new house. Meanwhile, Siddharth's mother pays a visit to his office to meet his love interest, Harini.

videos.title: New Opportunity for Jayshree
videos.overview: When Harini looks for a lawyer's job for Jayshree, Siddharth uses his connections and helps her get a job. His father is surprised and questions him about his unusual behaviour.

videos.title: Jaggu and Madhu Grow Closer
videos.overview: Jaggu and Madhu find themselves growing closer as new feelings spark between them. Meanwhile, Girija celebrates a fresh start by hosting a grand house-warming function.

videos.title: Siddharth Faces Roshini's Love
videos.overview: Despite Girija's objections, Madhu visits jail to meet someone. Following his mother's advice, Siddharth asks Roshini to move out of his cabin. But Roshini has different plans.

videos.title: Harini Opens Up
videos.overview: Ashwin gives Meera a hard time about her siblings' attitude towards him. Meanwhile, Harini shares her budding love interest with Jayshree.

videos.title: Jayshree's Dilemma
videos.overview: Jayshree unexpectedly meets Priyan and learns of his situation. On the marriage front, things move too fast for Jayshree, but Harini convinces her to agree for now.

videos.title: Jaggu's Shocking Discovery
videos.overview: Girija asks SS to accompany her to a friend's wedding. At Jaggu's DJ gig, he sees something that shakes his world.

videos.title: SS's Secret Shocks the Family
videos.overview: Jaggu discovers a startling truth about SS and confides in his sisters. Together, they decide to keep their mother unaware of the situation.

videos.title: Jaggu Presents the Proof
videos.overview: As his sisters struggle to accept it, Jaggu presents proof of SS's affair. Unaware of the growing tension, SS remains busy preparing for the groom's visit to see Jayshree.

videos.title: Humiliation Strikes Jayshree
videos.overview: When the groom publicly reveals the truth about Jayshree, Ponmalar collapses from the shock. While Jaggu watches helplessly, Priyan steps in to comfort a devastated Jayshree.

videos.title: SS Realises His Love for Ponmalar
videos.overview: After regaining consciousness, Ponmalar asks for Jayshree. Watching SS care for Ponmalar, Jaggu and his sisters begin to realise the depth of his feelings for her.

videos.title: Jaggu's Outburst
videos.overview: Jaggu comes home drunk and has a heated argument with his sisters. He accuses Jayshree of being responsible for their mother's condition, leaving her feeling hurt.

videos.title: A Home Filled with Care
videos.overview: As Ponmalar gets discharged from the hospital, the girls take charge of the cooking and other chores. Ponmalar talks to SS about getting Jayshree married to her brother, Keerthi.

videos.title: Ponmalar Fixes Jayshree's Alliance
videos.overview: Madhu feels Jaggu is distancing himself from her. Meanwhile, Jayshree is unable to voice her feelings after Ponmalar convinces her brother and finalises her alliance with Keerthi.

videos.title: SS Under Scrutiny
videos.overview: Girija takes SS to an Ayurvedic clinic for Ponmalar’s medicines. While Ponmalar is happy with his care and concern, Jaggu questions him about his mysterious hospital visit.

videos.title: Harini Says No
videos.overview: SS agrees to a marriage between Jayshree and Ponmalar's brother, Keerthi. During a car ride, Siddharth insists on taking Harini out for a lunch date, much to Harini's displeasure.

videos.title: Jaggu Learns About Madhu's Family
videos.overview: Jayshree meets Priyan and tells him about her marriage alliance with her relative and her decision to reveal her secrets. Meanwhile, Jaggu meets Madhu and digs into her family.

videos.title: The Children Plot Against SS
videos.overview: SS asks Ponmalar to accompany him to secure a loan for the shop. However, Jaggu and his sisters decide to stop them.

videos.title: Jayshree Tells the Truth
videos.overview: SS vents his frustration to Girija about the business loan issue. When Ponmalar's relatives arrive to finalise the wedding, Jayshree decides to reveal the truth to Keerthi.

videos.title: SS Chooses Girija
videos.overview: After Keerthy rejects the marriage, SS and Jayshree hide it from Ponmalar. SS plans a trip to Ahmedabad to procure stock for Ponmalar Textiles and asks Girija to accompany him.

videos.title: Madhu Convinces Girija!
videos.overview: Madhu encourages Girija not to accompany SS on the Ahmedabad trip, accusing the latter of being selfish. Meanwhile, Jaggu strikes up a new friendship with Meena.

videos.title: SS's Silent Hurt
videos.overview: Jayshree and her sisters plan to reunite their parents by making Ponmalar sleep in their father's room. SS is deeply hurt when they question his business decisions.

videos.title: A Twist on Madhu's Birthday
videos.overview: After Girija leaves for Ahmedabad with SS, Madhu is left alone on her birthday. She invites Jaggu to her house and feeling sorry for her, he visits her. But a surprise awaits him.

videos.title: Meera's Smart Move
videos.overview: As SS leaves for Ahmedabad with Girija, Jaggu and the sisters try to disrupt their trip. Meera’s smart move of joining Ponmalar Textiles surprises everyone.

videos.title: Harini's Unexpected Demand
videos.overview: Harini agrees to accept Siddharth's love with a shocking condition, leaving him torn. Meanwhile, Ponmalar discovers why Keerthi rejected the wedding proposal.

videos.title: SS Under Meera's Watch
videos.overview: After the family's pleas, SS lets Meera intern at Ponmalar textiles. However, rather than concentrating on her training, Meera remains highly observant of SS's every action.

videos.title: Girija Seeks SS's Support
videos.overview: Girija opposes Madhu's love interest, leading to a rift between them. She hopes for support from SS. A heated argument between Priyan and Jayshree unexpectedly brings them closer.

videos.title: SS Lies to Ponmalar
videos.overview: Madhu's hospitalisation forces SS to rush to her and her mother, but Ponmalar has questions. Meanwhile, Siddharth goes to Girija's apartment building in search of a new house.

videos.title: Siddharth Alarms Harini with Truth
videos.overview: Siddharth agrees to Harini's request to live near Girija's house and reveals that he knows the truth. Girija catches Madhu on a call with Jaggu and questions her.

videos.title: Jayshree, Priyan's Special Moment
videos.overview: SS rages at Girija for visiting his shop when his daughter is present. Jayshree helps Priyan admit his pregnant sister to the hospital and they share a heartfelt moment together.

videos.title: Siddharth Takes Harini Home
videos.overview: Priyan is deeply touched as Jayshree gets nutritious postnatal meal for his sister at the hospital. Siddharth introduces Harini to his mother. Velpandi spots them and gets upset.

videos.title: Madhu's Love Confession
videos.overview: Madhu bares her heart to Jaggu, but his unexpected response leaves her shattered. Meanwhile, Siddharth performs his house-warming ceremony and meets Girija.

videos.title: Jayshree's Fumble
videos.overview: Siddharth plays the good neighbour to Girija when she is away from home. Ponmalar again coaxes Jayshree to consider marrying. To pacify her, Jayshree blurts out a lie.

videos.title: Ponmalar Meets Priyan
videos.overview: SS resists the auditor's pressure to sell his textile business as Jaggu seeks a solution. At the hospital, Ponmalar runs into Priyan and mistakes his and Jayshree's bond for love.

videos.title: SS Draws the Line
videos.overview: As Thangam and her sons take charge of SS's security, SS asks Jaggu to end the arrangement. When SS confides in Girija, she advises him to sell Ponmalar Textiles.

videos.title: Madhu's Heartfelt Confession
videos.overview: As SS struggles with a crisis at Ponmalar Textiles, Jayshree offers legal help. Elsewhere, Madhu makes an emotional confession to Jaggu and questions why he cannot love her back.

videos.title: Ponmalar Meets Priyan's Family
videos.overview: Ponmalar decides to visit Priyan and his family to check on them, leaving Jayshree in shock. Meanwhile, Girija changes Madhu's mind and begins searching for a groom for her.

videos.title: SS Goes Missing
videos.overview: SS mysteriously goes missing, throwing Girija's household into chaos when the groom's family arrives. Ponmalar and her daughters desperately search for SS, fearing for his safety.

videos.title: Jaggu Seeks Thangam's Help
videos.overview: Jaggu approaches Meenu and asks for Thangam's help in finding his missing father. Meanwhile, Harini asks Siddharth to seek his father's assistance in moving the case forward.

videos.title: Girija Avoids SS
videos.overview: SS returns home after going missing for a night. Girija is angry with SS and refuses to answer his calls. As the stress builds, she faints, and Siddharth helps her.

videos.title: SS Faces Girija's Wrath
videos.overview: SS worries about Girija avoiding his calls and goes to her house. Once there, she vents her frustration and disappointment.

videos.title: Ponmalar Talks About Priyan
videos.overview: Madhu and Girija plan to rent out their house without SS's involvement. Ponmalar has a conversation with Jayshree about Priyan.

videos.title: Priyan Plays Reluctant Cupid
videos.overview: Baskar approaches Jayshree using Priyan's phone, creating friction between Jayshree and Priyan. Girija realises SS was indeed kidnapped.

videos.title: Jaggu Doubts Jayshree-Priyan's Bond
videos.overview: Jaggu spots Jayshree having tea with Priyan and suspects they are more than friends. He shares his doubts with Ponmalar, while Meera struggles to convince SS about online sales.

videos.title: Jayshree's Feelings Surface
videos.overview: Priyan's gift stirs new feelings in Jayshree. While the Ponmalar Textiles staff voice their concerns about online sales to SS, Girija reconciles with him and awaits his visit.

videos.title: A Critical Turn for Jaggu
videos.overview: Jaggu has been hospitalised following an accident, which has left SS feeling distressed. Meanwhile, Girija is anxiously waiting for SS at home, oblivious to the situation.

videos.title: Jaggu's Truth Reaches His Sisters
videos.overview: Madhu visits Jaggu in the hospital and lashes out at him for cheating on her. Meera, Harini and Jayshree witness the confrontation and discover the truth about their relationship.

videos.title: Jayshree’s Mission to Free Mohan
videos.overview: Jayshree meets Mohan in jail and promises to get him out. Since she needs Girija’s signature to appeal in court, she asks Siddharth to help reach out to Mohan’s daughter, Madhu.

videos.title: Siddharth Caught in SS’s Suspicion
videos.overview: Photographer Vivek makes Meera the model for Ponmalar Textiles’ photoshoot. The security guard mistakenly assumes Siddharth is meeting Girija and Madhu and informs SS about it.

videos.title: Madhu's Modelling Break
videos.overview: SS is upset with Vivek after seeing Meera as the model, while Vivek approaches Madhu for the next campaign. Elsewhere, Kala's visit to the doctor brings an unexpected twist.

videos.title: When Ponmalar Meets Madhu
videos.overview: Vivek's request for help with Madhu's saree brings Madhu and Ponmalar together for the first time. Elsewhere, Madhu and Girija seek a loan to kick-start their business.

videos.title: Jayshree’s Unexpected Shock
videos.overview: SS advises Girija against starting a business, while Mohan seeks financial aid from outside source. Jayshree visits Priyan to confess her feelings, but she is in for a big shock.

videos.title: Priyan Proposes to Jayshree!
videos.overview: Girija and Madhu are surprised when their loan gets approved by the bank. Meanwhile, Priyan proposes to Jayshree not knowing what she is going through.

videos.title: Velpandi’s Startling Decision
videos.overview: Jayshree confesses to Harini why she rejected Priyan’s love, while Priyan struggles with heartbreak. Siddhu is elated as Velpandi finally accepts Harini as his daughter-in-law.

videos.title: Velpandi Corners Harini
videos.overview: SS meets Punniyakodi for a groom for Jayshree, but Ponmalar understands her daughter’s plight. Harini visits Velpandi, whose strategic move could change the course of her wedding.

videos.title: Jayshree Draws the Line
videos.overview: Jaggu and his sisters learn about Girija’s new boutique. Jayshree meets Priyan and expresses her concerns about taking their relationship to the next level.

videos.title: Meera Caught in the Middle

videos.title: Priyan Fights for Jayshree

videos.title: SS' Disappointment Turns to Anger

videos.title: SS and Girija's Growing Distance

videos.title: Kala's Wedding Pressure

videos.title: SS Tries to Pacify Girija

videos.title: SS Begins to Suspect

videos.title: Siddharth’s Clever Plan
videos.overview: Madhu gets furious with Girija for forgiving SS. Siddharth suggests that his parents, Kala and Velpandi visit bride Harini’s family, but without him.

videos.title: Jayshree Avoids the Awkwardness
videos.overview: Harini gets SS’s permission to arrange the groom’s visit at her house. Meanwhile, Jayshree leaves to visit Chandra on the same day to avoid the awkwardness at home.

videos.title: Jayshree Finally Finds Chandra
videos.overview: Siddharth’s parents visit SS’s house. While Jaggu insists that Jayshree’s marriage should happen first, Jayshree, Priyan, and Madhu finally find Chandra. Did she recognize them?

videos.title: Siddharth’s Lie Raises Doubts
videos.overview: SS learns that Madhu visited Chandra to seek her help in getting Mohan released. Ponmalar gets doubtful seeing Siddharth on the street as his parents had said that he was abroad.

videos.title: Jayshree Opens her Heart
videos.overview: Jayshree speaks her mind when Priyan’s brother-in-law convinces her to marry Priyan. Meanwhile, SS looks for a potential match for Jayshree through a matrimonial website.

videos.title: Priyan and Jayshree’s Plan
videos.overview: Priyan and Jayshree plan to convince his sister. Ponmalar contacts Kala for Siddharth’s horoscope. Later, Kala comes up with a master plan to make the wedding happen

videos.title: SS Tests Priyan
videos.overview: SS meets Priyan personally to determine whether he is the right match for Jayshree. Chandra comes to Ponmalar Textiles to visit SS.

videos.title: Jayshree’s Tough Task for Madhu
videos.overview: After Madhu gives Jayshree the NOC signed by Chandra, she gives her a tough task to complete. Meanwhile, Priyan finds it difficult to convince his sister to accept Jayshree.

videos.title: Jayshree Gives Priyan the Good News
videos.overview: Jayshree tells Priyan that her father wants to meet his sister and family to discuss the wedding. Meanwhile, Madhu shoots the coconut oil advertisement with Keerthi.

videos.title: SS Humiliates Siddharth
videos.overview: Jayshree confirms Mohan’s release, making Madhu happy. Meanwhile, Siddharth confronts Harini after he visits Ponmalar Textiles and SS humiliates him in front of everyone.

videos.title: Madhu Learns the Truth
videos.overview: Siddharth and Harini feel heartbroken after their fight. Meanwhile, Madhu learns the harsh truth about Jaggu and his decision to avoid her.

videos.title: Ponmalar Discovers Kala’s Secret
videos.overview: Jayshree tries to resolve the conflict between Harini and Siddharth. Meanwhile, Ponmalar meets Kala at the hospital and learns her truth and the urgency behind the wedding.

videos.title: Girija Seeks Divorce
videos.overview: Determined to move on from her bitter past with Mohan, Girija meets lawyer Leelavathy to proceed with the divorce. Jayshree is shocked by the turn of events.

videos.title: SS Discovers Madhu’s Ad Shoot
videos.overview: Ponmalar’s family visits Priyan’s house to formalise the wedding and proceed with the arrangements. Meanwhile, SS learns about Madhu doing an advertisement with Keerthi.

videos.title: SS Confronts Siddharth
videos.overview: Siddharth and Harini reconcile and decide to go ahead with the wedding. Harini takes SS to meet Siddharth. Seeing Siddharth, SS gets furious, but his questions leave him in shock.

videos.title: Siddharth’s Unexpected Move
videos.overview: Harini returns home in tears, fearing that her father has rejected Siddharth. Meanwhile, Siddharth tries to convince SS but makes a shocking move to win his approval.

videos.title: SS’s Family Visits Velpandi
videos.overview: SS and Ponmalar decide to sell their property to arrange finances for their daughters’ wedding. Later, the family visits Velpandi’s house to discuss the wedding arrangements.

videos.title: Double Date
videos.overview: Meena confesses her love to Jaggu but maintains a distance. Meanwhile, Jayshree and Priyan, along with Harini and Siddharth, go on a double date.

videos.title: Madhu Makes a Difficult Request
videos.overview: The police arrive to investigate and question Girija and Madhu regarding Mohan’s early release from jail, creating tension. Later, Madhu meets SS and makes a strange request.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Warrant
_verifiedMetadata.description: A bullied and vulnerable small‑town constable transforms into a brutal force while solving forgotten warrant cases, until a custodial death forces the law to judge the man he has become.

videos.title: An Attack That Changed Karuppu's Life
videos.overview: On his first station duty, Karuppu lets an accused escape, but when he recaptures him, a brutal attack changes his life forever.

videos.title: Karuppu Faces Humiliation
videos.overview: Mocked by colleagues and burdened by a humiliating nickname, Karuppu struggles in the force until a major warrant case comes his way.

videos.title: A Determined Karuppu's Warrant Mission
videos.overview: Determined to prove himself, Karuppu leads a warrant mission but ends up realising that nabbing criminals is tougher than donning the uniform.

videos.title: A Brutal Murder Case
videos.overview: The entire police station is stunned when Karuppu cracks a brutal murder case and controls a violent 15-member clash in a single day.

videos.title: The Honey Trap
videos.overview: As the hunt for Kodaikanal Saravanan intensifies, Karuppu sets a honey trap to nab the notorious criminal.

videos.title: Karuppu's Poweful Attack on Saravanan
videos.overview: Power and rage engulf Karuppu as he brutally breaks Saravanan’s leg in what appears to be an encounter.

videos.title: Feared Yet Trusted
videos.overview: Karuppu rises as the station’s most feared and trusted constable, but in the quest of solving others’ problems, he slowly begins to lose his own humanity.

videos.title: Karuppu’s Troubled Past
videos.overview: A mysterious custodial death unsettles the department as Karuppu’s troubled past resurfaces, drawing his name into the enquiry.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Super Subbu
_verifiedMetadata.description: An unlucky teacher is assigned to teach sex ed in a hostile village. Can he balance this secret while chasing his dreams and saving his relationship?

_verifiedMetadata.name: The Revolutionaries
_verifiedMetadata.description: The Revolutionaries narrates the inspiring tale of brave young Indian freedom fighters who fought for ending British Raj with their unwavering spirit and ideology.

videos.title: Behroopiya
videos.overview: An assassination attempt on the Viceroy shakes the foundations of the British Raj. As the Empire unleashes the ruthless Lt. Col. Dyer to hunt down those responsible, Rash Behari Bose races to finish the mission he set in motion. Sachindranath Sanyal struggles against his family's legacy of operating in the shadows, throwing his engagement to Pratibha Lahiri into question.

videos.title: Shaagird
videos.overview: After a narrow escape, Rash contemplates his next move. Sachin is torn between the promise of love and his dream of fighting on the frontlines of the freedom struggle, facing a choice that could alter the course of his life. Meanwhile, Dyer's relentless investigation for British India's Most Wanted Man leads him to Benaras.

videos.title: Ekla Cholo Re
videos.overview: Rash and Sachin reunite with Pishima, caretaker of the Revolutionaries' Calcutta safe house. After years underground, the legendary Bagha Jatin returns with an audacious plan: to execute the greatest heist the British Empire has ever seen. DCP Tegart closes in on the elusive revolutionary and, determined not to let Jatin slip away a second time, unwittingly walks into a carefully laid trap.

videos.title: Paigaam
videos.overview: The Revolutionaries go underground. As Dyer tightens the noose around Rash, an unforeseen obstacle throws his hunt into disarray. In Benaras, 18-year-old rebel Kartar Singh Sarabha joins forces with Pratibha, who takes a bold risk to deliver a message that could alter the rebellion's fate. And when a message from Ghadar leader Lala Hardayal reaches Rash, a dying revolution surges back to life.

videos.title: Shabaash!
videos.overview: A devastating incident leaves Rash and Jatin confronting the cost of their cause, as Sachin fights for his life. Just as Dyer narrows in on the hiding Revolutionaries, the tide begins to turn, as thousands answer the call of revolution.

videos.title: Komagata Maru
videos.overview: After a long and perilous voyage, the Komagata Maru finally docks in Calcutta. Disguised among the crowds, Rash, Kartar, and Pishima arrive to receive the revolutionaries returning home to fight for freedom. But the British are ready for them. As Dyer and Tegart race to unravel the insurgent plot, Rash finds himself trapped at the heart of a conspiracy on the verge of exposure.

videos.title: Aur Bhi Aayenge
videos.overview: An ally and a mole are both revealed. Pratibha challenges Jatin's perspective on the role of women in the revolution as Pishima holds on against torturous circumstances. The Revolutionaries scatter to execute their plans, leaving themselves dangerously exposed. Meanwhile, Tegart pieces together a single, devastating clue that could bring the entire revolution crashing down.

videos.title: Ghadar!
videos.overview: Heartbreaking news months before Ghadar day leaves the Revolutionaries reeling and forces Rash to confront the terrible cost of freedom. When all hope seems lost, Pratibha arrives at the training camp with a bold plan that could save the rebellion. But as the dream of revolution is reborn, the mole finally plays his cards, threatening to bring the entire movement crashing down.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As the investigation deepens, tensions inside the mansion start to surface.

videos.title: Hell's Kitchen
videos.overview: Vetri is a village boy burdened by his family responsibilities. His journey begins at RR Resort, where he comes face-to-face with Nedumaran, the resort kitchen's dictator.
