videos.overview: Devika and Danny go to Durga's house to get Gayathri Amma's documents. Devika finally confronts Jaggi and her spiritual journey begins.

videos.title: The Frog Jumps Out of the Bowl
videos.overview: Devika and Danny go to Durga's house to get Gayathri Amma's documents. Devika finally confronts Jaggi and her spiritual journey begins.

_verifiedMetadata.name: The Pyramid Scheme
_verifiedMetadata.description: Follows the story of Goldy, an ambitious but impatient young man, whose quest to get rich through a pyramid marketing business spirals into a rollercoaster of chaos - risking not just his future, but also the love and trust of his close-knit joint family.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Mazha Thorum Munpe
_verifiedMetadata.description: Abandoned as a child, Aleena grows up longing for love. Will life ever lead her back to her lost parents and the happiness she dreams of?

videos.title: Aleena's World Falls Apart
videos.overview: Tensions rise during the 25th anniversary celebrations of Snehanikethan as caretaker Brijithamma suddenly collapses. Aleena is devastated upon hearing the doctor's grave diagnosis.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Police Police
_verifiedMetadata.description: A cop hires a criminal to become a cop illegally. How long will they manage to get away with it?

videos.title: The Clash of Paths
videos.overview: Sub-Inspector Raja lives a disciplined life while Murali spends his time gambling. What happens when the two encounter each other for the first time in a moment of conflict?

videos.title: A Chance at Redemption
videos.overview: Murali redeems himself by helping SI Raja identify the culprit in a chain-snatching case. How will Raja react when he narrates his life's dream to him?

videos.title: Vaavar's Rise
videos.overview: Because of SI Raja's aggressive actions, he is restrained from handling cases at the station. This leaves Vaavar to dominate every investigation.

videos.title: Raja's Offer
videos.overview: In a bid to reestablish himself at the station, Raja extends an offer to Murali. But will Murali accept it?

videos.title: The Uniform of Dreams
videos.overview: A fading wish, a fragile bond - the only world Murali knows is on the verge of disappearing.

videos.title: The Paths We Dare
videos.overview: When loyalties and risks collide, a single decision can change the course of two lives... or trap them both.

videos.title: Hidden Training
videos.overview: As secrets come to light, can Murali step onto a new path? Or will the memories of the past continue to follow him?

videos.title: First Day
videos.overview: Murali steps into his new role. Now, he and Raja must keep the secrets that brought them together.

videos.title: Shifting Moves
videos.overview: Murali and Lalithambika’s game takes a new turn. Now, can mysteries hold? Or will Raja and Vaavar’s secret dealings change everything?

videos.title: Echoes of the Hunt
videos.overview: A trap is laid in the park. Though the kidnappers were in sight, constable Murali’s error alters everything.

videos.title: Roasted by the Minister
videos.overview: Raja gets trapped under the weight of power and authority. Meanwhile, Murali stands confused and helpless.

videos.title: Unexpected Allies
videos.overview: Lalithambika and Murali, once enemies by necessity, are forced to become allies. What will happen next?

videos.title: Past Imperfect
videos.overview: Raja's painful past is revealed to Murali. Thanks to their friends, Lalithambika and Murali are forced to sit through a movie together.

videos.title: Operation Love Letter
videos.overview: Skeletal remains are found in a cemented drum, and Vaavar is tasked to solve it. Meanwhile, Jeeva and team chase a thief who left behind a love letter.

videos.title: Centre of Attention
videos.overview: Muniyandi asks his son about a kidnapped college boy. Arthana questions Vaavar about the status of the cemented skeleton case, but Murali already has answers.

videos.title: Kidnapping a Case
videos.overview: Murali volunteers to solve the case of the kidnapped college boy, but Vaavar has its file under lock and key. Meanwhile, Lalithambika comes across Raja's daughter on the road.

videos.title: An Unexpected Meeting
videos.overview: After years, Raja and Neelasundaravalli come face to face. As forgotten emotions from the past resurface, where will this unexpected encounter take their love journey?

videos.title: The Unfinished Chapter
videos.overview: As Vaavar’s hunt for truth begins, will the outcome be as he expects? Raja and Neelasundaravalli’s untold love story unfolds. In a tale of love, who made the mistakes?

videos.title: The Missed Details
videos.overview: After providing solid evidence, Vaavar closes the murder case. Murali, however, feels something is not right and secretly begins his own investigation. Will his efforts bear fruit?

videos.title: Trust Your Instincts!
videos.overview: Murali’s instinct insists that something is amiss, and he finds himself re-investigating a case already thought as solved. Will his gut be right this time?

videos.title: The Hidden Badge
videos.overview: Murali’s secret life as a cop begins to unravel when his past comes chasing. As chaos erupts, SI Raja steps in, and Lalithambika’s quiet presence weaves into the unfolding storm.

videos.title: First Pay
videos.overview: Murali begins to understand the pulse of police life through Raja’s guidance. His first salary becomes a moment of pride and warmth, bridging the distance between duty and home.

videos.title: The Power Play
videos.overview: Raja fumes when illegal money linked to a minister slip from the law’s grip. With Murali’s sharp idea, the chase shifts from the streets to strategy, where power and justice clash.

videos.title: The Fall of Power
videos.overview: Murali’s master plan unfolds with surgical precision, pulling a powerful minister into a web of his own making. As truth surfaces, a father’s silence burns louder than his power.

videos.title: A Quiet Shift
videos.overview: A regular day at the station brings small tensions and quiet victories. Unspoken changes linger in the air, setting up a new phase for everyone.

videos.title: Operation Ganga Cow
videos.overview: A routine complaint turns into a quirky field mission that puts the station’s teamwork and patience to the test. What starts as a light assignment leads to an unexpected trail.

videos.title: Echoes from Two Decades
videos.overview: A promising lead takes the team back 20 years into a forgotten killing. What starts as a routine enquiry ends with a chilling recollection of the past.

videos.title: Buried Truths
videos.overview: Clues from the past take Raja and Murali deeper into an unsolved murder. Each answer raises new questions about what really happened 20 years ago.

videos.title: Algorithm of Memories
videos.overview: As Raja follows an AI trace, a reunion with his childhood friend Shwetha reawakens the past. Neela’s impulsive choice adds a new twist to the team’s rhythm.

videos.title: Collision Point
videos.overview: An official lead and a personal choice collide on the same day. An attack at Lalithambika’s office pulls Raja into a rescue that blurs every line between case and care.

videos.title: Sugar and Surveillance
videos.overview: In Visakhapatnam, a modest sweet stall hides more than sugar. Murali and Lalithambika’s undercover move draw the suspect out, but every smile at the counter could be a test.

videos.title: Closing Circuit
videos.overview: Every clue points to one moment and it finally arrives. Raja connects the missing links and cracks both cases in a move that rewrites the investigation’s course.

videos.title: Party and the Paper
videos.overview: Raja, Murali and the rest of the team celebrate the completion of a difficult case. But the calm fractures when Swetha is attacked at the hospital and a vital file is stolen.

videos.title: Ashes of the Truth
videos.overview: A son’s breakdown changes everything for Muniyandi. Lalitha and Murali spend quality time together. But what happens when a stolen post-mortem report goes up in flames?

videos.title: Neon Clue
videos.overview: Murali’s search for a strange glow-mask opens a path no one expected. As the dots start to align, Muniyandi makes a silent decision that pushes the case into deeper waters.

videos.title: Warmth and Whispers
videos.overview: A tender meeting arranged by Murali brings an unexpected softness to Raja’s day. However, a young girl’s absence hints that the moment of joy might have come with a shadow.

videos.title: The White Clue
videos.overview: A sudden incident pushes Raja and Murali towards an unexpected trail. As a forgotten detail unfolds, tensions erupt when Neela storms in. A white clue changes course of the case.

videos.title: The Mask Trail
videos.overview: The team chases the origins of a mysterious mask, only to find the trail growing thinner. In the station, uneasy silences and hidden fears begin to surface.

videos.title: Written in Clues
videos.overview: The team examines one letter that could unlock everything. Each stroke, each mark, draws the net tighter. Soon, the case feels uncomfortably near.

videos.title: Breaking Point
videos.overview: Just as the investigation tightens, a brutal incident rattles everyone. Fear and anger rise on both sides of the law. The station enters an unfamiliar territory.

videos.title: Trouble Visits More Than Once
videos.overview: Aachi and Lalithambika get hospitalised. While Vaavar's temper and Muniyandi's suspension unsettle the team, one truth becomes clear: nothing stays buried for long.

videos.title: The Weight of the Truth
videos.overview: Troubled by Vaavar's warning, Murali goes into a state of panic. A simple missing bike complaint opens a trail that refuses to stay simple.

videos.title: A Trail and a Shadow
videos.overview: Raja follows a quiet danger, one that began with Lalitha. Somewhere outside the station, a pair of old eyes starts watching the officers more closely.

videos.title: Warmth and Clashing Realities
videos.overview: Lalitha settles into a new space, unaware of the emotions it awakens. Raja starts investigating all the bike gangs. Meanwhile, Vinoth visits Murali's station.

videos.title: Emotional Turmoil
videos.overview: The case stirs up old memories as Murali and Raja battle their inner conflicts. Neela, in pain, tries to call Raja, but cannot reach him.

videos.title: The Missing Rudraksha!
videos.overview: Vinoth’s missing Rudraksha has Murali worried as his past returns to haunt him. Raja wonders about Murali’s strange behaviour. Meanwhile, a desperate Neela takes a drastic step.

videos.title: Inner Struggle
videos.overview: Murali worries about his secret being revealed. Meanwhile, Raja is angry with Murali's strange behaviour. Will Vishwa’s word of advice guide him through his stress?

videos.title: The Drug Route
videos.overview: Lalitha tries to comfort a dejected Murali. When Raja senses his conflict, Murali confesses to him. With the air cleared between them, Raja takes a firm decision.

videos.title: Confession and Confusion
videos.overview: Murali gets clarity on Vinoth's role in his past through his confession. Meanwhile, confusion arises at the station as the cops struggle to crack an existing case.

videos.title: Award Gone Wrong
videos.overview: It was supposed to be a happy family moment, a milestone in Neela's professional career, but again Mission MAD fails. Meanwhile, Murali springs many surprises on Lalitha.

videos.title: Wheel of Life
videos.overview: Finally, Murali brings his magic moving house to Lalitha. A major incident from Murali's past is unravelled because of Bheemji.

videos.title: The End or the New Beginning!
videos.overview: Murali's struggle with the past and Raja's search for Lalitha's attacker ends. But the answer isn't something they're going to like as a much bigger challenge begins.

videos.title: A Bond Breaks! A Bond Forms!
videos.overview: After the unexpected turn of events, Murali ends his friendship with Vinoth. For Lalitha, a new chapter is set to begin as she gets closer to Murali and bonds with his grandmother.

videos.title: Matchmaking!
videos.overview: The case of a missing bride takes Raja to his better half. Lalitha's father registers her name at the matrimony office, but Swetha is a step ahead as she plays the matchmaker.

videos.title: Mission MAD Ends in Vain
videos.overview: Neela finds out who is behind Mission MAD and changes her divorce lawyer. Vaavar sets out to bring justice to Mohammad Ali while Raja continues his search for the missing bride.

videos.title: Two Different Paths
videos.overview: Murali and Lalitha enjoy the first essence of their love. Raja is shocked to get a divorce notice from Neela. Meanwhile, the case believed to be solved takes an unexpected turn.

videos.title: The Root of All Evil
videos.overview: Lalitha and Murali confess to Raja about the reason behind Neela's recent outburst. A dejected Raja informs them what conspired on that day to lead to his and Neela's split.

videos.title: Raja Finds the Bride
videos.overview: Raja works his way to find the missing bride who was earlier considered as a fraudster. Meanwhile, Aira learns about the past he shares with Raja.

videos.title: No Giving Up!
videos.overview: Lalitha encourages Raja not to give up and to fight his case against Neela. While Swency is firm that Jeeva learns to ride a bicycle, the Mohammad Ali case takes a positive turn.

videos.title: Parents and Problems
videos.overview: During the divorce hearing, Raja and Neela dispute over Sathya’s custody. Lalitha’s father, on the other hand, comes between his daughter and her love unintentionally.

videos.title: The Price Of Truth
videos.overview: Murali is shocked to learn about Lalitha’s father. Worried that Murali's truth may land them in trouble, Raja gives him an ultimatum. Ayiravathan warns Raja of an upcoming rivalry.

videos.title: Duty Or Desire?
videos.overview: Shattered, Murali avoids Lalitha, who worries about his behaviour. Ayiravathan prepares kids and youth to fight for their caste while his men wage an indirect war against the cops.

videos.title: In The Dark
videos.overview: Unable to bear his silence, an anxious Lalitha confronts Murali. Meanwhile, despite several issues, Raja and Murali see some light in their quest to solve Mohammad Ali's case.

videos.title: Round 1 Goes to Ayiravathan
videos.overview: Raja and Murali track down Mohammad Ali's killer and arrest him. However, things turn against Raja in the courtroom, leading to his suspension, much to Ayiravathan’s relief.

videos.title: Clueless Days
videos.overview: The cops struggle with electricity and landowner issues. Lalitha is unable to assess Murali’s strange behaviour. Suspended Raja is spotted at a place no one expected him to be in.

videos.title: The Cops Strike Back!
videos.overview: Under Raja's direction, the cops strike back at the landowner and the EB guys. Later, Raja gets closer to one of Ayiravathan's accomplices.

videos.title: Powered Again
videos.overview: With swift action of the police, the landowner issue is resolved, and power is restored at the station. While Lalitha confronts Murali, Raja sets out to gather new evidence.

videos.title: Payback Time
videos.overview: The Mohammed Ali case is back for hearing. Raja gives it back to Ayiravathan as Palani Veerappan is convicted for causing the accident. Someone is moving closer to Murali's truth.

videos.title: Yet Another Challenge
videos.overview: The detective demands a bribe from Raja and Murali to hide Murali’s secret. While Raja encourages a dejected Murali to fight back, he is unaware of Ayiravathan’s next strike.

videos.title: As Different as Night and Day
videos.overview: Murali and Lalitha hide their newfound romance from Raja. Meanwhile, Raja's personal secrets come to light after a video is released by Ayiravathan’s team.

videos.title: In the Shadows!
videos.overview: Lalitha and Murali’s romantic lunch is disturbed by Raja. Later, to nullify the detective’s threat, Murali follows him and figures there is something fishy about his activities.

videos.title: Caught ‘Gold’ Handed!
videos.overview: The detective’s illegal gold smuggling deed is discovered by Raja and Murali and both parties agree mutually to forgo their findings. Neela’s shocking news startles everyone.

videos.title: Misery of a Child and God
videos.overview: A distressed Sathya enters a judge's chamber in court and her question shocks everyone. Raja’s probe affects Neela. Later, Raja and Murali go after a missing God's crown.

videos.title: Not on the Same Page
videos.overview: Raja and Murali's opinions vary in the lost crown case as they doubt two different people. Lalitha has a spat with Gautham for refusing a lucrative offer from one of his friends.

videos.title: Is Blood Thicker than Water?
videos.overview: Feeling guilty, Neela decides to unite with Raja for Sathya’s sake. Raja and Murali catch the thief of the missing crown in Kanagavel's house. However, the crown is still missing.

videos.title: Chasing the Crown and Throne
videos.overview: After retrieving the crown, the cops find out who the mastermind is. Ayiravathan, who is chasing the MLA throne, learns that Lalitha is his only hurdle and he confronts her.

videos.title: Home is Sweet and Sour
videos.overview: Raja shifts to Neela's house after agreeing to conditions and signing an agreement. At the station, Jeeva gets a weird case when a family is attacked by someone that's not a human.

videos.title: Fight Against Discrimination
videos.overview: The alien fiasco is solved by Raja. He moves a step forward against discrimination by taking up Karthik's honour killing case. However, his life in Neela's house has a rocky start.

videos.title: On Cloud Nine!
videos.overview: Murali and Raja are over the moon. While Raja is happy at Neela's house, Murali and Lalitha have their share of fun. The cops fail to get proof in the Karthik murder case.

videos.title: New Crimes, New Clues
videos.overview: Raja's crime rate increases as Neela finds him breaking home rules. Murali goes awry during a romantic video call with Lalitha. Later, the cop duo gets a step closer to the truth.

videos.title: Getting Closer
videos.overview: Raja and Murali are getting closer to identifying Karthik's killer. Later, Murali discreetly acquires evidence from Eli by swapping his phone with a decoy.

videos.title: Standing Up
videos.overview: The commissioner scolds the cops for investigating the Karthik murder case. Vaavar defends his team, and the commissioner warns Lalitha. She resists, sparking tension with Murali.

videos.title: The Sacrifice
videos.overview: Raja seeks help to turn the case around. Meanwhile, Ayira retraces the cops' moves and realises they're too close, forcing him to sacrifice someone to protect himself.

videos.title: Hurdles Everywhere
videos.overview: Raja plans to stay with his father, but Neela insists he comes home. As troubles arise, the Karthik murder hearing starts hopeful, but linking Ayira fails since the A1 is dead.

videos.title: Anything Can Happen in Love
videos.overview: After the Karthik case setback, Lalitha got upset at Murali, while Raja and Neela grew closer. Swency told Jeeva that love had created the imaginary alien.

videos.title: Love Takes You Through Time
videos.overview: To win Lalitha over, Murali gives her everything she loved as a child, including a school crush. During the Mohammad Ali murder case, Raja and Murali discover a new character.

videos.title: Romance With and Without a Car
videos.overview: Murali and Lalitha share a loving car ride, while Raja creates a moment with Neela on his bike. Raja and Murali find a way to contact Ramesh, key to the Mohammad Ali case.

videos.title: Love Can Hurt
videos.overview: The cops retrieve Mohammad Ali’s data, which cost him his life. Lalitha is overjoyed when her grandfather recalls her and asks about her marriage.

videos.title: Bedridden!
videos.overview: Raja suspects his accident was deliberate. The station is alarmed when the lorry driver surrenders. When Raja settles in Neela's house, an unexpected visitor arrives to meet him.

videos.title: The Confrontation
videos.overview: Ayira welcomes a foreigner business partner. Shwetha discovers that many school students are affected by a disease. Raja confronts Murali about his secret romance with Lalitha.

videos.title: Something Deep Inside
videos.overview: Neela invites Murali and Lalitha for lunch and apologises for her behaviour. Raja and Murali steal sand samples from Ayira's yard and send them for testing. The result shocks them.

videos.title: Cat is Out of the Bag
videos.overview: The cops try to get details about Ayira's Korean partner. Raja plans action, but Murali and Jeeva fail to catch Kim. Lalitha feels shattered to learn of Murali's past from Stella.

videos.title: Protest No More!
videos.overview: Kim gets angry with the situation. Ayira handles the protesters and media, while his wife convinces the mothers to leave the protest site. Raja is upset to see his plan go in vain.

videos.title: Another Case, Another Disappointment
videos.overview: Lalitha tries to pin the silicosis issue on Ayira. The quarry's fate is decided, but Palani Veerappan comes up with a plan

videos.title: Too Much Exposure
videos.overview: Gautham secretly records Lalitha and Raja’s conversation as Raja tries to convince her about Murali’s truth. The Commissioner gets furious when he learns Lalitha loves Murali.

videos.title: The Axis Power
videos.overview: Ayira is cornered by Kim and the syndicate. Palani Veerappan gets caught by cops. Ayira shows Gautham’s recording to the Commissioner and together, they form a dangerous alliance.

videos.title: The Blues
videos.overview: Murali and Jeeva spot Ayira get a blue wig from a salon. Vaavar informs the team that police trainer Radhakrishnan is arriving for the Police Day event, shocking Murali and Jeeva.

videos.title: A New Alliance
videos.overview: Ayira and the commissioner clash over the Murali-Raja case. Later, Muniyandi calls out Raja for fraudulently appointing Murali as a police officer.

videos.title: All is Well
videos.overview: Love is back in Raja and Neela's life. Murali gets Vinoth to spy on Ayira. The commissioner joins Raja and Murali as they round up Ayira, but something unexpected happens.

videos.title: All is Not Well
videos.overview: During Police Day celebrations, Murali urges Lalitha to stay, but she ignores him. He evades Radhakrishnan's threat but is caught by the commissioner, beginning a new mission.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Kobali
_verifiedMetadata.description: Two families become entangled in revenge, greed, and payback. Rising tensions unearth buried secrets that impact multiple lives.

videos.title: The Shadows of the Past.
videos.overview: During a village festival, Ramu is drawn into a violent conflict. The past reveals his fraught relationship with his family, especially his brother Srinu.

videos.title: The Drug Lead
videos.overview: Ramu gets into the narcotic drug trade to help his family financially. However, a clash with the local gangsters compels Srinu to intervene.

videos.title: The Betrayal
videos.overview: A vengeful Ramana assigns ruthless Murthy to eliminate Sambaiah's family. Meanwhile, Ramu, embroiled in the illegal drug trade, gets caught in a dangerous web of deceit and betrayal.

videos.title: The First Strike
videos.overview: While seeking refuge after an attack, Sambaiah's family meets a girl whose father is killed. The police question Ramu after his brother Gopi gets implicated in a series of crimes.

videos.title: The Desperation
videos.overview: Srinu and Ramu flee after a deadly encounter with Peeri's gang. They learn of Gopi's betrayal and his fate. An elderly lady shelters Meena and her family, but are they really safe?

videos.title: The Hunt Begins
videos.overview: Shocked by Gopi's fate, Srinu and Ramu decide to seek revenge. While Ramu receives a crucial tip about Paidiraju's whereabouts, Srinu prepares for the inevitable confrontation.

videos.title: The Reckoning
videos.overview: Amidst the revelry of a village festival, SI Raghu confronts Paidiraju. While Srinu and his family face a new threat, Ramana spirals into grief and a thirst for revenge.

videos.title: The Confrontation
videos.overview: Srinu confronts Ramana, seeking revenge for his family's death. But a mysterious figure appears for retribution for past wrongs. What will happen to Srinu and his family?

videos.name: The Watch Project

A Sidelined Tata executive Xerxes Desai is tasked with reviving a dying division of Tata's Tata Press, only to stumble upon a bold idea that could redefine Indian industry. Challenged by global humiliation, he sets out to build India's first world-class watch against all odds.

videos.name: Demonstration

Just when hope resurfaces with a government partnership and the birth of "Titan," financial doors slam shut, threatening the vision once again.

_verifiedMetadata.description: Something Fishy! - Karikku

_verifiedMetadata.name: Seruppugal Jaakirathai
_verifiedMetadata.description: A pair of ordinary slippers becomes the center of chaos when a diamond smuggler uses them as a hiding spot, triggering a frantic search across town.

videos.title: The Birth of the Sandals
videos.overview: Rathnam hides diamonds worth 10 crores inside a pair of slippers and hands them to Thyagu, who misplaces them. When he realizes the worth of the sandals, he sends his son, Ilango, to find the pair.

videos.title: The Elusive Pair
videos.overview: Ilango arrives at Ekambaram's house and is shocked to see a large crowd gathered to pay their last respects. Just as Ilango finds the slippers, a man walks away with them.

videos.title: Sandals in Chaos
videos.overview: Ilango successfully retrieves the slippers. The father and son panic when they cannot find the diamonds inside the slippers. They return to Ekambaram's house, only to receive another shock.

videos.title: Sandals and Secrets
videos.overview: Thyagu and Ilango become restless in their search for the discarded slippers. On the other hand, Rathnam arrives at Ekambaram's house to look for them himself and confronts Thyagu.

videos.title: The Cursed Sandals
videos.overview: Thyagu tricks Rathnam and gets him beaten up by Ekambaram's family. The police arrest Rathnam as Thyagu celebrates thinking the diamond slippers will be his. However, his happiness is short-lived.

videos.title: The Vanishing Sandals
videos.overview: Thyagu and Ilango's final attempt to recover the diamond slippers fails when the police catch them. Surprisingly, no diamonds are found, leading to their release. But where are the diamonds?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Vikkatakavi
_verifiedMetadata.description: In the 1970s, the people of Amaragiri are devastated by a plague that causes memory loss. A detective, Rama Krishna, arrives to investigate the case. Will he find the cause or fall prey to the curse?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Desi Bling
_verifiedMetadata.description: Glitzy parties and delicious secrets rule the lives of ultra-wealthy Indian expats as they spare no expense — or drama.

_verifiedMetadata.name: The Confession of Paul Jobson
_verifiedMetadata.description: A film crew unknowingly welcomes a true psychopath onto their set. But when they push his buttons one too many times, their shoot turns into a deadly game of survival.

videos.title: Reel Vs Real
videos.overview: A film crew unknowingly welcomes a true psychopath onto their set. But when they push his buttons one too many times, their shoot turns into a deadly game of survival.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Om Kali Jai Kali
_verifiedMetadata.description: Set in 1995, a tale of revenge, loyalty and redemption unfolds against the backdrop of the Dasara festival in Tamil Nadu.

videos.title: Surrendering to God
videos.overview: During the Pidari Pooja, a pregnant woman is found inside a well. Kaathadi and Koothaar's search for her brings them to Vanadesam.

videos.title: Cause and Vengeance
videos.overview: Neela reveals her bitter past to the villagers, where her lover was killed while fleeing from Rajadurai. During the Dasara festival, Mookandi dresses as Goddess Kali.

videos.title: Revenge Unfolds
videos.overview: Ganesan seeks revenge for Mookandi and Bama's murder. At Nagercoil court, Kaathadi apologises to Neela, who then takes Ganesan to Rajadurai and the murderers.

videos.title: Justice Served
videos.overview: Kaathadi joins hands with Ganesan and his group. After Barani's death, AJ makes a plan for his son Arun's future in politics. Meanwhile, a young widow is held hostage for Rajadurai.

videos.title: The Final Verdict
videos.overview: The conflict comes to a head when Rajadurai escapes, Arun is kidnapped, and the existence of Vanadesam is put in danger.

_verifiedMetadata.name: The Rana Daggubati Show
_verifiedMetadata.description: Featuring genuine conversations, fun moments and a healthy dose of quirk- this is The Rana Daggubati Show. It’s not just another show, it’s an experience—one that dares to break norms and redefine entertainment by featuring fun and exciting conversations with stars from telugu industry and beyond.

videos.title: Normal Is Boring
videos.overview: Teja is hosting an Award Show for the first time, his entire dilemma is whether his two 'seniors' Rana & Nani, will give him the advice he needs or is he in for some whacky surprises?

videos.title: And Just Like That
videos.overview: Siddhu comes to Rana with a problem about his late-night hunger and Sreeleela joins them to find a solution.

videos.title: Cousins, Cars and Cinema
videos.overview: Rana meets Chay and they chalk a plan to soup up an old car. As they relive childhood memories they are joined by their cousins who discuss cinema, legacy and much more.

videos.title: Master Influencers
videos.overview: Rana reaches out to the Masters who have influenced him, discovering new perspectives to experience the Cinema we all love.

videos.title: Myth Buster!
videos.overview: Get ready for a whirlwind adventure as Rana Daggubati kicks off his journey to Kundapura to meet the one and only Rishab Shetty along with Neha Shetty.

videos.title: When THE GOOD BOY meets BAD BOY
videos.overview: Dulquer and Meenakshi dive into a fun conversation about their latest film and share hilarious childhood memories. The fun continues as they head to the set of Kantha, where Rana juggles producer duties and Dulquer shines as the star.

videos.title: Getting Real with the Real Star
videos.overview: After a wild New Year’s party with his friends Navdeep & Faria, Rana has a wild guest, the Cult Kannada Superstar Upendra along with Actor-Producer Sharmiela Mandre.

videos.title: V for Victory
videos.overview: Come celebrate Sankranthi in the Daggubati home, with a whole selection of Sankranthi sweets curated by Rana’s sister Ashritha, specially for Venky Sir and his squad - Aishwarya, Meenakshi & Anil. Along with a surprise visitor, the musical icon, Ramana Gogula.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Shekhar Tonite
_verifiedMetadata.description: Talk show by Shekhar Suman

videos.title: The Voice of a Common Man
videos.overview: In this heartfelt episode of Shekhar Tonite, Shekhar Suman pays tribute to India's middle class—the people who quietly carry the weight of their families, dreams, responsibilities, and the nation itself. From relatable middle-class habits and everyday struggles to hilarious observations on jugaad, savings, and family life, Shekhar delivers a monologue that is both funny and deeply emotional. The episode also features an inspiring conversation with Mumbai auto driver Sandeep Tiwari, who shares his journey, struggles, dreams, unforgettable passengers, and why honesty, kindness, and hope still matter. This is not just a comedy show—it's a celebration of every common man who keeps moving forward despite life's challenges. If you've ever stood in long queues, adjusted with limited resources, dreamed big despite small means, or believed that tomorrow will be better, this episode is for you.

videos.title: Laalo Team on Their Cannes Journey & Success Story
videos.overview: Every great film begins with a dream. Some dreams make it all the way to Cannes. In this special episode of Shekhar Tonite, Shekhar Suman welcomes the talented creators behind the acclaimed film Laalo—Ankit Sakhiya, Jay Vyas, and Shruhad Goswami. From the challenges of independent filmmaking to earning international recognition and taking Laalo to the Cannes Film Festival, this conversation is filled with inspiring stories, creative struggles, memorable moments, and valuable insights for every cinema lover. If you're passionate about filmmaking, storytelling, or chasing impossible dreams, this is an episode you won't want to miss.

videos.title: Nitin Gadkari
videos.overview: The very first episode of Shekhar Tonite kicks off with none other than Nitin Gadkari joining Shekhar Suman for a conversation that’s equal parts insightful, unfiltered, and outrageously entertaining.

videos.title: Bobby Deol
videos.overview: This week on Shekhar Tonite, Bobby Deol joins Shekhar Suman for a conversation filled with honesty, nostalgia, laughter, stardom, struggles, reinvention, and moments you’ve never seen before.

videos.title: Ali Fazal
videos.overview: An honest, witty, and unfiltered conversation with Ali Fazal and Shekhar Suman, as they dive into stories, perspectives, and moments you don’t usually get to hear.

videos.title: Amruta Fadnavis
videos.overview: This week on Shekhar Tonite, Amruta Fadnavis joins Shekhar Suman for a candid conversation filled with personal stories, music, public life, perspectives on leadership, and moments of honesty, humour, and insight. From balancing multiple roles to navigating life in the public eye, this episode offers a side of Amruta Fadnavis rarely seen before.

videos.title: Manoj Bajpayee
videos.overview: In this episode of Shekhar Tonite, Shekhar Suman and Manoj Bajpayee come together for a candid exchange on life, cinema, ambition, struggles, reinvention, and the stories that shape an artist. From his early days of uncertainty to becoming one of India's most respected actors, Manoj reflects on the journey with honesty, humour, and perspective. A conversation that's insightful, entertaining, and deeply human.

videos.title: Gippy Grewal
videos.overview: Punjabi music sensation and beloved actor Gippy Grewal joins Shekhar Suman on Shekhar Tonite for a conversation that goes far beyond the glitz and glamour. In this episode, Gippy opens up about his incredible journey — from his early struggles to becoming one of the biggest names in Punjabi music and cinema.  He talks candidly about the highs and lows of his career, the emotional moments that shaped him as an artist, and the personal sacrifices behind his success story. Expect raw honesty, heartfelt nostalgia, and a few laughs along the way as Shekhar Suman digs deep into the man behind the music. This is one of the most emotional and real conversations on Shekhar Tonite yet — a must-watch for fans of Gippy Grewal, Punjabi music, and inspiring life stories.

videos.title: Farah Khan
videos.overview: Farah Khan Opens Up on Tees Maar Khan, Marriage, Motherhood, Bollywood & Her Incredible Journey. One of Bollywood's most loved filmmakers, choreographers, and entertainers, Farah Khan joins Shekhar Suman. In this candid episode, Farah Khan shares stories from her extraordinary career, opens up about the highs and lows of Bollywood, reflects on the criticism surrounding Tees Maar Khan, talks about marriage, motherhood, success, failure, and how she reinvented herself in the digital age. Known for her wit and infectious sense of humor, Farah also shares hilarious behind-the-scenes moments, personal anecdotes, and life lessons that make this conversation both inspiring and entertaining. From laughter to heartfelt reflections, this episode has something for every Bollywood fan.

videos.title: Prajakta Koli
videos.overview: Prajakta Koli (MostlySane) joins Shekhar Suman on Shekhar Tonite for one of the most honest and heartfelt conversations yet. From getting rejected at her very first radio internship to becoming the only Indian on the TIME100 Creator list — Prajakta's journey is nothing short of extraordinary. In this full episode, Prajakta Koli talks candidly about building MostlySane from the ground up, the pressure of being a full-time content creator, her popular role as Dimple in Mismatched (Netflix), her debut novel Too Good To Be True, life after marriage, and what she will never trade for fame. She also shares a deeply personal and moving tribute in the confession room that you won't forget.

videos.title: Sunidhi Chauhan
videos.overview: This week on Shekhar Tonite, Shekhar Suman welcomes one of India's most iconic and celebrated voices—Sunidhi Chauhan. From her extraordinary musical journey to behind-the-scenes stories, unforgettable performances, career milestones, and candid conversations, this episode is a heartfelt celebration of a voice that has defined generations. Known for her versatility, passion, and unmatched stage presence, Sunidhi opens up like never before in an engaging conversation with Shekhar Suman. Expect laughter, nostalgia, inspiration, music, and plenty of memorable moments.

videos.title: Badhshah
videos.overview: In this episode, Shekhar Suman sits down with one of India's biggest music icons, #Badshah  for an honest and engaging conversation. From his journey in the music industry and the stories behind his biggest hits to fame, success, challenges, creativity, and life beyond the spotlight, Badshah opens up like never before.

videos.title: Pankaj Tripathi
videos.overview: In this episode, Shekhar Suman engages the acclaimed performer in an engaging and hilarious discussion about his journey from theatre to becoming a Bollywood icon. From his breakthrough roles in Gangs of Wasseypur to his stellar performances across films and web series, Pankaj Tripathi opens up about the craft of acting, career challenges, and the moments that shaped his incredible trajectory. Expect witty banter, surprising revelations, and Shekhar's signature satirical humor as two brilliant minds discuss cinema and storytelling.

videos.title: Shashwat Sachdev
videos.overview: The genius behind the music of Uri: The Surgical Strike and blockbuster franchise Dhurandhar, composer Shashwat Sachdev, joins Shekhar Suman for a deeply moving and inspiring conversation. He talks about training under his guru Ustad Ramzan Khan, the incredible sacrifices made by his parents, his sister (who gave up her own singing career for him), and his wife after their move to Mumbai in 2017 — and opens up about the journey behind some of Bollywood's biggest soundtracks. Before the interview, Shekhar Suman opens the show with his sharpest satire yet — taking aim at the Delhi student protests, Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation, and the government's viral reel culture. A perfect blend of biting political comedy and heartfelt musical conversation, only on Shekhar Tonite!

videos.title: Vikas Khanna
videos.overview: World-renowned chef, restaurateur, and MasterChef India judge Vikas Khanna joins Shekhar Suman for one of the most emotional conversations of the season. From being told as a child he'd never walk, to his mother's unwavering belief that he was "born to fly," Vikas opens up about the journey that shaped his life. He shares the heartbreaking story behind his acclaimed New York restaurant Bungalow — built as a promise to his late sister, and the first restaurant in a century to receive 3 Michelin  stars from The New York Times. He also talks about cooking for global icons like Barack Obama, PM Modi, the Dalai Lama, and the Pope, and reflects on resilience, identity, and what it truly means to build a home, not just a restaurant.

videos.title: Vikrant Massey
videos.overview: National Award-winning actor Vikrant Massey joins Shekhar Suman for a deeply candid and emotional conversation. He shares the touching story behind his name - inspired by INS Vikrant - his humble middle-class upbringing, and the humiliation he faced after being fired on his very first television shoot. Vikrant opens up about his hard-fought journey from TV to films, his National Award-winning performance in 12th Fail, and the real reason behind his much-talked-about "break" from the industry - choosing to spend time with his newborn son and ailing father over the demands of newfound fame.

videos.title: Vir Das
videos.overview: International Emmy Award-winning comedian, actor, and writer ‪@virdas‬  joins Shekhar Suman for a raw, honest, and thought-provoking conversation. He breaks his silence on the backlash following his viral "Two Indias" speech, opens up about the FIRs and legal battles that comedy has brought him, and shares his unfiltered philosophy that "controversy should not become your content." Vir also reflects on his journey from getting bullied in boarding school to becoming the first Indian to win an International Emmy, his humble beginnings on The Great Indian Comedy Show, his love for dogs, and why he believes comedy - not acting - gives him complete creative freedom.

videos.title: Amish Tripathi
videos.overview: What happens when India's ancient stories meet a modern storyteller? This week on Shekhar Tonite, Shekhar Suman sits down with bestselling author and storyteller Amish Tripathi for a fascinating conversation about Lord Shiva, Indian mythology, faith, writing, philosophy, and the stories that have shaped India. Amish opens up about his journey from being an atheist to finding faith, the inspiration behind The Shiva Trilogy, and how writing The Immortals of Meluha changed his life. A candid, thought-provoking conversation between Shekhar Suman and Amish Tripathi that explores faith, philosophy, literature and the timeless power of Indian stories.

videos.title: Nawazuddin Siddiqui
videos.overview: One of Indian cinema's most acclaimed and versatile actors, Nawazuddin Siddiqui, joins UNI Cards Presents Shekhar Suman for a raw, inspiring, and deeply honest conversation on Shekhar Tonite. He recalls the sheer self-belief that carried him through a mere 40-second role in Sarfarosh, opens up about years of struggle and self-doubt after being told he "wasn't good looking," and shares the pivotal moment director Anurag Kashyap told him, "I want Nawaz, not Al Pacino" — reshaping his approach to acting forever. From iconic roles like Faisal Khan and Dashrath Manjhi to performing alongside his daughter, Nawazuddin reflects on craft, failure, and what real success means.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Love Under Construction
_verifiedMetadata.description: Vinod is ready to build his dream house. But is he ready to face the hurdles in his path?

videos.title: Foundation of Love
videos.overview: Pappan oversees the work of Vinod's new home in Kerala. In Dubai, Vinod, who is building this home for his eager parents, meets Gouri. But a job loss throws his future into turmoil.

videos.title: Building Bridges
videos.overview: Gouri pushes for marriage and a move to Canada. With no job, a half-built house, a mounting debt, and disapproving families, what will Vinod do?

videos.title: Reinforced Romance
videos.overview: Vinod and Pappan try to fast-track the marriage registration, but a vindictive officer refuses to help them. As Vinod struggles with money, he gets shocking news.

videos.title: Bricks and Hearts
videos.overview: Vinod is hit with fraud, the secret about the wall collapse and more money struggles. As Gouri's father tightens control, her mother accuses their maid of theft.

videos.title: Sealing the Cracks
videos.overview: Vinod returns the pawned jewellery but gets into a fight with Gouri's dad. When rumours start flying linking Pappan and Gouri, Vinod and Gouri realise they have no time to lose.

videos.title: The Final Coat
videos.overview: While Gouri faces her angry father, Vinod challenges the overseer. At the registration office, Gouri finally loses her patience and temper when Vinod arrives really late.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Office
_verifiedMetadata.description: Two types of work ethics clash when analogue meets digital in a rural government workplace, propelling the mundane to hilarious.

videos.title: New Arrival
videos.overview: Villagers protest at the Tahsildar Office for a 'just' cause. While the office staff prepares to welcome the Collector, a person arrives in a government-issued beacon car.

videos.title: Mistaken Identity
videos.overview: Paari gets baffled over the VIP treatment given by the government staff. Just when he realises the misunderstanding and is about to resolve it, he sees Indu, an old acquaintance.

videos.title: Burst Bubble
videos.overview: Paari's ruse gets exposed when Raghavan arrives. As the government staff lashes out at the IT team, the villagers' protest intensifies.

videos.title: Another Argument
videos.overview: Paari learns about the government staffers from his colleagues. Napoleon refuses to give the IT team access to confidential files. Paari and Indu get into another argument.

videos.title: Village Trouble
videos.overview: Napoleon assigns a menial job to the IT team. Indu is reminded of their first meeting when Paari gets a fish tank in the office. Murthy and Prakash struggle to deal with the villagers.

videos.title: House Hunting
videos.overview: Sani offers to help Paari find a house in the village, but the villagers refuse to rent out their place to him. Sharmi's food vlog ends up in a funny misunderstanding.

videos.title: Sleep Ritual
videos.overview: Indu loses her cool with her mom. Napoleon berates Paari for disturbing his sleep ritual. Raghavan asks Napoleon to let the IT team start their work. Paari finally finds a roommate.

videos.title: Father's Fury
videos.overview: Paari's disinterest in attending the UPSC interview makes his father furious. Sharmi's vlog in the office goes viral for the wrong reasons.

videos.title: Interview Call
videos.overview: Indu gets excited as she gets an interview call, but Paari mocks her. Mani feels overwhelmed when Raghavan signs a blank cheque to help Janu. The IT team complains about Napoleon.

videos.title: A New Enemy
videos.overview: Indu gets furious when she finds her missing book in Paari's bag. While Napoleon creates a ruckus about the files in the record room, Paari catches Hari taking a bribe.

videos.title: The Missing Wig
videos.overview: Paari gets berated by Raghavan when Hari frames him. Raghavan panics as his wig goes missing. Indu assumes Paari hid the wig.

videos.title: Matchmaking
videos.overview: Jambulingam fails to recognise Raghavan without his hair. Indu panics when she receives a call from home. Paari gets upset when he learns about a marriage proposal for Indu.

videos.title: Unwanted Guest
videos.overview: Paari joins Raghavan and Hari to inspect government lands in the village. An old lady arrives in the office to ask about her pension. She slips, falls and doesn't wake up.

videos.title: Hit and Miss
videos.overview: Paari suspects Hari's involvement in the encroached lands, but a mishap with Raghavan stops the inspection. The old lady's daughter-in-law comes to the office searching for her.

videos.title: Action, Reaction
videos.overview: Paari and Sani beat up Hari for misbehaving with Sharmi. Paari helps Indu's mother when she faints in the market. An error in a slogan creates chaos.

videos.title: The Start of Love
videos.overview: Indu gets irritated when her mother praises Paari. A sarcastic retort by Paari causes a misunderstanding among the villagers.

videos.title: Escalation
videos.overview: Paari's friends make fun of his weird behaviour towards Indu. Frustrated by the lack of work, Sharmi decides to resign, angering Paari who confronts Napoleon.

videos.title: Party Planning
videos.overview: Paari complains to his brother-in-law about not getting access to files. Prakash and Moorthy lie to convince Indu to attend Sharmi's farewell party and choose a frightening venue.

videos.title: Haunted Party
videos.overview: Indu gets irked to see Paari at the party, but the others convince her to stay. The guys keep sneaking away to drink secretly. What happens when Paari plays a prank on Indu?

videos.title: Resolution
videos.overview: The locals complain to Napoleon about the staff's partying on a disputed land. Raghavan gets an earful from the Collector for the IT team's stalled digitalisation work.

videos.title: Lease, Lies and Lost Goats
videos.overview: The news of lease expiration and relocation creates an uproar in the office. Prakash falls for a village girl who has lost her goat. Hari plots to stop digitisation.

videos.title: A Missing Goat and Hidden Truths
videos.overview: As Veni searches for her missing goat, tension brews in the office over a potential scam. While Napolean grows paranoid about a conspiracy, will the team uncover the truth in time?

videos.title: Truths Unravel and New Dilemmas
videos.overview: Paari and Murthy suspect a scam, but Napolean shuts them down. Indu's accident leads to an unexpected moment with Paari. Jambulingam faces trouble over missing land documents.

videos.title: Buried Truths and Broken Ties
videos.overview: Indu worries about her family pressuring her to marry. As Paari's missing file causes chaos at work, his past with Indu resurfaces, exposing old wounds.

videos.title: Who Took It?
videos.overview: When a vital file goes missing, Indu uncovers a shocking truth. Frantic to cover his tracks, Hari appoints a former thief for a secret mission.

videos.title: Echoes of Theft
videos.overview: While Indu faces pressure to marry, Jambulingam tries to hide his land troubles. Chaos erupts when computers and a gun go missing.

videos.title: A Risky Retrieval
videos.overview: With jobs at stake, the team plots to retrieve the gun and computers. Indu sneaks out in th dead of the night, unaware of the incoming danger.

videos.title: The Uninvited Guests
videos.overview: The IT team sneaks into the bungalow, tunknowingly crossing paths with two groups of thieves. Indu feels uncomfortable when Sathyan arrives in the office the next morning.

videos.title: Bro Code Broken
videos.overview: While Indu tries to evade her marriage, a drunk Paari visits her at night. Prakash informs Sathyan about Paari and Indu's friendship. What happens when Sathyan seeks Paari's help?

videos.title: Staged and Confused
videos.overview: Paari plays mind games with Sathyan, making Indu angry. With a fake proposal, a scam and the entry of a fierce lady cop, chaos brews around the office.

videos.title: Wrong Switch
videos.overview: Indu battles entitled relatives who misuse government schemes. Paari grapples with corruption, moral dilemmas and a humbling lesson about who truly merits help.

videos.title: Shortcut Denied
videos.overview: When Indu learns that her dream job was offered to her through backdoor dealings, she erupts, setting off a domino of confrontations.

videos.title: Between the Lines
videos.overview: A kabaddi mishap sparks an unexpected bond. While Sani's bold action angers Sharmi Prakash's weird antics rattle the office. The announcement of Indu's engagement shocks everyone.

videos.title: The Stamp of Truth
videos.overview: Veni's intimidating brother scares Prakash. While indu suffers silently, Sathyan gets a surprise from a drunken Paari. Sani's distress deepens after Sharmi rebukes him.

videos.title: The Moment of Truth
videos.overview: Paari challenges Indu's engagement, and tensions rise between heart and tradition. When Indu finally looks her uncle in the eye, silence speaks louder than words.

videos.title: Unravelled
videos.overview: Indu uncle's decision about the engagement shocks the family. Caught between gratitude and guilt, Indu gets advice from Raghavan. What is his motive?

videos.title: The Lone Stand
videos.overview: As Hari tightens his web of influence, Paari dares to defy him. Indu's quiet gestures hint at a change of heart, and Janaki's misunderstanding leads to embarrassment.

videos.title: Brake Point
videos.overview: As Paari stages a clever prank to win Indu's smile on her birthday, a hidden enemy plots a deadly move with the brakes. Emotions stir between old flames and failed engagements.

videos.title: Sympathy Syndrome
videos.overview: After surviving an accident, Paari fakes an injury to win Indu's affection. Meanwhile, a serious government audit looms over the team.

videos.title: A Clean Sweep
videos.overview: A surprise inspection throws the entire office into a tizzy. As the IT team comes under the microscope, Paari begins to suspect a deeper conspiracy.

videos.title: Trial and Error
videos.overview: Fired and desperate, the IT team pulls off an office heist, a fake divine sign, and a temple possession stunt to win back their jobs. What happens when their "miracle" goes awry?

videos.title: Served Cold
videos.overview: Raghavan's fury leaves the IT team in despair. Indu's plea to her famous uncle, Jeyaraj, sparks a tense meeting. While the team's fate is unknown, Indu and Paari have a fallout.

videos.title: Unspoken Farewells
videos.overview: As the team prepares to leave the village, Prakash, Sani and Paari try to tie up loose ends. But the weight of unspoken words and broken bonds leave them far from closure.

videos.title: The Spark Before the Storm
videos.overview: A goldfish leads Paari back to the office, where a shocking discovery exposes deep-rooted corruption. He tries to gather proof, but a desperate act threatens to erase everything.

videos.title: Burning Secrets
videos.overview: Raghavan files a police complaint against Paari for the fire at the office, and Napolean escalates it to the Collector's office. Will Paari become a victim of a deeper conspiracy?

videos.title: Unexpected Returns
videos.overview: Guru's intervention saves Paari, but Hari conspires with Jeyaraj. Jaanu's unexpected return scares the office staff. Can they get rid of Jaanu before she uncovers their secret?

videos.title: The New IT Team
videos.overview: When Sathyan arrives with a replacement IT team, arch-rivals Napolean and Paari are forced to team up - one to protect the office secret and the other to win back Indu's heart.

videos.title: A Missed Confession
videos.overview: After Paari is humiliated, the old IT team reunites to drive Sathyan out. As Indu decides to confess her love for Paari, he discovers a crucial lead about Hari's mysterious boss.

videos.title: The Assistant Officers!
videos.overview: Jeyaraj warns Paari to stay low, raising doubts. As playful office antics spiral into petty revenge and hidden agendas, a photo threatens to unveil secrets better left buried.

videos.title: Petty Revenge
videos.overview: As Jeyaraj balances belief and doubt, Indu fights for Paari’s attention. Raghavan helps Janaki from societal injustice. The office staff panics when Prakash goes missing.

videos.title: A Forced Marriage
videos.overview: When Veni's brother compels Prakash to marry her, Murthy disowns him. With the newlyweds feeling lost and the office in chaos, can Indu and Paari manage to change Murthy's mind?

videos.title: Just Friends?
videos.overview: Old feelings unfold, and new misconceptions take root as Paari’s mother visits his office. When Jeyaraj learns her truth, Indu is forced to choose between her heart and loyalty.

videos.title: Split Screens
videos.overview: Indu draws a line with Paari after his pranks go too far. While Raghavan is impressed by Jaanu's charm, Prakash and Veni take over Murthy's home and wallet.

videos.title: Misguided Missions
videos.overview: Jaanu likes Raghavan's new wig. Paari and Indu's road trip planned through deception, spirals into a public humiliation that shakes their fragile relationship.

videos.title: Blessings and Blunders
videos.overview: Paari draws a line with Indu after a rift. Veni's food cart brings hope and trouble. Raghavan takes Jaanu to the temple, but fate strips him of more than just his inhibitions.

videos.title: Things We Hide
videos.overview: Raghavan's wig mishap shatters him until Jaanu confides her problem to him. Paari retrieves Indu's stolen handbag, but his hopes are crushed when she asks for the unthinkable.

videos.title: Moves and Motives
videos.overview: Paari pretends to move on from Indu, while Raghavan sheds his inhibitions for love. Jeyaraj cautiously returns to the game just as a high-profile inspection looms over the office.

videos.title: Rejections and Recreations
videos.overview: Indu and Paari are teamed up as the office races to recreate the missing Patta documents before the Collector’s visit. Raghavan gets humiliated by Jaanu's judgemental parents.

videos.title: Signed and Sealed
videos.overview: Before the Collector's visit, an oversight by Indu threatens to expose their forgery operation. Paari takes a risky step, but his affinity with Indu goes through an emotional hit.

videos.title: Warmed Hearts, Cold Truths
videos.overview: Paari struggles to comprehend the deep reverence Indu holds for her uncle, Jeyaraj. His accidental discovery of a forged file threatens to expose a powerful man’s secrets.

videos.title: Operation Impress
videos.overview: Paari tries to impress Jeyaraj with food and books. Raghavan's mother meets Jaanu at the office. A public health project forces Paari and Jeyaraj into an unexpected alliance.

videos.title: Ground Realities
videos.overview: Jeyaraj's resistance threatens to ruin Paari and Indu's efforts with a health scheme. While Murthy is hurt when Napolean ignores a personal crisis, a property file sparks suspicion.

videos.title: The Cost of Truth
videos.overview: Paari unknowingly triggers a storm, unraveling Jeyaraj's carefully staged negotiation. A sickle-wielding saviour gets a desperate Murthy his leave.

videos.title: Framed!
videos.overview: Paari's bold revelation earns Jeyaraj respect from the villagers. A shocking twist exposing a hidden betrayal threatens to destroy everything Paari believes in.

videos.title: Truth or Trap
videos.overview: Paari uncovers shocking evidence pointing to Raghavan's corruption. While Jeyaraj plots to frame Raghavan, Paari is caught between exposing the truth and earning Jeyaraj's trust.

videos.title: Inside Job
videos.overview: While Paari works on a fake design at Jeyaraj's house, Sani tries to sneak out a file at the office. Paari suspects foul play when Dhamodharan secures a key government tender.

videos.title: Decorations and Doubts
videos.overview: The office celebrates Raghavan and Jaanu's surprise engagement announcement. Paari's secret probe uncovers proof of Raghavan's corruption, but a saint's warning could alter things.

videos.title: Tough Choice
videos.overview: As Raghavan gets engaged, Paari, struggling between love and justice, decides against exposing the truth for Indu's sake. But a dramatic showdown leaves the village in shock.

videos.title: Faith on Trial
videos.overview: Raghavan faces an inquiry over bribery charges. While evidence mounts, Paari is dazed by the unwavering faith of Raghavan’s mother and the speechless dignity of the accused himself.

videos.title: False Light
videos.overview: Tensed for having ruined an innocent man, Paari digs for the truth - only to find that he has been a pawn in a deeper game. His confession leaves Indu shattered and Raghavan enraged.

videos.title: Cracks and Clues
videos.overview: Indu wrestles with her heartbreak and distrust. As Napolean tightens his grip on the IT team, Paari takes the risk to get closer to exposing a deeper conspiracy.

videos.title: Blind Spots
videos.overview: As Raghavan drowns in betrayal and self-doubt, Paari tries to make him see the reality. A court notice arrives that could seal Raghavan’s fate unless the real mastermind is exposed.

videos.title: The Great Pretender
videos.overview: Paari convinces Raghavan to fake corruption in a frantic bid to access Dhamodharan's testimony and reclaim justice. Jaanu too plays her part as Raghavan stages his downfall.

videos.title: Confessions and Consequences
videos.overview: Paari and Indu's secret romance is finally out. A carefully orchestrated sting operation backfires when Hari flips the script, turning Raghavan's trap into his own public undoing.

videos.title: Echoes of a Prophecy
videos.overview: As Hari vanishes with the incriminating evidence, Paari, Indu and Raghavan are shaken as careers, trust and love are all on the line. Jaanu risks everything to defend Raghavan.

videos.title: Destiny's Detour
videos.overview: During Raghavan's inquiry, shocking revelations and personal ties surface at the Collector's office as an unexpected ally from his past rises to his defence. Will justice find its way?

videos.title: The Return and The Reckoning
videos.overview: Raghavan reclaims his position as the Tahsildar, shaking up the corrupt office. As tension rises, Hari goes missing. When things seem to calm, a knock at the door alters everything.

videos.title: The Hidden Guest
videos.overview: Indu and Paari's affinity finally comes to light, and it is celebration time. With secrets tightening around Jeyaraj, one error could unravel everything he is plotting to protect.

videos.title: Festive Fallout
videos.overview: As love and joy bloom with Indu's surprise morning lesson and Veni's festive Thaali ceremony, a hidden power move imperils the village's peace. Raghavan brings devastating news.

videos.title: Deadline Drama
videos.overview: News breaks that the office will shut down, and Paari plans to rally the villagers and impress the visiting Collector. However, an unexpected twist threatens to unravel everything.

videos.title: One Month to Go
videos.overview: In the last month of the office, Raghavan encourages each staffer to rise beyond their comfort zone. Indu faces resistance in office as she readies for a life-changing interview.

videos.title: The Shortcut and the Long Road
videos.overview: Paari races against time to sneak Indu into a surprise interview under Napoleon's watchful eyes. While Indu nails her shot, Paari faces a bitter truth about confronting his family.

videos.title: Civil Lies
videos.overview: Indu and Paari face Chezhiyan’s huge pride in government service. Prakash’s relentless study stuns Veni and his friends. An unexpected encounter at the bus stand sparks a new tension.

videos.title: Checkmate
videos.overview: Paari outwits Hari with a trap and closes in on the truth. A frantic call leads to shocking revelations. As loyalty is tested, a name is finally to be exposed, changing equations.

videos.title: The First Invitation
videos.overview: As police arrives at Jeyaraj’s door, secrets are unraveled. Indu faces the burden of hiding her career change from the one man who idolises her government status - Paari’s father.

videos.title: Cover-Up
videos.overview: Indu’s family tries to hide her IT aspirations from Chezhiyan. However, a confession and a kitchen eavesdrop unravel it all, leaving the future of the wedding hanging in balance.

videos.title: Between Pride and Apology
videos.overview: Indu’s hidden career choice shocks everyone. When Chezhiyan pays a surprise visit, apologies are made, and lessons are learnt. But unresolved tensions linger between him and Paari.

videos.title: Shadows at the Altar
videos.overview: At Raghavan’s wedding, tension arises as Paari and Chezhiyan’s strained father-son relationship plays out amid festivities. Unexpected guests threaten to disrupt the celebration.

videos.title: The Price of Blood
videos.overview: An accident at the venue throws everyone's lives into turmoil. Jeyaraj is forced to confront his past mistakes. Paari risks everything to save the person he once failed to protect.

videos.title: Hope Served Hot
videos.overview: Indu and Paari's attempts to lift a heartbroken Muthu’s spirits backfire hilariously. An unexpected confession from the ever-shy Chetta reveals a love that’s been simmering quietly.

videos.title: Silence of the Scold
videos.overview: Indu finally stands up to Napolean’s harshness. The team uncovers the silent sacrifices of the man they thought was their tormentor and give him the farewell he truly deserves.

videos.title: The Letter
videos.overview: A cheerful bachelor party at Jeyaraj’s farmhouse turns into a night of confessions and revelations. Paari stumbles upon a letter from his past, one that could change equations.

videos.title: A Friend in the Frame
videos.overview: Paari’s suspicions about Jeyaraj deepen after seeing a photo in Kumaresan’s home, triggering an investigation. Indu begins to connect the dots, uncovering secrets too risky to chase.

videos.title: Exit Protocol
videos.overview: As the digitisation project ends, heartfelt goodbyes, bold decisions, and budding romances fill the air. Paari is set to leave, but a startling revelation about Jeyaraj stops him.

videos.title: Locked Truth
videos.overview: Sangu seeks forgiveness from Prakash. Paari cleverly manipulates a family visit to infiltrate Jeyaraj’s guarded office and uncovers a game-changing secret, right under his nose.

videos.title: Fallen Mask
videos.overview: As Paari digs deeper into the land scam, powerful forces begin to close in. With secrets unraveling and loyalties tested, a tense encounter forces everyone to show their true faces.

videos.title: Burned Bridges
videos.overview: Paari must choose between exposing a vicious land scam or let a guilty Jeyaraj atone privately by sacrificing everything. Indu grapples between justice and protecting her family.

videos.title: Curtain Call
videos.overview: On the last day, the staff faces a moral dilemma when Jambulingam, the person behind the closure, asks for help before the doors shut for good. Will they choose duty over resentment?

videos.title: Judas Kiss
videos.overview: Paari confronts betrayal from someone closest to him. He learns the full extent of a land scam and faces a heartbreaking confession that challenges his trust and shakes his future.

videos.title: Red Wedding
videos.overview: A deeply personal revelation shakes Indu and Paari’s world, testing their trust and forcing them to face difficult choices that will change their lives forever.

_verifiedMetadata.name: The Mystery of Moksha Island
_verifiedMetadata.description: A lavish inheritance and a pharma empire lure a dead scientist's relatives to a remote island. The excitement turns into horror when they realise it's a trap.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Vimal Khanna
_verifiedMetadata.description: An accountant accused of killing his brother flees, assumes the identity Vimal Khanna, and faces blackmail while seeking his vanished wife. Survival and accidental heroism drive noir-style rescues and moral choices.

videos.title: Kismat Ka Khel
videos.overview: Vimal Khanna, a ragpicker, is hired by Amrita Das after he bravely saves the life of her husband. Vimal accepts the offer and enters the villa, using it as a refuge to escape and hide from his past.

videos.title: Kastaa Shikanjaa
videos.overview: Vimal is attacked by a burglar and realizes he is in danger. He had come to the villa seeking refuge, but now finds himself trapped within it. To make matters worse, Inspector Jyoti arrives in the city, in search of him.

videos.title: Kuch Raaz
videos.overview: Vimal decides to stay on in the villa, determined to dig into the hidden secrets of every member of the Dass family.

videos.title: Chakravyuh
videos.overview: Vimal begins involving himself in every matter of the house, trying to uncover the conspiracy surrounding Nishant Dass’s accident and the complex, unusual dynamic between Nishant and Amrita an odd couple.

videos.title: Aur Phir Achanak
videos.overview: As Vimal and Amrita grow closer, their connection crosses into an intimate space. But in the aftermath, Vimal is forced to confront the reality of their situation he is Nishant’s caretaker, and Amrita is his employer.

videos.title: Bhoot Aur Vartmaan
videos.overview: Amrita reveals she knows Vimal is a murder convict of his brother, Vimal is haunted by his past, Shalini, betrayed him a turning point that led to the unraveling of his life. He is now on a relentless search for her, desperate to understand why she did it.

videos.title: Makadjaal
videos.overview: Amrita delivers a final checkmate to Vimal, leaving him stunned. She reveals that she was never truly Amrita she was once Sheetal, an innocent woman, until society shaped and hardened her into the person she has become.

videos.title: Shikar Ya Shikari
videos.overview: Amrita sets her plan to kill Nishant, But the stakes rise when Nishant’s daughter, Arushi, becomes part of the plan. Just as the final move is about to be made, everything collapsed Inspector Jyoti storms in and arrests Vimal.

videos.title: Maut Ka Khel
videos.overview: In the end, Vimal emerges victorious, reversing every move Amrita had set in motion. He saves Nishant and Arushi, while Amrita is left to face the consequences of her sins. Yet, even as the dust settles, one question remains—will Vimal ever find Shalini?

_verifiedMetadata.name: 1000 Babies
_verifiedMetadata.description: Enter a cradle of mysteries where a man with a dark past manipulates multiple lives through a series of cryptic letters and deadly games.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Parachute
_verifiedMetadata.description: Shanmugam does not spare the rod and spoil his children. But despite his strict nature, they go on a joyride on his bike and get lost. What will he do now?

videos.title: A Mother's Nightmare
videos.overview: Lakshmi goes to the police station to file a missing complaint about her children, Varun and Rudra. Where are they? How did they go missing?

videos.title: Love for Parachute
videos.overview: Varun plans a birthday surprise for his sister, Rudra, and it involves Parachute, their father's bike.

videos.title: Bikes and Bandits
videos.overview: Varun and Rudra desperately try to get their Parachute back, but an unforeseen incident occurs, which makes things worse.

videos.title: Kids in Danger
videos.overview: Kiruba and his team get the location of the stolen bike. He, along with Lakshmi, Shanmugam and Charles, race against time to save the children.

videos.title: Love Over Fear
videos.overview: Varun and Rudra get caught up in the middle of a riot. Will the kids get their Parachute back? Will Shanmugam and Lakshmi get to them before it's too late?

_verifiedMetadata.language: Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Bengali

_verifiedMetadata.name: Bench Life
_verifiedMetadata.description: Balu, Ravi and Meenakshi, three employees at an IT company, are desperate to be 'benched', each for their own personal reasons. However, when confronted by their flaws, can each of them learn to overcome their issues and grow? 'Bench Life' stars Dr. Rajendra Prasad, Vaibhav, Charan Peri, Ritika Singh, Aakanksha Singh, Nayan Sarika, Venkatesh Kakumanu and Tanikella Bharani.

videos.title: Code Error
videos.overview: Balu, Meenakshi and Ravi have grand plans on how to utilize their time on the bench. But fate has something else in store.

videos.title: Firewall
videos.overview: Prasad, an ex-IAS officer, joins the company. Does he have an ulterior motive?

videos.title: Debugging
videos.overview: Balu needs Prasad’s help to get the bench. Meanwhile, Meenakshi struggles to make a demo film, while Ravi plans for the Goa trip. Will they succeed?

videos.title: Testing

With Minister Bapat plotting a state-level intervention, greed and ambition begin to corrupt Brij's empire from within.

Inspector Eknath begins to question his faith in the system as Matka spills into the homes, careers, and consciences of every citizen in Bombay.
