_verifiedMetadata.description: Cleanliness is her obsession. But what happens when this fetish leads to a highly qualified professional getting mistaken for a housemaid?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Sangamarmar
_verifiedMetadata.description: Amrita sacrifices her budding romance with Aditya to fulfill family responsibilities. Their tender love endures through years of separation, becoming a poignant tale of sacrifice, silent strength, and unchanging devotion.

videos.title: Humari Shaadi Nahi Hui
videos.overview: Aditya and Amrita's love blooms amidst disapproving looks. 25 years later, Amrita is at the peak of her career and Aditya is her biggest support.

videos.title: Jo Raah Tune Chuni
videos.overview: Amrita worries about how Vasudha would react, but the mother surprises her daughter. Problems brew around Neeraj's dream project and with Vasudha's health.

videos.title: Maiyya ki Odhaniya
videos.overview: Vasudha's death shatters the family. Being the eldest, everyone expects Amrita to step up, but she feels lost.

videos.title: Yeh Din Bhi Dhal Jaayenge
videos.overview: Amrita loses herself in added responsibilities, but Aditya tries to cheer her up. Meanwhile, Neeraj's problems at work spill over onto his home life, alarming Amrita.

videos.title: We Need You, Papa
videos.overview: Amrita confronts her father again, but he still struggles by himself. Finally, Aditya and Amrita convince Neeraj to go for therapy.

videos.title: Beti Hokar...
videos.overview: Amrita's memories of her father are tainted by his death. Neeraj's last words to the world make her feel hurt and betrayed.

videos.title: Reham
videos.overview: Amrita tries to hide the tragic news of their father's death from her siblings. But what happens when Abhinav and Preeti go missing from school?

videos.title: Maan-Swabhimaan
videos.overview: Amrita's uncle Naveen is arrested for a cheque bounce case. When she tries to free him, she discovers the overwhelming debt of the company. Finally, Aditya provides a solution.

videos.title: Seekh Jaaungi!
videos.overview: Amrita decides to fight her battle alone. In a meeting with the lenders, she declares that she would take over her dad's business and gets seven days to submit the project report.

videos.title: Jahan Kheli Gudiya Khilaune
videos.overview: Aditya inspires a worried Amrita through a bike ride. Shock awaits Amrita as court orders her to vacate the house in two days, and the relatives decide to separate the siblings.

videos.title: Uss Raah Par Badhte Jana Hai
videos.overview: Fearing separation, the siblings flee to Adi's house. Amrita learns Abhinav is job hunting, and moved by his resolve, she decides to seek work from Makrand Aagrwal herself.

videos.title: Kaise Nibhau (Piya) Pyaar Tera
videos.overview: Amrita gets a job and finds a house for rent. After relatives scorn her relationship with Aditya, Amrita asks him to stay away. Later, she and her siblings vacate their house.

videos.title: Yeh Raah Nahi Asaan
videos.overview: Amrita, with her siblings, shifts to Raja ki Mandi. But, the kids are unable to adjust to the surroundings. Shock awaits Amrita when Aditya goes missing.

videos.title: Shaadi Kar Lete Hain
videos.overview: After Amrita finds Aditya, he proposes marriage to her. Amrita gets late on her first day at work. She is shocked when Aditya’s mother shares an alternate arrangement with her.

videos.title: Adjustment Ya Compromise
videos.overview: Nisha convinces Amrita to accept the marriage arrangement. Aditya helps Amrita solve her office issue. Later, Amrita accepts Aditya’s wedding proposal.

videos.title: Ek Vichitra Shaadi
videos.overview: Adi dreams of a future with Amrita, while Nirmala fears society will label her son a live-in son-in-law. Elsewhere, Amrita struggles to balance work and time with Adi's family.

videos.title: Kashmakash
videos.overview: Amrita misses the family dinner due to work-life balance struggles. Nirmala is upset, but Adi patiently waits for her to return so they can eat together.

videos.title: Laate Ho Pyaar Kahan Se
videos.overview: Upset with Aditya, Nirmala distances herself from the wedding preparations. Amrita realises that she is the reason for the growing rift between Aditya and his family.

videos.title: Azaad Kar Diya...!
videos.overview: Aditya feels guilty to see his mother upset. Amrita is shattered when, after business meeting, the lenders decide to sell her dad's company. Amrita’s call leaves Nirmala in shock

videos.title: Shart
videos.overview: When Amrita's loan is denied, she deliberately ends her marriage with Adi. Despite his efforts to mend things, she insults his mother, pushing Adi to lose his temper and walk away.

videos.title: Consultation Fees
videos.overview: Upon discovering that Adi covered for Abhinav at the health camp, Amrita compensates him, turning payment into an insult. Later, Neeta brings a proposal for Adi, which he accepts.

videos.title: Shuruat
videos.overview: Amrita and Aditya try to move on in life. At work, Amrita impresses Makrand. Amrita coincidentally bumps into Shraddha and learns that she is meeting Aditya for a future alliance.

videos.title: Tu Door Nazar Aaye
videos.overview: Aditya confesses his love for Amrita to Shraddha. Nisha wants Amrita to wish Aditya on his birthday. But, when Amrita sees Aditya with Shraddha, she decides to step back.

videos.title: Happy Birthday
videos.overview: Aditya is hurt that Amrita didn’t wish him on his birthday. He challenges her to attend his birthday dinner with Shraddha. Later, Shraddha is convinced that Amrita has moved on.

videos.title: Chot
videos.overview: Aditya’s family is happy as Shraddha says yes. Makrand suggests Amrita wear a gold ring for luck. Seeing Aditya’s concern for Amrita, Shraddha releases that he has not moved on.

videos.title: Bharat Ki Beti
videos.overview: Shraddha confronts Adi and Amrita while Adi promises to forget Amrita and move on. Makrand supports Amrita, and she gains approval to restart her late father’s project.

videos.title: Khoya-Paya
videos.overview: Amrita begins the project with a ritual, unaware of the site manager and union leader's sinister plan. Meanwhile, Adi apologises to Shraddha for being distracted all the time.

videos.title: Akeli Hoon, Kamzor Nahi
videos.overview: Amrita cleverly outwits the union leader by distributing individual cheques. He attempts to assault Amrita, resulting in Adi getting hurt while trying to save her from the attack.

videos.title: Kasak
videos.overview: Shraddha's father learns of Adi's past in the hospital and wants to cancel the wedding. Adi insists the engagement proceeds, and Amrita accidentally reaches the engagement venue.

videos.title: Faisla
videos.overview: Amrita's attendance at her cousin's engagement ends in humiliation. Shraddha confronts Adi just before their engagement when his injury flares up.

videos.title: Woh Wali Train
videos.overview: Amrita deliberately pushes Adi away. A disheartened Adi lands up on a train where a miracle happens.

videos.title: Harzana
videos.overview: Shraddha's father demands compensation, which leads to a conflict within the Dixit family. However, Nirmala puts her foot down.

videos.title: Yaar Hai Uska
videos.overview: Adi offers to tutor Amrita's siblings. At work, Amrita feels something is amiss in Makrand's life. Prashant enters Amrita's life.

videos.title: Friend ya Boyfriend
videos.overview: Amrita meets investors for a possible joint venture. Although Prashant helps her, he starts instigating Abhinav against Adi.

videos.title: Jaanane Laga Hoon
videos.overview: Adi and Amrita's closeness infuriates Prashant. Amrita tries to buy a mobile phone but stops herself because it's expensive. However, the next day, someone delivers it to her.

videos.title: Tohfa
videos.overview: Amrita shares her suspicions with Adi about Prashant, who approaches her for a job in her company. After failing to find the anonymous gift-giver, Adi finally gets a break.

videos.title: Shaq aur Jhooth
videos.overview: Adi tells Amrita about the mobile bill, and she goes to confront Prashant. Amrita finds out about Makrand's secret life. Meanwhile, at work, Amrita's absence infuriates Prashant.

videos.title: Saazish
videos.overview: Furious after hearing Adi tell Amrita to fire him, Prashant tampers with his bike. While the police suspect Adi’s accident was planned, Prashant makes another attempt to kill him.

videos.title: Aap Beeti
videos.overview: Amrita gets Prashant arrested for causing Adi's accident. She approaches Makrand, who assigns his best lawyers to help her. Madhu creates chaos as her brother is taken to custody.

videos.title: Main Maiyya Hoon Teri
videos.overview: Madhu accidentally uncovers Prashant's hidden truth. While she stands by Amrita in court, she credits Nirmala for showing her the reality. Later, Amrita finds a mother in Nirmala.

videos.title: Legal Notice
videos.overview: Adi and Amrita long for each other when Nirmala invites her to her place. Amrita scolds Makrand on discovering his hidden lifestyle. Adi’s sister sends him legal notice.

videos.title: Dooriyan
videos.overview: Amrita tries to bridge the rift between Adi and his sisters, but Smriti refuses to accept her. Amrita gets a letter from Singhals and becomes the boss of Adi's brothers-in-law.

videos.title: Madam Ji
videos.overview: Sanjay and Ashish refuse to take the audit report deadline seriously. Realising that personal and professional lives should be kept separate, Amrita turns a task master.

videos.title: Happy Rakhi
videos.overview: Amrita saves the situation when Sanjay and Ashish face the ire of the management for their shoddy work. While Smriti and Neeta apologise to her, Abhinav runs away from home.

videos.title: Daayra
videos.overview: Adi and Amrita find Abhinav at the station, where Adi finds out Abhinav's concerns about their relationship. Meanwhile, Amrita faces trouble for standing by her ethics.

videos.title: Be Practical
videos.overview: Adi makes Amrita understand Abhinav's problem. With Abhinav’s help, she brings an ailing Makrand to her house. Later, Makrand learns about the condition put forth by the Singhals.

videos.title: Intezaar Nibhayenge Hum
videos.overview: As Ammu and Adi grow closer, a promise keeps them apart. Years later, their bond endures and hope for a new beginning grows until an unexpected crisis threatens everything.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Masterpeace
_verifiedMetadata.description: When marital discord becomes everyone's business and parents get way too involved in the "peace talks," family drama can become family trauma.

videos.title: Oh My Dog
videos.overview: Did they fight? Are they having problems? What is with the knife? Riya and Binoy's parents have more questions for the loving couple as they barge into their house unannounced.

videos.title: Om Shanthi Home
videos.overview: The parents' intervention complicates matters for Binoy and Riya, and the blame game begins. In the middle of all that, a guest arrives.

videos.title: Happy Hours
videos.overview: After the peace in the house is fully disrupted, the couple gets a call from their friend and neighbour, Adarsh, who is up to no good and wants their help to deal with his wife.

videos.title: Last Supper
videos.overview: Riya loses her patience with Aniyamma and Kuriyachan and blames them for insulting their guest. Things get worse when a prospective marriage proposal turns into a religious war.

videos.title: Song of Songs
videos.overview: Riya and Binoy realise that their parents' problems are more grave than theirs. Many surprises unfold as their inner conflicts come to light.

_verifiedMetadata.description: Top Cooku Dupe Cooku is an Indian Tamil-language comedy-based cooking competition show, Produced by Media Masons. The show based on Star Vijay's Cooku with Comali. It premieres on Sun TV on May 19, 2024, and airs every Sunday at 12:30 (IST). It is also available for streaming on Sun NXT. The show judged by Chef Venkatesh Bhat, Binny Krishnakumar and hosted by VJ Rakesh.

_verifiedMetadata.name: #90’s - A Middle Class Biopic
_verifiedMetadata.description: A nostalgic trip down memory lane, delving into the everyday life of a middle-class family.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Psycho Saiyaan
_verifiedMetadata.description: Kartik Pandey, a poetic student in Ujjain, becomes obsessed with Charu, convinced she is his destiny. When she disappears, he learns she’s trapped by ruthless gangster-politician Huntry Chauhan. Infiltrating Huntry’s haveli, Kartik enters a violent world of manipulation where love turns toxic, obsession deepens, and sanity blurs into madness.

videos.title: Siberian Seagull
videos.overview: In the ancient city of Ujjain, Kartik falls obsessively in love with the mysterious Charu, who arrives seeking mukti for her dying grandmother. But when she vanishes without warning, his devotion turns into a relentless search, where love may be far more complicated than it seems.

videos.title: German Shepherd
videos.overview: In Katni, Kartik discovers Charu trapped under the control of Huntry Chauhan, a ruthless politician hiding brutality behind charm. Posing as a caretaker for Huntry’s prized German Shepherd, Kartik steps into a world where loyalty is staged, and love demands terrifying choices.

videos.title: Persian Cat
videos.overview: Kartik decides to flee Katni with Charu before Huntry Chauhan tightens his grip. But on the night of Huntry’s grand “Mrs. Katni” spectacle, glamour turns to menace, loyalties shift, and escape becomes a deadly game of power and secrets.

videos.title: Raging Bull
videos.overview: Kartik is lured into Huntry Chauhan’s isolated farmhouse, where Charu pushes him toward an unthinkable choice. But in the wilderness, loyalties shatter, violence erupts, and Kartik finds himself trapped in a nightmare where love becomes accusation and survival comes at a devastating cost.

videos.title: Rowdy Rodent
videos.overview: Kartik is released from prison and pushed toward a “safe” new life with Ritu. But just as normalcy returns, an impossible sight reignites the mystery of Charu—and sends Kartik chasing her shadow once more.

videos.title: Wild Wolf
videos.overview: Kartik tracks Charu’s shadow to Georgia, desperate for answers. Instead, he finds a truth built on deception and reinvention. As old dangers return, love collapses into a final, ruthless reckoning.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Thalaimai Seyalagam
_verifiedMetadata.description: When the Chief Minister faces the bars of prison, a power struggle brews among the members of the ruling party. Meanwhile, the CBI follows a trail of murders from Jharkhand that might have a connection with another murder case in Tamil Nadu. However, things take an unexpected turn when all the chaos seems linked to each other.

videos.title: The King's Gambit
videos.overview: A murder case in Jharkhand clashes with Tamil Nadu CM Arunachalam’s corruption trial, prompting his daughter, Amudhavalli, to intervene. CM advisor Kotravai has mysterious visitors.

videos.title: Thalaimai Seyalagam
videos.overview: CBI officer Nawaz Khan takes up the Jharkhand murder case. Meanwhile, in Tamil Nadu, DGP Manikandan probes into a horrifying discovery. Political unrest grows along with rising suspicions.

videos.title: Whispers of Deceit
videos.overview: Manikandan discovers a link between Kotravai and a mysterious figure named Durga. On the other hand, Nawaz Khan follows a trail of clues leading to an ex-journalist.

videos.title: Interlocking Circles
videos.overview: Nawaz Khan's investigation leads him to a police informer and a confrontation with Durga. Kotravai taking charge of politics sparks danger, while Manikandan faces betrayal.

videos.title: A Web of Intrigue
videos.overview: Nawaz Khan encounters a false lead, shifting his focus. A suspended Manikandan continues investigating the case with more determination but gets involved in a violent incident.

videos.title: Chasing Shadows
videos.overview: As Kotravai fights for her life, Arunachalam's fate hangs in the balance. Manikandan and Nawaz Khan follow separate leads to Delhi, seeking answers amidst escalating tension.

videos.title: The Final Stand
videos.overview: With the verdict looming, Kotravai returns, signalling a last-ditch effort to secure power. As the courtroom drama unfolds, Manikandan and Nawaz Khan stumble upon the truth.

videos.title: The Coronation
videos.overview: A twist of fate affects the CM's position. Nawaz Khan and Manikandan close in on their targets. Amidst the chaos, secrets emerge, and alliances break, changing Tamil Nadu's politics forever.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Karimnagar’s Most Wanted
_verifiedMetadata.description: In 'Karimnagar's Most Wanted' Four small-town dreamers face adversity after a real estate deal goes wrong. Framed by a corrupt politician, they endure prison horrors. Upon release, they turn the tables, becoming feared underworld figures. A clash with an influential foe tests their mettle, leading to a relentless battle for survival.

videos.title: Twisted Ambitions
videos.overview: A Collision of Fates in Karimnagar' Middle-class small-town boys seeking a chance at fortune, tread unconventional paths. Yet, destiny takes a twist. Simultaneously, the high-handed MLA aspirant Purushottam exploits every illicit avenue to seize control of Karimnagar, setting the stage for a collision of fates.

videos.title: The Intensifying Gamble
videos.overview: Ghani and the boys grapple with their newfound woes, but each choice they make only tightens the grip of complication. Meanwhile, Purushottam escalates ruthlessly, hell-bent on seizing the PMP party's MLA ticket, regardless of the toll. The stakes rise; trouble intensifies.

videos.title: Pawns in Peril
videos.overview: Ghani and the boys awaken to the harsh reality of being sacrificial pawns in a grander conspiracy, their lives abruptly shattered. Purushottam orchestrates their descent into a point of no return with relentless precision. The trap tightens; destinies hang in the balance.

videos.title: A Gritty Descent into Nightmares
videos.overview: The boys' dreams crumble, their world flipped, hope extinguished, leaving them numb within prison's confines. Enduring a new life, they confront bullying, torture, and manipulation from the merciless inmate Gattu Seenu. A brutal descent into a nightmarish reality unfolds.

videos.title: Karimnagar's Underworld Unleashed
videos.overview: The boys return to Karimnagar with a new creed: 'Never ask; take what's yours by any means necessary.' Ghani adopts a ruthless approach, while Tinku transforms into a volatile gangster, poised to challenge the reigning kingpins of Karimnagar's underworld. A reign of defiance and ruthlessness begins.

videos.title: Power Play
videos.overview: The boys assert dominance, forging an alliance with Purushottam to expand their empire. Tinku's proclivity for violence catapults them into a perilous confrontation with an adversary they should have steered clear of. The battle for supremacy escalates, testing their mettle and alliances.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Bandwaale
_verifiedMetadata.description: Mariam, a young poetess, finds herself trapped in a sleepy town, where every young girl's future lies in wedlock. Mariam hopes to find her freedom against all odds, by uploading her poetry on the internet through an anonymous account.Along with her band of misfits - Robo and Psy, Mariam discovers the power of her poetry and her own voice.

videos.title: Mynah
videos.overview: When her anonymous poem about a kiss creates a scandal in college, Mariam, a young poetess, is forced to find a way to continue to express herself without causing a stir. Escaping her father David's ire, Mariam turns to the internet to express herself.

videos.title: 128 GB
videos.overview: Mariam struggles to find a way to increase the views on her channel. She looks for the right music to pair with her words. In an unlikely turn of events, she ends up seeking help from Robo, unaware of his contrasting musical sensibilities.

videos.title: Black Mamba
videos.overview: DJ Psy, a mysterious boy, catches Mariam's attention. Robo feels threatened with the arrival of a new prospective collaborator. Robo and his gang call him the Black Mamba.

videos.title: Muqabala
videos.overview: DJ Psy has introduced Ratlam to a new kind of music that is trending with the young. Mariam is in awe of his sound and his charm. Rafi believes this is what will revive the ailing New Modern Band. He invites Psy to join the band. Robo and gang are incensed at this subterfuge. Ismail, to placate flared tempers, calls for a 'Muqabala' between the New Modern Band and DJ Psy.

videos.title: Neela Moza
videos.overview: Mariam is distraught when her mother is confronted with a medical emergency which lands her in hospital. It doesn't help that things with Psy are awkward. Dark family secrets are revealed. On David's return from Kerala, father and daughter have a bitter showdown. Mariam's words fail her when she needs it the most.

videos.title: Bandwaale
videos.overview: Mariam has to make it to the influencer conclave organized by Book My Sitara at Jabalpur. However dodging David's ploys of getting her to impress prospective grooms is harder than she thought. Meanwhile Psy struggles to fight his demons. Mariam discovers his secret and takes Robo's help to save him from a dangerous situation.

videos.title: Haklaati Haseena
videos.overview: At Jabalpur, the band of misfits comes together. It's a whole new world of influencers, social media managers and algorithms. The band is off to a great start but falters when Mariam is faced with her biggest fear. The event is ruined when the band and the audience get into a violent scuffle.

videos.title: Knock Knock Knock
videos.overview: The Jabalpur debacle makes Mariam famous in a way she least expects. Mariam has to choose between capitalizing on internet fame and being true to her poetry.

videos.title: The Huntress

videos.title: Devil is in the Details

videos.title: What Lies Beneath

videos.title: Something Wicked

videos.title: The Ties That Bind
videos.overview: Panic strikes when Kathy and another forest guard go missing in the forest during a routine night patrol. Rishi’s traumatic past with Viji is revealed. Meanwhile, a young village woman gets a visit from the Vanaratchi.

videos.title: Deliver us from Evil
videos.overview: The exorcism of a Vanaratchi-possessed woman gets interrupted by a group of unruly villagers. While Rishi digs deep and studies the victimology, Chitra and Ayyanar lock horns and get into a heated argument.

videos.title: The Darkest Hour
videos.overview: Sathya and Irfan are abducted and tortured by poachers. While the rescue team searches for them in the forest, Rishi, Kathy, Ayyanar and Chitra conduct an investigation of their own to find the two officers before it’s too late.

videos.title: The Secret Cavern
videos.overview: Rishi, Ayyanar, Chitra and Sathya venture into a dark and mysterious cave to investigate a crime scene. The truth behind the tribal people’s deadly ritual is revealed. Kathy decides to confess her love to Rishi.

videos.title: Close Encounters
videos.overview: One major clue in the investigation leads Rishi to find shocking revelations and discoveries. The team realises that the lives of many innocent people are at stake if they don’t do something soon.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Vyooham

To solve the case, the officer has to hunt down a serial killer, a trained Naxal, a suspended cop, and a terrorist organization, while facing his own painful past.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Dil Dhokha Aur Desire
_verifiedMetadata.description: Duty spirals into a volatile triangle of love, loyalty and betrayal when the dreams of a young boxer lands him in the dangerous world of a ruthless businessman, entangling him with his wife, the one woman he was hired to protect. videos.title: A Dangerous Deal

videos.title: Temptation
videos.overview: As Shaurya resists temptation and clings to his moral code, Malini turns desire into leverage, pulling him deeper into a dangerous power play; crossing the line starts to feel inevitable.

videos.title: The Reckoning
videos.overview: When restraint finally breaks, one reckless night rewrites loyalties and the past Shaurya tried to bury comes knocking at his door.

videos.title: Collateral Damage
videos.overview: Trapped between Malini's obsession, his lost love's return and a friend's sacrifice, Shaurya realizes every choice now comes with blood on it.

videos.title: Nowhere to Run
videos.overview: Caught between truth and manipulation, Shaurya's choice turns devotion into danger, exposing how far Malini is willing to go; escape may cost more than staying.

videos.title: The Bloody End
videos.overview: In the ruthless game with no safe choices, Shaurya's final act of courage ends the war, but the price of survival delivers a blow that shatters everything he fought to protect.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Mansion 24

videos.overview: Amrutha enters a deserted mansion while searching for her missing father. She meets a watchman who knows about the place and starts recounting the tale of a novelist.
The watchman tells the story of a drugstore girl who was tragically killed by her married boyfriend, a tale shrouded in darkness and sorrow.
A family that once lived in the mansion gets caught in the mire of superstition as they believe their godly dead matriarch will come back to life.
A classical dancer starts hearing a baby's cries in her apartment. Who is this child, and why is she hearing them?
A sculptor moulds his creations, seeking more than inspiration from real women. Everything goes fine for him until a sex worker visits his apartment.
Amrutha tells the watchman what really happened in 307. Through that discovery, she unlocks the mystery behind her father's disappearance.

Can they successfully bluff their way out, or will their ruse be exposed? The tension builds as they prepare to face his probing questions.

videos.title: New Start
videos.overview: Energetic young interns have officially joined the office, bringing additional chaos with them. Just as Nisha and Shyama think things are going well, an investor calls with ridiculous ideas that must be implemented. A disagreement between the boys' and girls' teams soon arises, which the interns must resolve. Will they work together as a team?

videos.title: Liquor Delivery
videos.overview: Nisha and Shyama attempt to carry out the investor's plan but quickly realize it is a horrible idea. Meanwhile, Maari, who has always been single, is now hopeful of finding love. But with whom?

videos.title: Office Olympics
videos.overview: Keshavan organizes office games to break the ice, but all hell breaks loose during the game. Krish and Simbu fail to collect data from employees on their first day. Will they get fired or saved?

videos.title: Fight or Flight
videos.overview: When Leena and Algates order condoms, Alagtes friend Naalu Juram comes as a delivery guy to deliver them and finds out Leena is staying with someone. Will Naalu Juram break the secret of the live-in relationship? or will he cover it up?

videos.title: The Next Victim
videos.overview: Thara starts noticing strange, unexplainable things happening around her in the office. It’s almost as if something, or someone, is after her. As the eerie presence tightens its grip, she tries to escape, but it feels like there’s no way out. Will she break free, or will she end up as the ghost’s next victim?

videos.title: Tom and Jerry
videos.overview: For the lovebirds, everything seems to be going smoothly until a sudden argument shakes their relationship. Tensions run high, and the fight threatens to pull them apart. Can they patch things up, or has their love story come to an end?

videos.title: Two Truths and a lie
videos.overview: The Interns play the game of “Two Truths and a Lie” for fun, but it becomes serious as it progresses, exposing hidden secrets and shocking revelations. Watch the full episode to discover the lies and truths.

videos.title: Love and Hate
videos.overview: As the Game “Two Truths and a Lie” continues, Jenny and Krish open up their inner feelings about love, which results in a heated argument between them. Will the game bring them closer or make them drift further.

videos.title: Ouija Board
videos.overview: Maari and Thara are on a mission to prove the presence of a ghost in the office by playing Ouija Board. Will they find others to play the game or will it be the end game for them?

videos.title: Maran
videos.overview: Thara, Maari, Naalu Juram and Shyama reach the end of the Ouija Board game, where an unknown evil ghost possesses Thara. Will they find the name of the Ghost or will they become the victims of the Ghost?

videos.title: Role Swap
videos.overview: Thara, Maari, and Naalu Juram are on a mission to learn more about Maran, and they come across a popular YouTuber’s vlog about the ghost. Will they find answers? Algats and Leena challenge themselves to a role swap to decide who is right. Who will win the challenge?

videos.title: Revelation
videos.overview: Finally, Maari, Naalu Juram and Thara find someone who knows about Maran and his Flashback. Watch the full Episode to uncover the truth behind Maran. Jenny makes one last attempt to change Krish’s opinion about love. Will she succeed?

videos.title: Death by Cake
videos.overview: The security continues the flashback of the ghost Maran. Maari, Thara and Naalu Juram are about to learn how Maran died and why he is taking revenge on people. Will they be able to find the reason?

videos.title: Halloween Celebration
videos.overview: People in the office celebrate Halloween despite Maari’s warning about ghost Maran in the office. Will the celebration go planned, or will they all be attacked by Maran? What happens next?

videos.title: Danger Ahead
videos.overview: Maari makes one last attempt to stop the Celebration, but it fails, and one of the Colleagues falls victim to Maran. Meanwhile, Krish and Jenny are trying to reconcile their differences with her. Can they succeed?

videos.title: Closure
videos.overview: Despite Maari’s warning, Keshavan and the team cut the cake, and one of their colleagues is attacked by Maran and found unconscious on the floor. Krish and Jenny’s bond grows deeper, clearing their indifferences.

videos.title: The Shaman
videos.overview: Maran creates chaos during the Halloween celebration, traumatizing everyone in the office. To stop him, the team calls a shaman to capture Maran. Will the shaman be able to succeed?

videos.title: Unfulfilled wishes
videos.overview: After understanding Maaran’s true intentions, Maari realizes that they were wrong about him. Maari makes a plan to save Maaran from the shaman. Investor Aadithya arrives at the office to investigate the employees.

videos.title: Investor’s Atrocity
videos.overview: The company's investor Adhithya, comes to India to check on the employees, He has an offer from Elon Musk to sell the company. Will he agree to it? What happens to the company and the employees?

videos.title: Poorna is Back
videos.overview: All hell breaks loose when Poorna enters the office again as a Creative Director. Employees are going crazy seeing him. Poorna starts his mind game with his old employees. Will he take revenge on them?

videos.title: Imperfect Love Story
videos.overview: Krish narrates his past love story to Jenny and brings us all back to our nostalgic college days. The happy love tale ends in a heartbreaking note. Does this story lead to a new beginning?

videos.title: The Great Escape
videos.overview: Algates takes Leena for a checkup, but she panics and runs away after seeing the pain of the pregnant woman. Meanwhile, Elon Musk mistakes Maari for an important office member, and Simbu proposes

videos.title: Misfire
videos.overview: Keshavan and Shyama find themselves in hot water with Poorna over their work backlogs, risking their jobs. At the same time, Maari and Simbhu face the consequences after trying to deceive Elon Musk.

videos.title: Run Baby Run
videos.overview: Leena's mom makes a surprise visit to Leena's apartment, putting Algates in a difficult situation about their live-in. Meanwhile, Maari and Naalu Juram compete to see who can impress Thara and win her heart.

videos.title: Power
videos.overview: Maari and Naalu Juram are on a mission to see who can impress Thara the most. Meanwhile, Algatez asks Leena about what her mom told regarding their relationship, and her response leaves him stunned. In a bid to assert his authority, Poorna introduces new rules in the office.

videos.title: Restrictionship
videos.overview: Keshavan and Maari make a plan to prank Poorna, but it backfires, leading to unexpected consequences. At the same time, Jenny and Krish are impressed by a couple visiting the office.

videos.title: Middle Finger
videos.overview: Jenny starts using the dating apps for the first time, ready to meet people. Meanwhile, Leena hides an important secret from Alagates after the hospital visit. Maari fakes an injury as an excuse to avoid his tasks.

videos.title: Brainwash
videos.overview: Algates approaches his mother to convince her to call off his upcoming marriage to Kalaiselvi. Maari tries to win Thara’s affection by playing the sympathy card, but things take a turn when Poorna intervenes. Simbu is caught by Keshavan while trying to use the office printer for personal purposes.

videos.title: App Launch
videos.overview: The employees celebrate the successful launch of their app, but their joy is short-lived when they discover a cloned version of the ASS app has surfaced. Algates surprises Leena by inviting her to a registration office dressed in traditional attire.

videos.title: Culprit
videos.overview: The entire office is devastated as their hard work has been stolen by someone, and they set out to find the person responsible for the theft. Meanwhile, the investor gives Nisha an ultimatum: either make their app a success or pay back his investment with significant interest.

videos.title: The Brand Ambassador
videos.overview: Leena suggests making their former employee, Sharmi, the brand ambassador for ASS and assigns Maari and Poorna to handle the execution. However, a twist emerges when Elan Musk also seeks to sign Sharmi as the brand ambassador for AZZ. Who will win her over?

videos.title: Revelations and Reckonings
videos.overview: Poorna orders Jenney to stay late at the office, despite her fear of being alone, until a surprise arrives. Meanwhile, Leena drops a bombshell on Algates, revealing that she’s not pregnant, sparking a fierce confrontation. The truth is out, and everything is about to shift.

videos.title: Wishes and Wars
videos.overview: The battle for Thara escalates between Maari and Naalu Juram, with Maari turning to Simbhu for help. Thara introduces the concept of 11:11, showing how the universe responds to our wishes. When Jenny makes her own wish, the universe delivers a surprising twist.

videos.title: Revealed
videos.overview: Maari transforms into Maari 2.0 in an unexpected attempt to win Thara's attention. When Algates and Leena cross paths, a post-separation lot of unexpected twists happen. Will they get back together?

videos.title: Pretend
videos.overview: Villupuram Sugumaran, a secretive employee, stirs chaos for Kesavan and the team. Meanwhile, Krish's ex shows up, forcing Krish and Jenny to pose as a couple. But in the act, their fake relationship begins to feel surprisingly real.

videos.title: Hacked
videos.overview: The ASS server is hacked, which puts Krish and Jenny into the trouble. Meanwhile, Leena’s ex-boyfriend arrives at the office, further complicating her already tense relationship with Algates. what happens next?

videos.title: Shocking Secrets
videos.overview: Leena goes for a routine checkup, only to have her friend reveal a shocking secret to her. The interns head to Keshavan to receive feedback on their performance, but Poorna intervenes and stops them. With only one week left in their internship, Jenny feels the pressure, and Thara encourages her to confess her feelings to Krish.

videos.title: Betrayal & Rejection
videos.overview: A covert spy within the office betrays Maari, revealing crucial information to Keshavan, which is then passed on to Poorna. Jenny gathers the courage to confess her love to Krish, but his response leaves her heartbroken. Meanwhile, Maari makes one last attempt to win Thara's affection, but it ends disastrously.

videos.title: Tangled Fates
videos.overview: Krish calls Jenny to express his feelings. Meanwhile, Naalu Juram comes to know about Leena's pregnancy, which creates unnecessary problems. Nisha and her team are facing major issues. Will they be able to manage this?

videos.title: Final Stand
videos.overview: The ASS app becomes a huge hit, and Nisha opens a new surprise to her team. Algates comes to know about Leena's pregnancy, Will this bring them together or not? What happens to the interns?

videos.title: New Beginnings
videos.overview: The ASS App becomes an overwhelming success, and Nisha surprises her team with several unexpected announcements. Algates learns about Leena's pregnancy—will this bring them closer or push them further apart? As the interns face a decision about their future, will they leave the office or stay to see where destiny leads them with the ASS App?

videos.title: Motherless Boy

_verifiedMetadata.name: The Roommate Contract
_verifiedMetadata.description: The Roommate Contract is a drama series that follows a group of young adults who move in together under a written agreement designed to maintain order and harmony in their shared living space. What begins as a practical solution to everyday conflicts soon becomes a source of tension as personal boundaries are crossed and unspoken expectations come to light. As relationships evolve and disagreements intensify, the contract is repeatedly tested, forcing each roommate to confront their own values, responsibilities, and understanding of trust.

videos.title: Tadka
videos.overview: Two strangers, broke and desperate, accidentally land the same “couples-only” apartment. Aryan, a struggling freelance designer, and Rhea, fed up with her chaotic home life, fake a relationship to survive Mumbai’s brutal rental scene. What starts as a harmless lie turns into a legally signed Roommate Contract—with rules, boundaries, and zero romance allowed. Or so they think.

videos.title: Ek Myan Do Talwarein
videos.overview: Living together turns chaotic as Aryan and Rhea clash over space, habits, and basic human decency. From midnight noise wars to bathroom battles and ego-fueled standoffs, their “roommate contract” is tested hard. But amid the chaos, awkward silences, accidental tenderness, and unexpected concern hint that this war of egos might just be the beginning of something deeper.

videos.title: Phool Aur Kante
videos.overview: Jealousy enters the apartment as unexpected guests, awkward dates, and crossed signals turn Aryan and Rhea’s fragile truce into an emotional minefield. With egos bruised, drinks flowing, and boundaries blurring, both begin to realize that pretending not to care might be harder than actually caring. Between laughter, chaos, and late-night honesty, something dangerously real starts to bloom.

videos.title: Something Something
videos.overview: Morning chaos turns into emotional confusion as boundaries blur and unspoken feelings surface. Between awkward breakfasts, misunderstood intentions, and a growing emotional dependency, Aryan and Rhea begin to realize that their “temporary arrangement” is starting to feel dangerously permanent — even as outside relationships complicate things further.

videos.title: Sawaal
videos.overview: A surprise visit from Aryan’s mother explodes into chaos, misunderstandings, and heartbreak. What starts as comic panic quickly spirals into emotional damage when Rhea is forced to leave the house she thought was safe. Trust cracks, truths remain unsaid, and both are left questioning where they stand — and whether this arrangement was ever just a contract.

videos.title: Jawab
videos.overview: With emotions at their breaking point, Aryan and Rhea are forced to confront everything they’ve been avoiding. Confessions surface, egos clash, and love finally speaks out loud — just as life threatens to pull them in different directions. Choices must be made, and not all answers come without loss.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Brothers-in-Law
_verifiedMetadata.description: Aliyans (Brothers-in-Law) is a hit Malayalam sitcom on Kaumudy TV, directed by Rajesh Thalachira. It premiered on February 24, 2020, as a sequel to Aliyan vs Aliyan (Brother-in-Law vs Brother-in-Law). Set in Thiruvananthapuram, the show follows Ratnamma and her family, centering on the love-hate dynamic between brothers-in-law Kanakan and Cleatus. Most episodes revolve around Cleatus landing in trouble thanks to his quirky ideas, with Kanakan often stepping in to save the day.

videos.title: The Story Goes Like This
videos.overview: Aliyans is a family comedy sitcom of Kaumudy TV. Its about the love - hate relationship between two brother-in-laws and their families. Aneesh Ravi, Soumya Bhagyananthan, Riyas Narmakala, Manju Pathrose, Sethulekshmi, Binoj Kulathoor, Mani Shornur and Akshayamol. Aliyans is directed by Rajesh Thalachira.

videos.title: Search for Cleatus
videos.overview: When a Sheikh from Dubai comes in search of Cleatus, everyone starts believing that Cleatus has messed up something in Dubai and the Sheikh is after his life. How will Cleatus save himself from the Sheikh? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Kanakan Gets the Chit Funds
videos.overview: Kanakan tells Lilly and Thankam that based on the lucky draw, he has won the Chit Funds. But as soon as they come to know about it, they ask for their share to fulfill their wishes. Helpless Kanakan couldn't refuse but shared with them. Later a man visits Kanakan to ask for some money, but will Lilly and Thankam give up on their share to help the man? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Jasmine Flowers
videos.overview: After much pondering, Thambi finally finds a new job, but he hides it from her wife, Sulu, saying that he has got a job but didn't reveal where he has got the job. Sulu suspects that her husband, Thambi is having an extra-marital affair which makes her heavily disappointed as she gets a scent of Jasmine flowers from Thambi's shirt. Is Thambi really having an extra-marital affair? Find out to know more.

videos.title: The Speech
videos.overview: Takkuddu tells his mother that he has got a chance to give a speech in his school. On hearing this, his mom gets annoyed and stops talking to him till the time he backs off from giving the speech. Later Thankam's brother and his wife consoles her and pacifies her. Takkudu tells his mom that he removed his name from the list. What happens next? Find out to know more.

videos.title: Service Co-operation Bank Lilly
videos.overview: Thambi visits Lilly and gives her some money to keep it safe with her as she thinks that her wife, Sulu will spend all his earned money which he had earned from his acting classes, till Thambi asks for it. Later, Lilly gives that money to Kanakan to help his friend, Suresh, for his child's medical expenses. Later Thambi visits Lilly and asks for his money back as he has to give it to repay the loan which he took from a moneylender. Now what will Lilly do? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Kanakan's Ooty Trip
videos.overview: Ronald receives a message from Kanakan saying that he and his friends have been arrested by the Tamil Nadu Police for partying with a few girls in a hotel room in Ooty. He shares this news from Girirajan but hides it from the other family members. Later Thankam learns the truth from Ronald after getting at his back and consoles Lilly after informing her. After a while, Kanakan returns from the trip, but all are angry on him. What's the truth? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Fight for the Set Saree
videos.overview: Thankam and Girija, both of them selected the same few set sarees which were gifted to Ratnamma, because of which, they had an argument. Now the men of the house have decided to convince both of them to wear the set sarees or else Ratnamma had decide to donate it to Orphanage. Will the men succeed? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Girija's Chain Goes Missing
videos.overview: Ronald asks for some money from Thankam which she refuses to give. Later Ronald visits Ratnamma thinking that she might agree to give money but is a bit doubtful. Later when he comes to know that Amma is getting ready to collect pension from the bank, that's when he agrees to join her. Meanwhile Girija keeps the chain on the table of her room and goes to take bath. After returning, she notices that her chain goes missing and later calls Lilly and Thankam to search for it. Thankam raises doubt that Ronald might have stolen it to get some hard cash in exchange of that. Does her suspicion come out to be true? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Fear of Girija's Anger
videos.overview: Ronald informs Thankam that Girirajan felt unconscious and has been sent to the hospital. On return, they informed the family members that it was due to weakness and so they suggested him to do a few physical exercises. Girirajan refuses but Girija warns him that if he doesn't follow, she will impose stricter restrictions on him. Later Girija finds a stick in Girirajan's shirt's pocket which later Lilly identifies it as a smoke weed. What happens next? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Men of Kerala Association
videos.overview: Ronald has plans to start an association having all the men of Kerala who are tired of their wife's tantrum and his association aims to solve the problems of the men. Will he succeed in this movement? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Who Gets to Have the Dosa Pan?
videos.overview: Lilly, on Thankam's behest, purchases a Dosa Pan for her from a salesgirl who's very young. Later, Girirajan reveals that Lilly has been cheated by that girl as Girirajan purchased a similar dosa pan for even lesser price. On hearing this, Thankam refuses to take the pan from Lilly and also decides not to repay her for the pan she purchased. Who gets to have the pan? Will Thankam accept it? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Scooter Needs a Repair
videos.overview: Kanakan, who takes pride and good care of his scooter, find out that his scooter isn't working properly. Voluntarily, Ronald promises to Kanakan that he'll fix his scooter as soon as possible. Will Ronald succeed? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Movie Review
videos.overview: Ronald, in order to earn some money, decides to open his YouTube channel for reviewing the movies. Everything was going well, later his greediness takes over him. Now what will happen? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Ratnamma's Fear
videos.overview: Ratnamma's friend visits her for the last time before leaving this city as her children does not treat her properly. On hearing this, Ratnamma starts to worry, whether her children and her family would treat her in the same manner as her friend was treated. Later, Kanakan (who left early without meeting Ratnamma), Lilly, Thankam, Takkuddu and Ronald couldn't pay attention to her as they were busy with their work. How will the family members console Ratnamma? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Ronald Takes up the Job of Loading and Unloading Goods
videos.overview: Ronald receives a phone call from Rosemary, who requests financial assistance to settle an overdue electricity bill, which has led to a power outage at his residence. In response, Ronald seeks monetary help from his relatives, but only Lilly offers support. Upon noticing the money in Ronald's possession, Kanakan chastises him for frequently relying on family for financial aid. This prompts Ronald to accept a job involving the loading and unloading of goods at a vegetable shop, which pleases Kanakan as he observes Ronald's newfound work ethic. However, as news of Ronald's situation spreads, his family members begin to feel sympathy for him. Tune in to discover more!

videos.title: Where is Ratnamma's Phone?
videos.overview: Lilly and Kanakan leaves from their home to attend a wedding. Lilly informs Amma that she has prepared the rice but couldn't find the time to make the curry, so she suggests Amma to go to Thankam's place to have the food from there. Later Thankam gets a call from Cleatus asking her to get his important document, leaving Amma, Takkuddu and Ronald behind. Amma reprimands Takkuddu for taking her mobile phone and snatches it away. Later she kept it away from his reach, near the windowsill in the kitchen but later it goes missing from there. Everyone suspects Takkuddu. Has he lost or damaged Amma's phone? Watch the episode to know more!

videos.title: Ronald's Plan Goes in Vain
videos.overview: Thankam becomes upset with Lilly after she instructs her to remain silent so that the Ladies Meeting can proceed. Subsequently, a sister named Mini visits Lilly to provide a loan for her husband's medical treatment. Ronald discovers the truth about Mini's deception from Sister Omana who had spoken ill of her. Ronald's intention is to expose Mini's dishonesty in front of Lilly and Kanakan the following day when she comes to collect the loan, aiming to impress them. Meanwhile, Thankam secretly learns the full story from Ronald, who was overheard discussing the incident and his plan to reveal it over the phone. What will unfold next? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: The Ladies' Conversational Gathering
videos.overview: When Thankam, Lilly and Takkuddu were returning from the temple, they met Sister Omana, who's heading to meet one of their acquaintances, who are dealing with their family problems. On hearing this, Thankam and Lilly requests Omana to come to their place to give them updates after meeting them. Once Omana reaches, she tells the story to Lilly, Thankam and Ratnamma! What happens next? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Ratnamma Gets Into an Argument With Lilly
videos.overview: Ratnamma admonishes Lilly for her negligence in leaving the gas stove on while the rice cooker is preparing the rice. Subsequently, in an effort to support Amma, Thankam engages in a dispute with Lilly, which disturbs Kanakan's tranquility. Eventually, news of Kanakan's unexpected transfer spreads among everyone. What will unfold next? Stay tuned to discover more!

videos.title: Ronald Demands for a Scooter
videos.overview: Thankam and Lilly ask Ronald to purchase some grocery items, but he returns home late, causing frustration among everyone. He proposes that if they buy him a scooter, he will be able to complete his errands quickly, thus saving both time and money. Will they agree to his request? Watch now to discover more!

videos.title: Just One Look at Me
videos.overview: Akshaya calls Thankam requesting her to ask someone to pick her up from the hostel as all of her friends have gone to their parent's place for a few days. Thankam, at first relucted, later Lilly convinced her to allow her to come back from the hostel. Later, Sulu's cousin brother, Lallu, learns the news of Akshaya's return and is wanting her to see once! Will his dream be fulfilled? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Thankam and Cleatus Argue With Each Other
videos.overview: Thankam chastises Cleatus for spending the funds that were specifically set aside for Akshaya's hostel and tuition fees on his party expenses. As a result, they have chosen to live apart and refrain from communicating. What will be the resolution of their conflict? Discover the outcome!

videos.title: Akshaya Centre
videos.overview: Kanakan expresses his intention to establish an Akshaya Centre, not in the name of his wife, Lilly, but rather in the name of her sister, Thankam. This revelation leaves Lilly feeling disheartened and troubled, however, Kanakan eventually persuades her to see his perspective. Subsequently, both Lilly and Kanakan come to the realization that Thankam does not meet the necessary criteria to qualify as a candidate for opening the Akshaya Centre, which makes her feel upset. Will Kanakan succeed in launching the Akshaya Centre? If so, under whose name will it be registered? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: The Rising Heatwave
videos.overview: Thankam requests a new table fan from Cleatus, as the existing fan in their room is inoperative and the rising heatwave is making it difficult for them to sleep. She hands Cleatus 2000 Rupees to purchase a new fan, but he instead brings back a fan that has been unused at Girirajan's residence. When Thankam asks for a refund, Cleatus refuses, claiming he used the money to fulfill his party obligations. However, it later comes to light that he had actually given the money to settle a debt. What will unfold next? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: Breaking the Fast
videos.overview: A distressed woman seeks assistance from Cleatus, hoping he will confront the moneylender who has threatened to evict her and her two children. Regrettably, Cleatus declines to help because of avenging his revenge against her former husband for deceiving Cleatus. Observing her sorrow and disappointment, Thankam and Lilly devise a strategy to provide financial support to the woman. Will their plan be successful? Discover the outcome!

videos.title: Ethakka Appam With Beef Fry
videos.overview: When Kanakan, Lilly and Ratnamma were trying to pacify Thankam and Cleatus as they were arguing with each other, on the other hand, Girirajan and Girija Ammayi were arguing with each together while coming to their place, as Girija refused to have Beef Fry and Pazham Poori, a combination which only a few Keralites like. That's when the men of the house decided to give the ladies of the house, a taste of this combination. Will they succeed? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Half Price Scam
videos.overview: In the initial scene, Girirajan and Thankam engage in a dispute over a minor issue. Subsequently, news of the Half Price Scheme spreads, voluntarily prompting Girirajan to give Lilly 1000 Rupees to purchase a coupon worth 3000 Rupees. Witnessing this, Thankam feels envious and urges Cleatus to ask Girirajan for an additional 1000 Rupees to obtain her own coupon. Will Girirajan extend his generosity to Thankam as well? Discover the outcome!

videos.title: Addiction Free Kerala Campaign
videos.overview: Members of the DDT Party, in collaboration with opposition party members, have initiated a campaign aimed at educating the youth about the dangers of illegal drug use for their own well-being. Meanwhile, Lilly, Thankam, and other Kudumbashree members are visiting the nearby neighborhood to promote this initiative. During their outreach, they encounter a woman who appears to be in distress but conceals her situation from them. Will she seek their assistance? Discover the outcome!

videos.title: Lilly's Secretary Position at Stake
videos.overview: Thankam informs everyone that Lilly failed to perform her duties as the Secretary of the Kudambashree Group and might be expelled from the position of Secretary and Thankam has a higher chance of regaining her position. That's when Ronald comes up with a plan to save Lilly. Will his plan work? Find out to know more!

videos.title: A Trip to Munnar
videos.overview: Ronald receives information from a friend who claims to have seen Cleatus and Kanakan in Munnar. Thankam and Lilly find it hard to believe that they might be betraying them instead of fulfilling their work obligations. Is Ronald's account accurate? Are Kanakan and Cleatus being dishonest with their families? Uncover the truth!

videos.title: The Book of Troubles - Part 1
videos.overview: While playing, Nallu and Saiyyu noticed that Ratnamma appeared sad and disheartened, and they suspected that she might have been crying. They inquired about her feelings, but Ratnamma chose not to share the truth with them. Later, Thankam also noticed her distress and posed the same question, yet Ratna Amma again withheld her feelings. Eventually, during lunch, Ratnamma opened up to everyone about her disappointment. Shortly after, two unexpected guests arrived at Kanakan's residence, seeking information about Cleatus. Upon their arrival, Cleatus appeared visibly distressed. Who are these visitors, and what has caused Cleatus's unease? Uncover the details to find out more!

videos.title: The Book of Troubles - Part 2
videos.overview: Tom and Jessy, an eloped couple, seek refuge, triggering comedic attempts to hide them. The episode focuses on the humorous situations and the family's efforts to maintain secrecy from others.

videos.title: The Book of Troubles - Part 3
videos.overview: The eloped couple's presence creates legal and political worries, given their influential families. A politician's statement adds tension. The episode follows the family's attempts to manage the situation, ending with the couple's departure.

videos.title: The Book of Troubles - Part 4
videos.overview: The family focuses on convincing the eloped couple to leave their refuge. The episode is filled with comedic situations and dialogues as the family attempts to solve the problem and get the couple to leave.

videos.title: The Vishu Celebrations
videos.overview: On the fortunate occasion of Vishu, a young girl arrives at Kanakan's home inquiring about his whereabouts from his family. Regrettably, Kanakan is not at home and will be returning late from work. Upon learning this, the girl chooses to remain there until she can meet him. Subsequently, Ronald discloses a startling revelation about the girl to his family. What prompts this mysterious girl's visit? What is her motive for wanting to see Kanakan? Discover the answers to these questions!

videos.title: The Armchair
videos.overview: Ronald, inebriated, occupies the armchair at Kanakan's residence. Upon noticing this, Girirajan admonishes him, stating that only he and Kanakan, following Kanakan's father, are permitted to use the armchair. Ronald, feeling offended by this trivial matter, engages in a dispute with Girirajan and declares his intention to never return. What unfolds next? Stay tuned to discover more!

videos.title: The Missing Blue Churidar
videos.overview: Two representatives from a charitable organization visited the homes to collect unused clothing and solicit donations from both households. As Lilly and Thankam were occupied with their domestic tasks, they asked the men to return at a later time. Upon their return, Lilly donated her old clothes and proceeded to Thankam's residence to retrieve the garments that Thankam had placed on the table. After the men departed, Thankam inquired about a missing blue churidar that she had set aside for alterations, which had been given to her by a friend. Eventually, Thankam realizes that Lilly inadvertently included that churidar with her old clothes when she donated them. Will they be able to retrieve it from the charity, or will Thankam need to compensate her friend? Discover the outcome!

videos.title: The Buttermilk
videos.overview: Ronald asked Thankam for some food to satisfy his hunger; however, she declined his request due to a dispute with Cleatus, which resulted in the spices she was sautéing being burned. Subsequently, Thankam's creditor, Sister Savitri, visited her to collect the money owed, but Thankam was unable to repay the debt as Cleatus had taken the funds. She then asked Ronald to provide an excuse, but in his pursuit of making some money, Ronald deceived Thankam. Shortly thereafter, seeking to quench his thirst, Ronald went out in search of buttermilk but was unable to find any. He eventually made some at home, but soon experienced loose motions. What could be the cause of this? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Thankam's Birthday Celebration
videos.overview: Thankam shares her wish with Cleatus to visit a temple and enjoy breakfast from outside in celebration of her upcoming birthday. Cleatus promptly agrees to fulfill his wife's request. Upon their return, when questioned about their outing, Cleatus discloses that it was Thankam's birthday. This revelation surprises everyone, particularly Kanakan, who had forgotten the occasion, further upsetting Thankam, especially since she was already feeling the absence of Akshaya. Meanwhile, Takkuddu finds himself in trouble after creating a mess. How will they resolve this situation? How will Kanakan make amends with Thankam? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: Teaching Thambi a Lesson
videos.overview: Thambi, eager to evict his new tenants, a police officer and his wife, employs various strategies to achieve his goal, yet all his attempts prove futile. It is at this point that the police team devises a scheme to intimidate Thambi and teach him a lesson. Will they be successful? Discover the outcome!

videos.title: Swapping Identities
videos.overview: Thankam notifies Lilly that a young woman from the Microfinance bank is scheduled to arrive today to collect the chit funds. Thankam is anxious upon learning that Sister Sulu failed to repay Thankam with the necessary funds, as she doesn't have money, leaving her unable to pay the full amount to the young woman. Subsequently, the young woman arrives at Thankam's residence to collect the chit funds. In response, Thankam decides to assume Lilly's identity, informing the young woman that Thankam (who's actually Lily), has stepped out for an errand and will return late in the evening. However, the young woman insists on receiving the complete payment before leaving. How will Thankam manage to settle the total amount with the young woman? Stay tuned for further developments!

videos.title: A Big Misunderstanding
videos.overview: Ronald has noticed that in recent days, whenever Thambi, Sulu's husband, and Sufi, Mammootty's wife, leave the house, they engage in secret conversations. He communicates this observation to the other residents and subsequently informs Thambi and Sufi. How will they respond? What is the reality behind this? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: Ronald Causes a Trouble Again
videos.overview: Thankam urged Ronald to promptly withdraw cash from the nearby ATM; however, Ronald was reluctant to undertake this task due to his aching legs. After considerable persuasion, he consented to go, opting to either take a rickshaw or use Kanakan's scooter. Initially, Lilly was hesitant to lend the scooter to Ronald, but she eventually relented after he assured her that he would not cause any damage. However, upon exiting the ATM, Ronald discovered the scooter lying on the roadside, resulting in minor damage. He reassured Lilly and Thankam that he would repair the scooter. Will he manage to finish this task before Kanakan returns? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: Cleatus Gets Into Trouble
videos.overview: Cleatus is presented with an opportunity to appear on a news channel for a contentious debate against the opposition party, which had colluded with a road contractor responsible for a road accident due to negligence. However, he soon finds himself in a predicament upon discovering that the allegations he made against both the party and the contractor were unfounded. What will unfold next? Stay tuned for more details!

videos.title: The Story of the Marriage Ring
videos.overview: The ex-fiancé of Thankam, who was set to marry her, came to her home to reclaim the ring that her mother had given to her. Unfortunately, Thankam cannot remember where she had kept the ring. After extensive questioning from all the household members, Lilly proposes that Kanakan should inquire with Girirajan as well, believing he may have information regarding its whereabouts. What happens next? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: An Imposter in Disguise
videos.overview: One morning, Sufi's youngest sister, Surmi, arrives at Sufi's place to surprise her but instead got a surprise when she learnt that they aren't at home. Thankam calls her to her place to rest and wait till they come. Susbsequently, Lilly arrives and insisted her to stay at her place. Later, Thankam and Lilly leave for the Kudumbashree meeting (Ladies Meeting), leaving Takkuddu behind. When they came back, they found her to be missing. What happens next? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Job as an Aanganwadi Helper
videos.overview: Both Girija and Thankam convey their eagerness to engage in work rather than idly spending their time after finishing household tasks. The following day, Thankam visits the Aanganwadi Centre for some work and is presented with an opportunity to serve as an Aanganwadi helper. She shares this news with Kanakan, anticipating that Cleatus would decline. Girija asserts that if Thankam is unable to accept the position, she is willing to take it, however, both of their husbands oppose this. Who will ultimately seize this opportunity? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: The Missing Induction Cooker
videos.overview: One morning, Sister Sulu approached Lilly to request a gas cylinder for cooking purposes. However, Lilly was unable to assist as her own gas cylinder was nearly empty. Instead, she lent Sister Sulu, Sufi's Induction Cooker to help her until a new gas cylinder could be obtained. Later, Sulu and Thambi returned to inform Lilly that the Induction Cooker had been stolen. Who could be responsible for the theft? How will Lilly explain this situation to Sufi? Tune in to discover the full story!

videos.title: The Friendly Avengers
videos.overview: Cleatus and Ronald informs the household members that two people were after them, and in order to save themselves from getting bashed up, they run for their lives, leaving the ladies and Takkuddu behind. After a while, the two men arrive in search of Cleatus. With Kanakan's absence, the ladies try to pacify the men to come back later as Cleatus was not there, but they resisted to stay back unless they teach Cleatus a lesson! How will the ladies manage to pacify the two men? Watch now to know the story!

videos.title: A Sip of Redemption for Thankam
videos.overview: The narrative commences with distressing news conveyed by Appu Kuttan Sir to Cleatus, informing him of Natarajan's sudden heart attack, which has left him on a ventilator in the hospital. Subsequently, Natarajan clarifies the situation. During this time, Lilly ridicules Thankam for never having offered even a cup of tea to Ansar and Natarajan during their visits to Cleatus. In an effort to counter Lilly's claim, Thankam extends an invitation for them to enjoy a cup of tea. Will Thankam resolve the dispute by disproving Lilly's assertion? Discover the outcome!

videos.title: Surmi Gets Blackmailed
videos.overview: The narrative commences with Surmi, the younger sister of Sufi, who is in a state of distress after being blackmailed by an individual. This person had spiked her drink, taken unauthorized photographs, and recorded videos of her, subsequently demanding money to prevent the release of this content on social media. Surmi was not in a suitable mental state to confide in Lilly and Thankam, prompting Sufi to inform them of the situation so that Kanakan could step in and provide assistance. How will Kanakan apprehend the perpetrator, ensure he faces consequences for his actions, and safeguard Surmi's dignity from being compromised? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: Girija's Love for Poetry
videos.overview: The entire household appears taken aback by Girija's transformation, as she begins sharing poetry on social media. The following morning, Girirajan arrives, visibly concerned about Girija's abrupt change in behavior. What unfolds next? Discover the details!

videos.title: Why is Thankam Upset?
videos.overview: The narrative commences with Cleatus, Thankam, Takkuddu, and Lilly as they prepare to attend a wedding. Upon their return, Thankam appears to be distressed and is uncommunicative. What might be the cause of this demeanor? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: The Summer Camp
videos.overview: The narrative commences with Thankam expressing her frustration over the children constantly watching television. Upon abruptly turning it off, Takkuddu retaliates with a vulgar remark, inciting anger in her and others. The family resolves to send the children to a summer camp, but the kids refuse. What unfolds next? Discover the details!

videos.title: Ansar Gets a Second-Hand Car
videos.overview: The narrative commences as Ansar acquires a pre-owned vehicle and reaches Cleatus's home. Upon noticing the car, Kanakan ridicules Cleatus for lacking a vehicle. This provokes Cleatus, who, accompanied by Ronald, visits a second-hand car dealership to purchase a car. Will he succeed in buying a car and disproving Kanakan? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: Girirajan Saves the Day
videos.overview: The story commences with Thankam waking up Takkuddu and sending him to the Summer Camp. Upon his return, Thankam notices that there are red marks on his hands. On questioning, Takkuddu makes excuses and walks away. Later, Thankam learns the truth and informs Lilly about it. Meanwhile Sulu informs Girirajan about this incident and decides to handle the situation. Will he succeed in fulfilling the task? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Thankam's Grand Pretence
videos.overview: Thankam and Cleatus gets involved in a fight where Thankam accuses Cleatus of abusing her physically. Everyone gets highly upset on knowing this and express their anger towards him. How will Cleatus save himself from everyone's wrath? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Frock Nighty
videos.overview: One morning, Girija Ammayi returns to Kanakan's place after attending the opening ceremony of her friend's store. On her way back, she had purchased three Frock Nighties for the ladies of the house, except for Ratnamma, which makes her feel sad and disappointed. Earlier, unaware of the reason behind her sadness, when Girija asked, Ratnamma opened up and expressed her desire for a Frock Nighty. Will the household members agree to buy one for her? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Cleatus Experiences Severe Itching
videos.overview: While traveling by bus to a party event in Kozhikode, Cleatus experiences severe itching. He decides to broadcast a live video to express his discomfort. However, he soon faces difficulties when his assertions are proven to be untrue. How will Cleatus extricate himself from this predicament? What might be the cause of his intense itching? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: Lilly is the Star
videos.overview: One morning, Lilly receives a phone call from Cleatus, who informs her of an opportunity to perform with her students at a nearby upcoming shoot. Seizing this chance, Lilly starts rehearsing the dance performance with her students. Will she achieve the recognition and fame she desires? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: A Dispute Between the Mother-In-Law and Daughter-In-Law
videos.overview: One morning, Sister Omana pays a visit to Ratnamma to inquire about her health. Following an extensive discussion, she encounters Lilly and incites her against Ratnamma by spreading negative remarks about her. Upon hearing this, Lilly becomes very distressed and confronts Ratnamma, leading to a conflict between them. How will their misunderstanding be uncovered? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: The Kids' Vishu Money
videos.overview: As is customary, Cleatus and Ronald find themselves in urgent need of funds. Subsequently, they discover that the children have not yet utilized the money they received during the Vishu Celebrations. The two devise a strategy to determine who will acquire the money. Who will emerge victorious? Read on to find out more!

videos.title: Girirajan's New Farm Helper - Part 1
videos.overview: This episode opens with Girirajan alerting Cleatus to the absence of his farm helper, who has also taken some money. The team heads to the Red Spinach farm in search of him, but to their disappointment, he is not found. After returning to Kanakan's home, Lilly and Thankam have a confrontation. Later, Girirajan gets a call from his missing farm helper. What unfolds in the next part? Keep watching to find out!

videos.title: Girirajan's New Farm Helper - Part 2
videos.overview: In the latter segment of this episode, Cleatus admonishes Kishanchand, the newly appointed Bengali farm assistant employed by Girirajan, for failing to inform everyone about his location. Subsequently, a small group of Bengali workers organizes a protest at the farm, prompting Girirajan and Cleatus to leave in order to address the situation, but they end up being captured. Where has Kishanchand disappeared to? What consequences will Girirajan and Cleatus face if he cannot be located? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: A Meeting of Love and Friendship
videos.overview: Cleatus, together with his DDT Party Members, has chosen to initiate a campaign with the assistance of the opposition party. Conversely, Shashi, the leader of the RDP Party and Cleatus's rival, is strategizing his own plans. Subsequently, at home, the children engage in a dispute among themselves, which is then joined by Thankam and Lilly. After addressing these issues, Girirajan receives a call informing him of Cleatus's arrest. What will transpire next? Stay tuned to discover more!

videos.title: Spilled Mustard: Sowing Seeds of Strife
videos.overview: One morning, Ratnamma was preparing a dish in the kitchen when she asked Lilly to hand her the mustard seeds. By mistake, Lilly dropped some mustard seeds on the floor. Ratnamma remarked that the spilled mustard seeds would lead to disputes within the household. She indicated that Lilly was bound to have an argument, but Lilly, determined to disprove Ratnamma's assertions, promised not to engage in any fights that day. Will she succeed in her challenge and refute both Ratnamma and the age-old superstition? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: Red Spinach - The Root Cause of the Problem
videos.overview: One morning, Ratnamma requests the farm helper to provide her with several bundles of Red Spinach. Upon observing this, Girirajan reprimands Ratnamma for her request. Disheartened and furious, she departs from the scene. Later, upon returning home, she resolves to cut off her relationship with Girirajan due to his disrespectful behavior in front of the farm helpers. Girirajan arrives at her home and attempts various methods to soothe her, yet she remains resolute in her decision. How will Girirajan manage to appease Ratnamma and restore their relationship? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: The Mischievous Little Thief
videos.overview: One morning, Thankam was preparing Takkuddu's bag to send him to the Summer Tuition Classes, however Takkuddu pleaded with his mother not to send him. After considerable persuasion, just as they were about to depart, they realized that one pair of their footwear was missing. Meanwhile, while Kanakan and Lilly were on their way back home, they encountered Takkuddu's teacher, who expressed his concerns regarding his behavior to them. The following day, even Kanakan's one pair of footwear went missing! Who could be responsible for this theft? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: Cleatus Lands Ronald In Trouble
videos.overview: One morning, Cleatus found himself in urgent need of 500 Rupees and asked Thankam for assistance. However, Thankam declined his request, explaining that she did not possess sufficient funds to help him. While on his way to a party function in Kollam, Cleatus encountered Ronald and inquired if he could lend him money, but Ronald also lacked the necessary funds. Subsequently, Cleatus formulated a scheme that placed Ronald in a difficult position. How will he extricate himself from this predicament? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: The God in Disguise
videos.overview: One morning, when Girirajan and Thankam reaches home after returning from the temple, Lilly notices that Thankam's chain is missing! Despite an extensive search, they were unable to locate the chain, leaving Thankam feeling extremely disappointed and sorrowful. Will she be able to recover her chain? Watch now to learn more!

videos.title: Ronald Foils the Plan
videos.overview: One morning, Lilly's friend notifies her of her visit aimed at addressing her husband's alcohol addiction. Lilly conveyed to Thankam and Ronald that her friend has a tendency to boast about her lifestyle in front of others, often comparing herself to them and, as a result, insulting them. Will their plan be successful? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: Ratnamma Teaches Everyone a Lesson
videos.overview: One morning, Ratnamma receives a phone call from Girirajan, notifying her of the death of her close friend. She asked either Lilly, Thankam, or Ronald to accompany her, but none were available. Subsequently, she contacts Girirajan to come and pick her up. Upon their return, Ratnamma begins to suffer from intense stomach pain! Now, who will be willing to accompany her and Girirajan to the hospital? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: The Kudumbashree Club's Chair
videos.overview: One morning, Lilly receives a phone call notifying her that Cleatus has not yet returned the chairs he borrowed from her, which belong to the Kudumbashree Community. Lilly and Thankam ask him to return them today, and he was somewhat persuaded. At that moment, Kanakan intervened, which infuriated Cleatus, leading him to declare that he would not return the chairs under any circumstances! Now it is a showdown between Kanakan and Cleatus. Who will emerge victorious? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: A Morning Walk Gone Wrong
videos.overview: One morning, Lilly and Thankam returned home after undergoing examinations at the Medical Check-up Camp. Lilly's results were normal, but Thankam's cholesterol and sugar levels were elevated! Upon learning this, Girirajan informed Thankam that she needed to take early morning walks, where she encountered a 70-year-old man with whom she would walk and converse daily. What unfolds next? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: Akshaya Returns From Her Hostel
videos.overview: Everyone is thrilled about Akshaya's return tomorrow. Regrettably, Cleatus is unavailable as he has a meeting with an individual in Coimbatore regarding a new business opportunity. Upon learning this, Thankam becomes quite upset and begins to criticize Cleatus. Will he consent to join? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: Why is Akshaya Silent?
videos.overview: Since Akshaya's return from the hostel, she has not been communicating effectively with Thankam. Subsequently, she confides in Lilly and Ratnamma. How will Thankam respond upon discovering the truth? Stay tuned to find out more!

videos.title: Tickets for Thudarum Movie
