_verifiedMetadata.name: Bhay: The Gaurav Tiwari Story
_verifiedMetadata.description: Gaurav Tiwari, a paranormal investigator, faces his greatest challenge when his pursuit of the truth behind unexplained phenomena leads him into a deadly spiral. As his mysterious death leaves questions unanswered, a journalist delves into his eerie and celebrated legacy, unearthing secrets that blur the line between reality and the supernatural.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Scoot
_verifiedMetadata.description: This series tells the story of two young men who work together and and their allie Shyam Kandithara they intends to construct a turf and Things take a turn when they set out to buy a place.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Accidental Farmer & Co.
_verifiedMetadata.description: Inheriting a debt-ridden farming estate is hardly a dream come true, especially for a man with no direction in life. Just about having given up on the barren land, the man stumbles upon a mysterious medicinal herb. He decides to cultivate it so he can pay off the debt but ends up attracting wanted as well as some unwanted attention.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Save the Tigers
_verifiedMetadata.description: Revolves around three frustrated husbands who meet by chance and how their rants over their marital problems set off a series of crazy events.

videos.title: Mother's Day
videos.overview: Caught in a drink-and-drive case, three frustrated men spill their marital woes at the police station. The catalyst to their problems: a video shot in their kids' school.

videos.title: Tiger Meet
videos.overview: As the troubled trio continues to share the problems that led them to the bar, a famous actress, Hamsa Lekha, goes missing.

videos.title: Tigers on TV
videos.overview: At the beauty salon, the wives of the trio meet coincidentally. How will they react when they see a video on TV of their husbands wreaking havoc in a bar?

videos.title: Dikky Dikky
videos.overview: While Ganta Ravi has an eventful day at the shoot of an underwear ad and his daughter's school, Vikram is forced onto a psychologist's couch and Rahul tries to "help" his wife.

videos.title: No Pain No Gain
videos.overview: Vikram and Rekha visit the psychologist again. Fuelled by Madhuri's criticism of his generous paunch, Rahul attempts to work out.

videos.title: Rise of the Tigers
videos.overview: Everything comes full circle that lead the trio to get caught in a drink-and-drive case. Finally, the police let them go. However, they get arrested again!

videos.title: Where is Hamsalekha?
videos.overview: As CI Bhikshapathi probes Ganta Ravi, Rahul and Vikram about Hamsalekha's disappearance, they recall something important. Chaos ensues when their angry wives reach the police station.

videos.title: 7 year itch
videos.overview: Rekha, Hyma and Madhuri seek counselling from psychologist Spandana on marriage. Their husbands try to get back to serious work and decide to face their wives boldly.

videos.title: Hail Women Power
videos.overview: Rahul gets the chance of a lifetime through Hamsalekha. At Spandana's party, Rekha, Hyma and Madhuri have a gala time.

videos.title: 10000 BC
videos.overview: It's the Stone Age, and three Tigers have to survive in a women-dominated society. In 2024, the present-day Tigers wonder who invented marriage.

videos.title: Pets and Owners
videos.overview: Chaos ensues as Rahul gets a calf as a pet, shocking the society members and Laboni, his neighbour. Vikram consoles a troubled Harika. Now, why is Dimple's school calling up her parents?

videos.title: Family Celebration
videos.overview: At Dimple's celebratory event at Ganta Ravi's house, the Tigers, their wives and friends come together. However, it's not a party unless there is some unpleasantness.

videos.title: Fall of Tigers
videos.overview: Vikram meeting Harika leaves Rekha broken. Rahul rejects Vrushen Babu's lucrative offer. Ganta Ravi faces a scathing betrayal. The lives of the Tigers finally reach a crossroads.

videos.title: Marriages Are Made In Heaven
videos.overview: At their usual bar, Ganta, Rahul, and Vikram drunkenly blame Lord Indra for their misfortunes. This prompts Lord Indra to intervene with an unusual experiment.

videos.title: Neech Kameen Kuttey
videos.overview: In World 2, the Tigers are more powerful, arrogant and corrupt than ever. At the heavenly realm, Gupta and Babu hatch a risky multiverse plan to alter their fate.

videos.title: Ulta Palta
videos.overview: A baffling twist upends the Tigers' lives, leading them into an unpredictable journey. As the truth comes to light, they make a daring choice that changes everything.

videos.title: Same Same But Different
videos.overview: As the Tigers adapt to new responsibilities, their actions begin to affect those around them. Their wives grow suspicious of their unusual behaviour and decide to dig deeper.

videos.title: Free Hit
videos.overview: The Tigers are struggling to adjust to their new lives in their swapped worlds, so they decide to call Gupta. Will the call resolve their issues or make things even worse?

videos.title: Deal Breaker
videos.overview: The swap reaches a turning point when Tigers 1 return home and begin setting things right. Realising their true happiness lies with their families, they decide to contact Gupta.

videos.title: Clash Of Tigers
videos.overview: A dramatic clash erupts when the truth is revealed and the two sets of Tigers come face to face. Will they stay in the new world or return to where they truly belong?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Single Papa
_verifiedMetadata.description: When Gaurav finds a baby in the back of his car, he must defy his eccentric family, the adoption agency and societal norms to become a single papa.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Engga Hostel
_verifiedMetadata.description: The relatable and curious life inside a Tamil Nadu engineering hostel by capturing the trials and tribulations of 6 engineering students and their struggles with identity, friendship, love, life and academics

_verifiedMetadata.name: Bad Trip
_verifiedMetadata.description: A shared cab ride presents a group of people the opportunity to get rich quickly. What seems like an easy job turns into a web of nightmares for the gang.

videos.title: Shotgun
videos.overview: Ved visits Hyderabad to convince his parents that he is not ready for marriage. At the railway station, he books a shared cab and then befriends fellow riders. At one of the drop-points, they all get into a nightmarish situation.

videos.title: A Bridge Too Far
videos.overview: Ved, Abhi, and Santosh get a once-in-life opportunity to get rich but they part ways as it's too risky. They get back to their lives and try to forget the night's events but the allure of money is too strong to ignore.

videos.title: Crash Course
videos.overview: Jo joins Ved, Abhi and Santosh. They plan the kidnap and go after Reva. But Reva has her own plans for the night.

videos.title: Pit Crew Party
videos.overview: As the gang fight among themselves over the failure of their plan, a new opportunity to kidnap Reva presents itself. They improvise and go after her. But first, they have to find a way to work together as a group.

videos.title: Gasolina
videos.overview: The gang manages to get inside Reva's villa and tie her up. But they find out that Reva is hosting an all-nighter and her friends are on their way to the villa. As they scramble to find their next move, things take a turn for the worse.

videos.title: Clutch Control
videos.overview: The gang decides to cut out the middleman and contact the client directly. Ved comes up with an out-of-the-box idea to get client details from the girls. Jo has other plans.

videos.title: Changing Lanes
videos.overview: Jo tries to convince Ved and turn him to her side. Abhi finds out the information from the girls. But a man in a clown mask comes out of nowhere and changes the game.

videos.title: Nitro Nightfall
videos.overview: The gang finds out that the whole thing is a bad, bad trip.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Vinny Ki Kitaab
_verifiedMetadata.description: Vinny appears to be an ordinary housewife living a quiet, routine life — but behind closed doors, her mind is a world of erotic fantasies and secret desires. Through these vivid, intimate stories she escapes the monotony of everyday life with her husband. Only one person knows the truth about her hidden world: her best friend, Sarla. But when her private stories are stolen and published, she is shocked to discover that betrayal comes from those she trusted most. Forced out of the shadows, Vinny sets out to reclaim her voice, her truth, and her life.

videos.title: Hot Pink Nighty
videos.overview: On her 10th wedding anniversary, Vinny prepares to turn her secret fantasies into reality, dressing up in a hot pink nighty and an expensive perfume to surprise her husband. As anticipation builds, one question hangs in the air - will the night fulfill her desires, or will her dreams remain locked in her imagination, to be shared only with her best friend Sarla?

videos.title: Dil, Dosti, Dhokha
videos.overview: Vinny's world shatters when her most private stories and deepest secrets are exposed for everyone to read. Consumed by shock and shame, she is forced to confront a devastating truth — the ultimate betrayal has come from the people she trusted most.

videos.title: Women On Top
videos.overview: Crushed by guilt, Vinny struggles to hold herself together. And just as she begins to feel her self worth again , the discovery of Navneet’s betrayal shatters her world, igniting a storm of anger, pain, and resolve that will change everything.

videos.title: Haseen Badla
videos.overview: Armed with her charm and sharp wit, she sets out to outsmart and punish those who betrayed her — determined to reclaim what was always rightfully hers. She will spare no one.

videos.title: Neeli Shirt
videos.overview: Vinny deepens her dangerous game of seduction with Manish, while Navneet faces a brutal reckoning of his own. At the same time, Sarla makes a shocking discovery that sends the Saxena household into complete chaos.

videos.title: Haq Aur Husn
videos.overview: Sarla publicly exposes Vinny as the author of the erotic bestseller Vinny Ki Kitab. What was meant to destroy her, instead ignites a fierce transformation — Vinny finds her voice, embraces her truth, and rises in a roar of empowerment, reclaiming her identity, her power, and the life that was always hers to own.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Ayali
_verifiedMetadata.description: Young Tamizhselvi dreams of becoming a doctor. But her village, Veerappannai, has fearsome age-old customs and traditions which inadvertently suppress women of the village. Will she be able to overcome them?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Anger Tales
_verifiedMetadata.description: An anthology bringing alive the various hues of anger, telling the stories of four ordinary people belonging to different socio-economic backgrounds.

videos.title: Benefit Show
videos.overview: Ranga organises a show of his favourite star's latest movie. When a local leader buys 200 tickets to show off his power, Ranga's self-respect is put at stake.

videos.title: Food Festival
videos.overview: A hard-core non-vegetarian, Pooja, gets married into a 'health-conscious vegetarian' family. Her dietary struggle continues until she falls ill and another struggle begins.

videos.title: An Afternoon Nap
videos.overview: Radha lives a tranquil life with her husband in an old house. Her peace is disturbed by her landlord, which puts her marital life in jeopardy.

videos.title: Helmet Head
videos.overview: Giri is unhappy about his baldness and the nature of his work. When he finally finds the solution to one of his problems, a shock awaits him.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Real Kashmir Football Club
_verifiedMetadata.description: Inspired by the true story of a Kashmiri Hindu Pandit and a Kashmiri Muslim responsible for the formation of the Real Kashmir Football Club, the first ever club from Jammu and Kashmir to compete in any top-flight football league in India.

videos.title: Kickoff
videos.overview: Disillusioned with journalism, Sohail wants to change Kashmir for the better by starting a professional football club. He attempts to recruit his oldest friend Mustafa to coach RKFC and solicits funding from businessman Shirish - who knows nothing about football.

videos.title: Pressing
videos.overview: With financier Shirish and coach Mustafa onboard, and having selected a squad of players, Sohail must take care of formalities to ensure RKFC complies with league requirements.

videos.title: In Possession
videos.overview: In order to be accepted into a league-qualifying tournament, RKFC must recruit local star Shah - which proves difficult for Sohail as Shah has a confrontational history with Mustafa.

videos.title: Transition To Defence
videos.overview: Shah joins the club and they travel to Delhi for the tournament, where things couldn't go worse - both on and off the field.

videos.title: Own-Goal
videos.overview: After the Delhi fiasco, strife has increased and it appears that various players have dropped. Sohail must find a way to keep Mustafa, re-sign Shah, and appease Shirish, who now wants to be more involved with club management.

videos.title: Regroup
videos.overview: After Sohail agrees with Shirish that they should bring in an international coach to increase RKFC's chances for success, it gets ugly when he informs Mustafa of this decision.

videos.title: Counterattack
videos.overview: After international coach Douglas arrives and sees what a challenge it is to mount a club in Srinagar, Sohail and Shirish slowly move the club closer to league qualification.

videos.title: Goal!
videos.overview: When the players learn that RKFC's pathway to qualification is to play a security forces team at the local cantonment, a debate ensues as to whether they should participate in the match or not.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Story of Things
_verifiedMetadata.description: An anthology of five stories that follow characters who experience supernatural occurrences through material objects around them.

videos.title: Weighing Scale
videos.overview: When Ram and Titus, aspiring actors, are close to grabbing a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, a moment of carelessness endangers the life of a stranger. Titus, ridden with guilt, urges Ram to surrender to the police, but Ram refuses to let go of the aspirational life he craves. Things take an eerie turn when the latter is haunted by a weighing device he finds in his late grandmother’s belongings that weighs his sins in addition to his body weight.

videos.title: Cellular
videos.overview: Having been raised in the shadow of her mother, Vannamayil decides to do as she likes for once, and the unfortunate happens. But Vannamayil gets the scare of her life when she gets an otherworldly call.

videos.title: Compressor
videos.overview: When Raghu chances upon a bundle of cash, he asks his live-in girlfriend Shruthi to either plan a vacation for the two, or buy an air conditioner. She buys a second-hand AC, and the object begins to trouble Raghu. When he goes missing all of a sudden, Shruthi begins to investigate.

videos.title: Car
videos.overview: Britto is on a brave quest to overcome the fear of his abusive father and his car. Every time his mother questioned his father for beating him, little Britto would get locked up by his father in his car with a watchdog standing guard. Inside that dark and dingy car, Britto’s fears manifest in many forms. Decades later, Britto decides to fight back, but the ghosts of his past return.

videos.title: Mirror
videos.overview: After he is thrown out of his hostel, Sethu, who is suffering a terrible break-up, moves into the attic of an old house. He questions his own sanity for a moment when a ten-year-old girl named Nazia talks to him through an old dresser mirror.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Puli Meka
_verifiedMetadata.description: A serial killer is targeting police officers in Hyderabad. A female cop in charge of the Special Investigation Team and a forensic expert race against time to find the culprit.

videos.title: The Hunt Begins
videos.overview: The commissioner of police, Anurag Narayan assigns officer Kiran Prabha to the case of a serial killer targeting police officers. Forensic expert Prabhakar Sharma also gets appointed to the case.

videos.title: Case Closed?
videos.overview: Prabhakar Sharma falls in love with Kiran and tries to find ways to express his feelings. Meanwhile, the prime suspect gets arrested. Another police officer gets killed. Who is the culprit?

videos.title: Killer in Disguise
videos.overview: The investigation team discovers that the killer disguises himself as an animal. On the other hand, Prabhakar confronts his elder brother Karunakar, who tells him that he has disowned the family.

videos.title: The Twist
videos.overview: The department is shocked when the disguised serial killer attacks Kiran. Prabhakar realises who the real culprit is!

videos.title: Kiran's Past
videos.overview: Kiran's past reveals the incidents that have made her the vengeful police officer that she is today. However, the memories of a dear friendship help her in surviving.

videos.title: A Parallel Investigation
videos.overview: Karunakar has a moment of epiphany when he sees his father's popularity and respect in society. Commissioner Narayan starts a parallel investigation with suspended encounter specialist, Emmanuel.

videos.title: Justice
videos.overview: A series of kidnappings and interrogations lead to a shocking revelation about the story of a girl, Pallavi, who is cornered for objecting to the use of narcotics at a party.

videos.title: The Next Target
videos.overview: Emmanuel drops out of the case after sharing a few clues with the commissioner. His investigation reveals the commissioner to be the next target. Will the culprit be caught before it's too late?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Aukaat Ke Bahar
_verifiedMetadata.description: A small-town boxer enters an elite Delhi college to fulfill his brother's dream. He faces bullying and class discrimination while falling for an ambitious senior student, forcing him to fight for love and dignity.

videos.title: Safeedon Se Dilli Tak
videos.overview: Rajveer Ahlawat, a fearless boxer from Safidon, Haryana, joins Delhi’s elite St. Collin’s College to fulfill his brother’s dream of becoming a suited-booted-jaat. But when Rajveer is humiliated at the fresher’s party for being a small-town boy, he takes on a bold challenge: to date a senior girl within three months.

videos.title: Dream Wali Girl
videos.overview: After the fresher’s party, Rajveer dreams of a girl in a mustard field. The next morning, he spots Antara Shukla and follows her to the Literary Society. When Antara stands up for him against bullies, Rajveer declares that she is the senior he will date—unaware that she’s already seeing a Master’s student Devraj.

videos.title: Chhora Hua Viral
videos.overview: Rajbala questions why someone like Antara would ever date Rajveer. He has no answer but stays determined. When Antara’s rival Manas Chauhan steals credit for her cleanliness drive, Rajveer makes a video exposing his ruse. Antara watches the video in rage —who asked for his help? Rajveer has unknowingly sparked a storm.

videos.title: Plan Hua Backfire
videos.overview: Antara publicly berates Rajveer for making the video, even dragging his late brother into it. Unable to hear a word against his brother, Rajveer storms off to Safidon. At home, memories of Karanveer flood back. On the terrace, he recalls the fated night - when Karanveer’s body was brought home.

videos.title: Bhool Chook Maaf
videos.overview: Rajveer’s friends, Jogi and Rajbala visit Safidon to cheer Rajveer up. Meanwhile, Antara regrets berating Rajveer after his video goes viral. When Rajveer returns to Delhi, Antara apologizes to Rajveer invites him to join her party. He agrees—on one condition: she must teach Rajveer, Jogi and Rajbala, English.

videos.title: Jahan Chah Wahan Raah
videos.overview: Rajveer starts English lessons with Antara and joins her student political party. Proud, he messages his late brother, telling him how he has finally become part of the “shehri log”. But spotting Antara with Devraj crushes him. Then comes a chance: to support Antara in a fundraising race, and prove Dev wrong.

videos.title: Main Hoon Naa
videos.overview: Focused on fundraising, Rajveer begins to drift apart from Jogi and Rajbala. Rajbala gets suspended for giving his proxy, but Rajveer ignores her message. Heartbroken, she leaves for Safidon. Meanwhile, Antara’s pregnant sister goes into labor—and Rajveer steps up to take control of the situation and help.

videos.title: Ek Nayi Shuruaat
videos.overview: At the hospital, Antara shares her abandonment issues with Rajveer, bringing them closer. For the fundraising Rajveer creates a video urging brands to invest in their college, and students like them. The video goes viral, and bond grows—but a jealous Devraj watches from the shadows and begins plotting his revenge in cahoots with Manas.

videos.title: Iss Pyaar Ko Kya Naam Du?
videos.overview: At Antara’s niece’s naamkaran ceremony, Rajveer impresses Antara by helping out with work and shutting down her jijuand Dev’s sexist remarks. When Rajveer learns that it’s Antara’s birthday the next day, he plans a surprise. But before he can act, Dev proposes to Antara—leaving Rajveer heartbroken in the crowd.

videos.title: Bade Bhai Ka Sach
videos.overview: Heartbroken, Rajveer vents to Jogi on the terrace—until a call changes everything: his mother’s had a heart attack. Back in Safidon, Rajveer’s haunted by memories of Karanveer’s death, how it was Rajveer’s impulsiveness that caused it. Meanwhile, Antara finds Rajveer’s surprise birthday setup—and realizes she misses him.

videos.title: Besht Junior
videos.overview: Rajveer returns to Delhi, still weighed down by grief. Meanwhile, Antara learns of Manas’ shady campaign tactics in the PG area and decides to rally there. Dev tips off Manas, who incites a riot. Chaos erupts, and just as Antara gets hit by a bottle bomb, Rajveer charges in heroically — catching the bottle with his hand and saving her.

videos.title: Sports Quota Zindabad!
videos.overview: Rajveer saves Antara and inspires her to lead, reminding her that true leaders rise in crisis. Antara steps up, gives a fiery speech and controls the crowd. But moments later, Antara faints from exhaustion. Rajveer carries her to the clinic, where they share some tender moments—until Antara receives a shocking video.

videos.title: Farak Padta Hai
videos.overview: Neel posts a video accusing Antara of two-timing Devraj and Rajveer. Furious, Rajveer storms into the gym and beats Neel. Antara urges him to calm down, but Rajveer confesses his love and walks away. Stunned, Antara realizes he’s always supported her. When Dev confronts her, she breaks up with him.

videos.title: Pehli Wali Chahat
videos.overview: That night, Rajveer realises that the girl in his dreams has been Antara all this while - realizing He's in love. But their joy is short-lived as Rajveer’s mother needs urgent surgery, and their home is being sold. Determined, Rajveer vows to raise the funds. Antara suggests a DU boxing match with a prize money, but soon learns Rajveer’s been expelled for beating Neel.

videos.title: Knockout!
videos.overview: Rajveer searches for Antara at the arena, unaware she’s struck a deal with Manas to stop his expulsion, at the cost of withdrawing her own candidature. After Rajveer wins the match, they go on their date. But even there, Dev intrudes and shows Antara the ‘date with senior’ bet that Rajveer made. Heartbroken, Antara leaves, and Rajveer loses everything.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Fall
_verifiedMetadata.description: An accident followed by memory loss has Divya trying to piece her life together. Will her near and dear ones support her quest for the truth?

videos.title: Plunged into Darkness
videos.overview: It's been six months since Divya's fall, and she is still in a coma. Rohit and Daniel try to sell her sports centre. Upon hitting a roadblock, Rohit does the unthinkable.

videos.title: Waking Up from the Abyss
videos.overview: As Divya tries to recollect the events of the fateful night, Rohit panics when he learns that she is out of her coma. Meanwhile, Daniel gets closer to Maya.

videos.title: Web of Lies
videos.overview: Caught secretly filming women and selling drugs at the sports centre, Ilango becomes a suspect in Divya’s fall. Moreover, a break-in raises further suspicion.

videos.title: What Lies Beneath
videos.overview: Divya tries to piece her memories together. While Rohit learns the actual value of the property and acts swiftly to sell it, Daniel digs deeper into Rohit’s past to stop him.

videos.title: Prey in the Shadows
videos.overview: Divya's suspicion against her brother grows stronger when she learns of his financial troubles. With Divya on the warpath, Rohit and Daniel take desperate measures to stop her.

videos.title: Truth Unwinds
videos.overview: When Malar learns the truth about Rohit, she shares her concerns with Divya. Things take an interesting turn when she reveals his whereabouts on the night of her fall.

videos.title: The Fall
videos.overview: Divya confronts Maya and learns shocking truths about her accident. Lakshmi forces Jeeva to leave the country to stop Divya from finding the final missing piece in the puzzle.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Nuvvu Evaru
_verifiedMetadata.description: An NRI techie reunites with his wife after her two-month Indian vacation only to realize that her behavior, habits and actions have significantly changed. And hours later, his actual wife arrives.

videos.title: Programmed Chaos...!
videos.overview: Episode overview not available

_verifiedMetadata.name: Seher hone ko hai
_verifiedMetadata.description: Strong-willed Kausar defies societal barriers for her daughter Seher's big dreams, but will destiny stand by their side?

videos.title: Secrets Surface at a Family Picnic
Seher Flies a Kite With Mahid
Can Seher Truly Hide Her Pain?
Husna Forces Kausar to Reveal Truth
Mahid Ends His Marriage with Seher
Mahid Urges Seher to Move On
Fatima and Wasim's Web of Deceit
Mahid Gets Seher and Kausar Home
Seher and Mahid Spy on the Family
Husna's Big Move to Win Mahid's Trust
Seher, Kausar Run for Their Lives
Mahid and Seher Search for Kausar
Seher Walks Out of Mahid's Life
Mahid Plans a Surprise for Seher
Husna sparks a clash with Seher

_verifiedMetadata.name: Vadhandhi
_verifiedMetadata.description: Vivek, a diligent cop, takes charge of the investigation of the murder of a beautiful young girl, Velonie. The rumours about her that spring up post her death threatens to irrevocably damage Velonie's image, Vivek must wade through a web of half-truths and confusing leads to solve the case.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Meet Cute
_verifiedMetadata.description: Meet Cute takes you through five instances of Two strangers, unexpectedly, find solace in each other’s company while navigating through tricky phases in their lives, helping them look at themselves and their loved ones in a different light.

videos.title: Meet the Boy
videos.overview: An independent Swathi is forced by her mother to meet ‘dude no 11’ aka Abhi for dinner. He might look sweet and be chivalrous but she’s wary of anyone who seems too good to be true.

videos.title: Old Is Gold
videos.overview: An old man, Mohan Rao, keeping a young woman, Saroja as company as they wait in a long line at the consulate. The former might have a lot to teach the latter, especially when it comes to her relationship with her husband Jay.

videos.title: In L(aw)ove
videos.overview: Padma on a mission to find out more about Pooja, the girl her son Siddhu is apparently dating. While sceptical about her at first, she finds out they just might have more in common than their love for animals and her son.

videos.title: Star Struck
videos.overview: Dr. Aman offers a lift to popular actress Shalini on a rainy night. He doesn’t know who she is and she revels in the anonymity, even if for a few hours. The two get talking about love, romance and everything in between.

videos.title: Ex - Girl Friend
videos.overview: Anjana, frustrated with her stoic husband Ajay who’d rather take her on expensive dates than express his feelings. One fateful day, she finds herself in the company of his ex-girlfriend Kiran. Will this person from his past be the key to Anjana finally understanding Ajay?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Perfect Family
_verifiedMetadata.description: A Punjabi family appears happy but deals with hidden issues, attending therapy together to address mental health and family bonds while fighting cultural stigma.

videos.title: Kidhar Hai Chot?
videos.overview: A “perfect” family hits its breaking point when tensions finally explode. Their only way forward now - starts with therapy.

videos.title: From The Top
videos.overview: The Karkarias walk into therapy pretending to be fine, but cracks widen under pressure. Will their masks hold, or will the truth push through?

videos.title: Marriage Material
videos.overview: Love, marriage and expectations collide as old hurts quietly resurface. Some bonds strengthen, others complicate.

videos.title: The 12th Birthday of Daani Karkaria
videos.overview: A birthday celebration turns into a mirror for everyone's happiness. But no party stays perfect when buried emotions show up uninvited.

videos.title: Empathy: Mothers & Daughters
videos.overview: The women of the family confront the childhoods that shaped them. Old wounds reopen, but so do chances to heal.

videos.title: Empathy: Fathers & Sons
videos.overview: A trip meant for bonding turns into a confrontation with buried fears. One moment changes everything for the men of the family.

videos.title: Coping
videos.overview: When life spirals, everyone finds their own way to survive - some healthy, some dangerous. And one announcement shakes the entire family.

videos.title: Family is Everything
videos.overview: A wellness retreat forces the Karkarias to drop their guards and face each other honestly. But healing isn't peaceful, especially for a family learning to love again.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Pettaikaali
_verifiedMetadata.description: To marry the girl he loves, the hero tames a bull that belongs to her with deceptive tricks. His frivolous act rekindles the bygone animosity between the families that prompts several problems.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Aha Naa Pellanta
_verifiedMetadata.description: Seenu, a young man who is desperate for marriage, lands at a suitable match with great difficulty. While he's relieved about tying the knot at last, comes the twist, when the bride elopes with her boyfriend.

videos.title: Therasala
videos.overview: Sinu narrates a childhood incident that prompted him to vow to never flirt with any girl before marriage. Now an adult, he finally finds his match in Sudha, who elopes on their wedding day.

videos.title: Pani Grahanam
videos.overview: Sinu moves to Hyderabad to pursue a job and stays with his friends Dass and Bala. Sudha’s father meets Sinu and convinces him to abduct Sudha’s accomplice Maha.

videos.title: Brahma Mudi
videos.overview: Ready to avenge himself, Sinu and his friends abduct Maha a day before her wedding. While Sudha’s father plans to kill the girl, Sinu saves her. They together leave for Hyderabad to start afresh.

videos.title: Sapatha Padi
videos.overview: On reaching Hyderabad, Maha is rejected by her family. Stuck, helpless, and alone, she has nowhere to go. Sinu witnesses her situation and hesitantly offers her shelter at his place.

videos.title: Arundhati Nakshaatram
videos.overview: In order to stop Maha from filing a complaint, Sinu asks one of his friends to impersonate a police officer. As the footage of the abduction goes missing, Sudha’s father continues to threaten Maha.

videos.title: Jeelakarra Bellam
videos.overview: Friendship and love brew between Sinu and Maha during their stay together. Maha, however, faces problems with her ex over a house promised in dowry. An angry Maha reveals why she helped Sudha elope.

videos.title: Madhuparakam
videos.overview: Sinu helps in solving Maha’s house issue. As Sinu’s wedding gets fixed with another girl, both realise their love for each other. But Sudha’s father exposes Sinu as Maha's abductor to her father.

videos.title: Mangalasoothra Dhaarana
videos.overview: Maha decides to profess her love for Sinu but gets to know the story behind her abduction. A heartbroken Maha decides to leave the country, but the lovers are once again brought together by fate.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Ekaki
_verifiedMetadata.description: A group of friends plan a fun weekend getaway to the mysterious Ekaki Villa, only to find themselves caught between laughter and fear when strange haunting begin. Filled with hilarious chaos, spooky twists, and emotional moments

videos.name: Chapter 1 : Presence
videos.overview: Seven friends reunite for a weekend getaway at a secluded villa, hoping for a fun break from routine. Their cheerful atmosphere slowly shifts as strange, unsettling events begin to occur around the house. What starts as harmless banter turns into confusion and fear as the group senses an unseen presence lurking within the villa.
videos.description: Seven friends reunite for a weekend getaway at a secluded villa, hoping for a fun break from routine. Their cheerful atmosphere slowly shifts as strange, unsettling events begin to occur around the house. What starts as harmless banter turns into confusion and fear as the group senses an unseen presence lurking within the villa.

_verifiedMetadata.name: TamilRockerz
_verifiedMetadata.description: Tamil Rockerz, an anonymous cyber pirates are threatening to release a highly anticipated film featuring a massively popular star. It's up to the cop Rudra to find the lawbreakers and bring them to justice.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Jhansi
_verifiedMetadata.description: Jhansi, a boutique owner, is an independent woman staying with her partner and his daughter, but an amnesiac. When she saves a girl from a molester at a wedding, Jhansi’s past catches up with her and rekindles several bitter memories from her childhood and the violence follows.

videos.title: Glitches
videos.overview: Memories of a horrid past haunt Jhansi and endanger the happy world she has made for herself. On top of that, an unexpected event forces her to face her other life.

videos.title: Man from the Past
videos.overview: Worried about what she has done, Jhansi meets a man from her past. International don John Caleb rules his cartel with a ruthless hand. Meanwhile, Dhruva fights for his love, Kriti.

videos.title: The Dark Box
videos.overview: A flash of her past puts Jhansi on the trail of Ripukumar, a notorious child trafficker. Back home, a little girl goes missing in Jhansi's colony.

videos.title: Another Murder
videos.overview: At Ripukumar's house, Jhansi meets Savithri, who gives her answers and tells her about her best pal, Barbie. Back home, a tragedy strikes Jhansi's colony.

videos.title: The Vigilante
videos.overview: As Sakshi probes Satya's murder. Amsa Begum reunites with her son, Thayib, who has an agenda. When Sankeeth worries about Jhansi, with Dhruva's help, she strikes again.

videos.title: Billu's Club
videos.overview: Sankeeth accuses Jhansi of neglecting the family. Sakshi begins suspecting Dhruva of the murders. Meanwhile, the breadcrumbs lead Jhansi and Dhruva to Goa.

videos.title: Love and Betrayal
videos.overview: Ameesha tells Jhansi about Billu and her past life at his club. With Barbie's whereabouts worrying her, she is shocked to learn about Ethan and his child.

videos.title: Italian Panna Cotta
videos.overview: Furious that Jhansi is alive, Caleb comes to India for her. As Jhansi shares her past with Sankeeth, Sakshi confronts her about the murders.

videos.title: The Wrong Turn
videos.overview: Amsa Begum recounts her past that's intertwined with Jhansi's. While Caleb gets ready for another consignment, a devastating piece of news reaches Jhansi.

videos.title: The Beginning of the End
videos.overview: As Jhansi attends her friend's funeral, Sakshi arrives to arrest her. Caleb decides to eliminate Jhansi, Amsa Begum and the gang, resulting in a final face-off.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Naa Tum Jaano Naa Hum
_verifiedMetadata.description: Aditi feels an unexpected attraction to her father's friend, Sandeep, sparking a complicated and intense connection. As social pressure grows, hiding their bond becomes harder. Can their relationship survive society's judgment?

videos.title: The First Spark
videos.overview: Feeling distant from her boyfriend Karan, Aditi meets her father’s friend Sandeep, and an unexpected spark of attraction quietly takes root. Could this be the start of something unexpected?

videos.title: Crossing Lines
videos.overview: A sudden, accidental moment sparks unexpected emotions in Sandeep. Torn between what’s right and what he feels, can he resist the pull of this forbidden connection?

videos.title: Point of No Return
videos.overview: Aditi and Sandeep’s closeness pushes every boundary, taking their secret bond to a point of no return. How long before the world uncovers the truth?

videos.title: The No-Ball Lie.
videos.overview: A family watches cricket as Sandy avoids lunch, lying about a meeting. Aditi waits for him, feels ignored, confronts him privately, and seductively reveals the “gift” she prepared.

videos.title: Forced Fate.
videos.overview: Aditi confronts Sandy after he lies about traveling. Feeling used and betrayed, she demands marriage immediately, giving him till midnight—otherwise she threatens to force the relationship forward.

videos.title: House Of Lies.
videos.overview: Aditi demands marriage and threatens to expose everything. Sandy panics, torn between guilt and fear. Nitin unknowingly asks Sandy to counsel her. As pressure peaks, Sandy’s wife walks in, exposing his lies.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Emoji
_verifiedMetadata.description: Aadhav and Deeksha, a vibrant young couple are about to be separated as passion pulls them apart. Can love win them back together?

videos.title: Emoji Episode 1
videos.overview: Aadhav visits Decathlon, by the twist of fate he meets Prathana there. He eventually becomes a regular customer for her sake, until one day he decides to let her know his real intention.

videos.title: Emoji Episode 2
videos.overview: When Aadhav and Dheeksha travel to a lively village, a new bond bloom between them. Meera tries to flirt with Aadhav which triggers Dheeksha’s possessiveness and prompts her to grow closer to Aadhav.

videos.title: Emoji Episode 3
videos.overview: The past unfolds where Prathana accepts Aadhav’s proposal and they wallow in love. A new couple moves next door to Aadhav’s flat, both the couples forge a friendship.

videos.title: Emoji Episode 4
videos.overview: Aadhav struggles to set his life back on an even keel after an unfortunate event. Simultaneously Dheeksha also goes through a rough phase because of her narcissistic boyfriend.

videos.title: Emoji Episode 5
videos.overview: Aadhav and Dheeksha’s friendship starts to flourish while they try to mend each other. Impulsive Aadhav dashes to the Bandhipur forest to pull off his heart’s desire.

videos.title: Emoji Episode 6
videos.overview: Impressed by Aadhav’s efforts, Dheeksha makes a big decision, her friends and family feels jubilant about it. Deeksha and Aadhav goes to her familial house in Kerala.

videos.title: Emoji Episode 7
videos.overview: An unforeseen plight disrupts their smooth sailing relationship. They both mutually come to a conclusion with a heavy heart.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Hello World
_verifiedMetadata.description: Eight youngsters join a renowned IT company assuming that their struggles are over. But, their excitement is short-lived when they realise that life has more in store for them than they had imagined.

videos.title: IT Calling
videos.overview: A bunch of youngsters from diverse backgrounds get an offer letter from PeopleTech. Later, they are shocked when a senior employee informs them that they will become permanent employees only if they fulfil certain conditions.

videos.title: Oops, Life Sucks Again
videos.overview: The interns rush out of their dorms to reach the office on time. Pravallika takes revenge on Varun for ragging her during their college days. Raghav, the Chief Learning Officer, has an important advice for the interns.

videos.title: Salary Credited
videos.overview: The first salary arrives, and the interns spend it as they wish. The boys decide to booze, but learn that alcohol is banned on campus. They devise a plan, but all hell breaks loose when the security guards see through their trick.

videos.title: Break-Point
videos.overview: Varun uses his uncle's influence and saves the gang from losing their jobs. Everyone attempts their first-term exams. The results are disappointing for Varsha, Suresh, and Varun.

videos.title: New Beginnings
videos.overview: Raghav promises to complete a challenging project with the help of the interns. A confidential document is found lying at the reception because of Suresh's ignorance, and Debashish threatens to fire him.

videos.title: Life Is a Scrum
videos.overview: Varsha decides to pursue the match suggested by her parents. Varun understands the importance of true love when Richa breaks up with him. Raghav kickstarts the project by onboarding the interns.

videos.title: Error 404
videos.overview: Prarthana takes a heartbroken Rahul under her wing. Debashish creates obstacles for Raghav's project, but the interns come together and take up the challenge to support Raghav.

videos.title: Exception Handling
videos.overview: Raghav suffers a heart attack. The interns are close to finishing the project but need Venkat's approval. Prarthana steps in to take up the responsibility in Raghav's absence. The team breaches office protocol to accomplish the impossible.

_verifiedMetadata.name: CO-ED
_verifiedMetadata.description: Twins Shikha and Nikhil couldn't be more different. But when their all-boys and all-girls schools suddenly go co-ed, the chaos of teenagehood hits them head-on. Now, both must confront new feelings, friendships, and the messy business of growing up together.

videos.title: Unity, Learning, And Respect
videos.overview: Two sister schools in Udaipur announce they'll merge into one co-educational school. Shikha's thrilled, Nikhil's anxious. At home, parents chase their own dreams as old walls begin to break.

videos.title: Scarmates
videos.overview: The co-ed term begins in chaos. Students fight over seats and rules till a handball match sparks new friendships. Nikhil loses his topper spot but finds a friend who changes his view.

videos.title: Am I your Type?
videos.overview: When their parents are away, the twins make plans with friends and get caught. Shikha must now pass her test to prove she can stay in co-ed!

videos.title: We Will Win This Together!
videos.overview: Sports Day brings excitement, rumors, and rivalry. As competition intensifies, the twins realize the importance of learning what it truly means to stand together.

videos.title: ⁠Efforts Waala Sorry...
videos.overview: Shikha and Nikhil skip school after a Sports Day incident. Their day out builds bonds but leads to trouble at home. An investor's interest in their mom sparks family conflict.

videos.title: Sweet Sixteen
videos.overview: It's the twins' birthday, but nothing feels normal. Tensions rise at home as unspoken conflicts surface. The Parwanis must find a way to hold on to each other as things start to change.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Victim
_verifiedMetadata.description: Four different people fall victim to their situations and must face the consequences of their actions. The choices they now make will define their outcomes.

videos.title: Kottai Paaku Vathalum Mottai Maadi Sitharum

_verifiedMetadata.name: Agent Anand Santosh
_verifiedMetadata.description: A quick-witted, aspiring detective strives to grow up as a professional, and he struggles to cope with the sluggish agency old personnel in which he is working.

videos.title: It's Meghana sir
videos.overview: Agent Anand Santosh runs a detective agency with his sidekick Ayomayam, dealing with petty cases in their neighbourhood. However, the situation escalated when he is tasked to find a missing girl. How our Agent using his quirky yet effective methods solves the case becomes the story.

videos.title: Are Entra Idi
videos.overview: The budding romance between Agent Anand Santosh and Alankrita takes a sudden turn when his livelihood of being a detective comes into question. Coincidently, he finds a job at a detective agency but has to deal with new problems.

videos.title: Chala Unnai... Dacham
videos.overview: Agent’s first case is to investigate and recover the stolen tire of an expensive car. Unlike his usual style, he has to devise a plan, present it to the team for approval, and work within a specific budget. However, Agent and Ayomayam find the robbers, but there is more to the case than the stolen tire.

videos.title: Daagudumoota Dandakor
videos.overview: After finding out drug papers in the stolen tyre, Agent returns the tyre without drugs to the owner and gives him a stern warning against dealing with drugs. Expecting appreciation for solving his first case, Agent left disappointed since he was asked to bear the expenses in return. A new case anchors that itself is a challenge.

videos.title: Pakdo Pakdo
videos.overview: As Agent struggles to find any clue in the iPhone theft case, he tries to build a new friendship to help him solve the case. With the help of his friend, he manages to locate the thief, but he has unwanted baggage in the shape of Sharma. The rest of the story is about how our Agent helps Sharma and manages to catch the thief.

videos.title: Haridas
videos.overview: Agent is assigned to deal with Agency's first costly case, the client was cheated when he placed an order for a branded shoe and he received a counterfeit.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Maa Neella Tank
_verifiedMetadata.description: In Buchivolu village, Sarpanch Kodandam's son Gopal threatens to jump off a water tank for his crush Surekha. With his image and career at stake, Kodandam appoints SI Vamshi to find Surekha, who is missing.

videos.title: The Idea of Self-Murder
videos.overview: Surekha runs away from home. Gopal climbs onto the tank and blames his father Kodandam for Surekha's disappearance. Gurumurthy requests inspector Vamshi to find Surekha. Vamshi learns about Surekha's whereabouts.

videos.title: A Favour And Fraud
videos.overview: Vamshi lies to Surekha to gain her trust and takes her back to the village. Surekha is shocked to discover the truth upon her return. Vamshi feels shattered after Gurumurthy's shocking revelation about the transfer letter.

videos.title: Celebrating the Chaos
videos.overview: Surekha has no choice and gets back to the fancy store. Her family is upset with her but decides to go ahead with her marriage to get rid of her.

videos.title: Alliance or Anguish?
videos.overview: Surekha's parents visit Gopal's house, and Chamundi approves of the marriage but puts forth a condition. Surekha is upset as the fancy store shuts and is taken over by a new owner.

videos.title: Planning the Twist
videos.overview: Vamshi learns some shocking facts from Gopal about his love for Surekha. Vamshi rushes to check on Surekha, who plans to leave again. At Kodandam's house, the priest is called to fix the marriage date.

videos.title: The Selfie-ish Love
videos.overview: Surekha and Vamshi believe that Narasimham can help Surekha get rid of her impending marriage with Gopal. Narasimham strikes a deal with Kodandam concerning the marriage and keeps the water tank repair in the loop.

videos.title: Love and Its Side Effects
videos.overview: Narasimham tries to establish himself as a true leader. Gopal and Surekha's engagement begins. Vamshi feels guilty for his mistakes and tries to apologise.

videos.title: Agreeing to Disagree
videos.overview: Vamshi and Surekha make some shocking revelations to the villagers. Will Surekha get married to Gopal? Will the villagers of Buchivolu hope for a better future as the next elections approach?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Search: The Naina Murder Case
_verifiedMetadata.description: A veteran cop gets mired in a high-profile murder case when a girl is found dead in a politician's car. With multiple suspects, how will she unmask the killer?

videos.title: Skeletons in the Closet
videos.overview: Just as ACP Sanyukta Das prepares to sign off, a new case lands on her desk. Forced to team up with her eccentric replacement, ACP Jai Kanwal, she faces a day unlike any other.

videos.title: Writing on the Wall
videos.overview: As Sanyukta and Jai follow the victim's trail, the grieving parents face harsh realities. Meanwhile, Tushar scrambles to contain the scandal threatening his political career.

videos.title: Et Tu, Brute?
videos.overview: Tushar hunts for the mole jeopardising his election campaign. Sanyukta and Jai's investigation points uncomfortably close to the victim's inner circle.

videos.title: End of the Rope
videos.overview: Sanyukta and Jai realise they've been looking for answers in the wrong places. Meanwhile, the victim's father, consumed by loss, decides to take a drastic step.

videos.title: Devil in the Details
videos.overview: With every theory falling apart, along with Sanyukta's marriage, she and Jai find themselves at a dead end. But a sudden discovery propels the investigation into a new direction.

videos.title: Cat and Mouse
videos.overview: Sanyukta and Jai begin to suspect the killer has been hiding in plain sight all along. But when she uncovers damning new evidence, it forces her to rethink everything.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Meme Boys
_verifiedMetadata.description: Four unassuming friends, launch an anonymous social media page "Meme Boys" shedding light on their oppressive college administration with a punch of humor. What starts as an innocent fun exercise, soon revolutionizes the entire college, birthing a movement of sorts in no time. With memes taking the college by storm, a cat-and-mouse game kicks off between the Meme Boys’ gang and the Dean.

videos.title: Expectation Vs Reality
videos.overview: As the new college year begins, Mojo actively tries to put a team together to take part in the Meme Fest. Meanwhile, Apoorva University gets a new dean who comes up with his own plans. Is there a conflict in the offing?

videos.title: Make This man Famous
videos.overview: With the popularity of the Meme Boys spreading, battle lines are drawn between the group and the dean, The dean tries to establish a task force to identify the faces behind the Meme Boys

videos.title: To Catch A Memer
videos.overview: The dean gets an unexpected ally in his crackdown on the Meme Boys. Meanwhile, as they get ahead of themselves, internal differences brew within the Meme Boys, leading to an unpleasant confrontation

videos.title: Confusions Of Apoorva University
videos.overview: As mistrust arises and the cracks widen, will the Meme Boys come together or disband their team? An unexpected move by the dean puts them at a further disadvantage.

videos.title: Mission Unpossible
videos.overview: With the bean tightening the noose and the deadline closing in to post their tournament-defining meme, the Meme Boys must pull off an impossible heist-like operation to save themselves.

videos.title: Gangs Of Apoorva
videos.overview: A rigged student union election orchestrated by the dean proves to be the last straw and leads to an all-out war between the students and the dean powered by the Meme boys. The issue becomes a matter of public and media debate

videos.title: The Dean Wants To Know
videos.overview: Apoorva University and the mediascape come to a standstill as they prepare to witness the epic showdown of Meme Boys vs Dean Narayanan on Primetime News. The Meme Boys must decide once and for all whether to reveal themselves to the public?

videos.title: Thoughts Become Things?
videos.overview: With the Meme Boys arrested under the pretext of issuing a death threat to the dean, they must do whatever it takes to prove their innocence while a vengeful Narayanan is out for blood. However, unexpected help arrives.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Amudhavum Annalakshmiyum
_verifiedMetadata.description: Amudha's dream is to marry a teacher so she chose Senthil, a school teacher. His mother Annalakshmi, too is proud of his profession. But the twist is Senthil works as a peon in the school.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Anya's Tutorial
_verifiedMetadata.description: Anya’s YouTube channel becomes popular when her viewers find hints of paranormal activity in her home. She uses the haunted house to her advantage, but dancing with the devil comes at a price.

videos.title: Deyyalu levu, Bhootalu levu
videos.overview: A wannabe influencer, Anya moves into an old apartment in the middle of nowhere just before the lockdown. The house seems to have a mind of its own. Is the house haunted or is it the demons of Anya's past that's haunting her?

videos.title: #girlinahauntedhouse
videos.overview: Anya's tutorial is trending across all social media platforms. Madhu reaches out for help to get her sister back home. Anya wants to stay trending and is ready to go to any lengths to do so. But a dance with the devil always comes with a price.

videos.title: Sevam ela paaripotundi?
videos.overview: Anya's tutorial needs to be banned - that's the talk everywhere and that only makes her trend more. Madhu is worried about what else 'Anya' is going to reveal to her followers. Madhu gives a comeback, but will that impact Anya's newfound fame?

videos.title: Followers kosame na idantha?
videos.overview: Anya's new friendship with a fan gives her all the courage to handle Madhu. There's Anyans and Anti-Anyans following her every move and their debate puts Anya in a spot. Anya's life is hanging by a thread while her fans are hunting for Madhu's whereabouts.

videos.title: #findtheevilsister
videos.overview: Anya's tutorial is now live 24/7. Anyans go on a digital hunting spree for Madhu. Anya breaks free into her new persona and decides to take her power back from Madhu. It's time for Madhu to hide.

videos.title: #justiceforanya
videos.overview: Anya has become a phenomenon that's loved, feared and hated all at once. Anya heads out to get her justice while her fans are hooked to her channel. The cops are trying to catch Anya. Meanwhile, Madhu decides to take matters into her own hands about Kira.

videos.title: It's too late
videos.overview: In the season finale, pressure is mounting to catch Anya and her hideout. With Hemanth vowing to protect her at all costs, Anya goes for her final justice - A face off with Madhu. With time running out and children vanishing from homes, the cops have to reach Anya before she breaks free.

event.name: 13th: Some Lessons Aren't Taught in Classrooms

_verifiedMetadata.name: 13th: Some Lessons Aren't Taught in Classrooms
_verifiedMetadata.description: 13th tells the story of Ritesh, a successful venture capitalist who reunites with his maverick IIT-JEE mentor, Mohit Tyagi Sir, to help scale his visionary educational institute. The series unfolds against the backdrop of India's most gruelling academic competition and a startup culture fixated on valuations. At its heart, 13th is a deeply nostalgic, human story of a master and his pupil-bound by ambition, respect, and the lessons that shape a lifetime.

videos.title: Paanch Sawaal
videos.overview: Ritesh, a sharp and successful venture capitalist, is sent to Jaipur by his firm to pitch a nationwide expansion plan to MT Sir, a legendary yet low-profile IIT JEE coach. But this meeting stirs up more than business-it reopens a chapter from Ritesh's own past, where a single mark and a simple challenge from MT Sir had changed everything. As old memories resurface and new ambitions collide, Ritesh is forced to confront not just the intent behind this potential investment but a deeper question: what truly defines success? The past and present intertwine, setting the stage for a decision that could reshape both their lives.

videos.title: Kuch Bhi Ho Sakta Hai
videos.overview: With his corporate ties cut, Ritesh dives headfirst into building something meaningful with MT Sir-but not everyone shares their vision. A tense investor meeting tests their commitment to authenticity in a world obsessed with optics. Meanwhile, flashbacks to Ritesh's time in Kota reveal an intense rivalry, mounting pressure, and a crucial lesson about speed versus intelligence. As the academic battlefield heats up and personal struggles deepen, a beautiful new connection offers Ritesh solace. But just as he finds his footing, a sudden shift threatens to upend everything he believed about success. Some lessons arrive too late-and hit the hardest.

videos.title: Cheating
videos.overview: Ritesh finds himself torn-between loyalty and logic, passion and practicality, as MT Sir enters an entrepreneurship competition without consulting him. Ritesh is skeptical; the prize feels too small, the odds too big. But for MT Sir, it's a matter of belief, not scale. Flashbacks reveal a younger Ritesh, thrown off course by sudden changes in the JEE pattern, losing focus just as his connection with Sheena deepens. In the present, Ritesh's ego gets battered when he learns that an old colleague will be judging the competition. With a crucial decision looming, Ritesh stands at a breaking point. As echoes of the past return, will he succumb to his own demons?

videos.title: The Clock Is Ticking
videos.overview: As the E-Summit nears, cracks begin to show-both in the present and the past. Ritesh wrestles with a decision that could impact MT Sir's moment in the spotlight, while memories of youthful jealousy and failure resurface. A tangled past with Sheena and a bitter rivalry with Abhishek reveal the emotional toll of ambition. In the present, even MT Sir isn't immune to pressure, questioning his place among slick-talking entrepreneurs. As doubts creep in and fears resurface, the story draws powerful parallels between past breakdowns and present reckonings-testing how far each man is willing to go to rise again.

videos.title: Handshake
videos.overview: Defeated by doubt, MT Sir returns from the E-Summit-but a new investment opportunity reignites hope. As he and Ritesh prepare for a fresh pitch, whispers from the past return: a younger Ritesh spiraling after a major debacle, only to be pulled back from the edge by MT Sir's wisdom. As past failures slowly transform into lessons of humility and focus, the present challenges begin to mirror them. With an unexpected second chance knocking, both mentor and mentee must decide-will they let fear dictate the future, or rise above it? Sometimes, the bravest move is just showing up.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Suzhal - The Vortex
_verifiedMetadata.description: In a small South Indian town, a seemingly routine minor case explodes into a twisted crime thriller that rips apart its social fabric.

_verifiedMetadata.name: Recce
_verifiedMetadata.description: Set in the backdrop of Anantapur, in 1993,  A dual murder takes place, setting off a series of unforeseen consequences and twists after a cop named Lenin embarks on an investigation.

videos.title: The Contract
videos.overview: A burnt body is found on the outskirts of Tadipatri village, and sub-inspector Lenin begins to investigate the murder. Kullayappa hires Paradesi and gang to kill the village sarpanch Varadarajulu

videos.title: The Sketch
videos.overview: Paradesi and gang plan to kill Varadarajulu during the flag hoisting ceremony. Lenin is off-duty due to his injury but continues his investigation. He visits a nearby police station when he finds a similar case.

videos.title: The Betrayal
videos.overview: Paradesi's men await his instructions to execute the plan, but Paradesi aborts the mission. Lenin finds out about Paradesi. Later, Paradesi demands to know the identity of the mastermind who hired him to kill Varadarajulu

videos.title: The Twist
videos.overview: Varadarajulu's men search all the hotels, but Paradesi and gang escape. Varadarajulu attends the temple procession with his family, where Paradesi and his men kill him

videos.title: The Clue
videos.overview: Lenin tracks Kullayappa's wife and finds out about his location. The MLA asks Varadarajulu's wife Devakamma, and Chalapathi's wife Bujjamma to contest the elections. Lenin and constable Swami find Kullayappa

videos.title: The Reveal
videos.overview: Lenin finds out some shocking details from Kullayappa about Chalapathi. Later, Lenin brings Rekha to the police station for interrogation, but his investigation meets a dead end

videos.title: The Revenge
videos.overview: Lenin checks the photos of the corpse and discovers a startling clue. Devakamma agrees to contest the elections and announces her nomination. The MLA asks Lenin to drop the case and gives him a promotion

_verifiedMetadata.name: Janaawar - The Beast Within
_verifiedMetadata.description: As SI Hemant Kumar explores a missing person's case in the jungle town of Chhattisgarh, he is determined to solve it. Trouble follows when that leads to a string of bodies and a likely serial killer.

videos.title: Devta Aur Dand
videos.overview: SI Hemant’s request for a week off is cancelled due to two urgent cases. The disappearance of MLA Jagtap’s brother, Sarju, and a gold theft. Later, the police find a mutilated corpse in the jungle.

videos.title: Aur Ek Ganth
videos.overview: Hemant and his team begin a desperate search for the missing head of the body. Shambhu is arrested and beaten up in custody. Meanwhile, Hemant’s son is born, and he rushes to Garima, his wife.

videos.title: Jaati, Kabhi Nahi Jaati
videos.overview: The mystery around the dead body and Sarju’s murder grows deeper. The tribals protest against Shambhu’s arrest. Hemant is shocked to learn that he must now choose between his identity and his duty.

videos.title: Purana Paap
videos.overview: Mamaji and Gopi, arrested for Sarju’s murder, are beaten up. They confess to the crime, but something seems off. Hemant is stunned when the loose ends of the case lead to his trusted ally, Kailash.

videos.title: Apsara
videos.overview: Kailash, once the police’s trusted ally, is now in custody as a suspect. A brutally beaten-up Kailash opens up to Hemant about his wife, Manda, and his connection to Sarju’s case.

videos.title: Aur Kaun?
videos.overview: The entire unit is stunned at Kailash’s confession, but the case is far from being solved with new revelations. Suspecting Kailash’s relation to more crimes, Hemant plays a trick.

videos.title: Sala, Janaawar!
videos.overview: Kailash claims that he was forced to lie in front of the DSP. Hemant fears transfer to a Naxal area. He requests Kailash to save his son from a life of struggles. Will Kailash give in?

_verifiedMetadata.name: Kuthukku Pathu
_verifiedMetadata.description: A group of friends try sorting out issues between a couple. When one of them gets attacked by the relatives of the couple, all the friends react in a harsh manner. The entry of a few gangsters makes things complex from a hand fight.

videos.title: Thulluvatho Ilamai
videos.overview: Boopathi impulsively proposes to Manisha with a love letter enraging her brother Rohit Sharma. Vishnu’s girlfriend Abhi gifts him a new phone for his birthday and that gets him involved with the leader of the local gang called ‘Reservoir dogs’.

videos.title: Rangasthalam
videos.overview: The ‘Reservoir dogs’ gang up against Kathiresan and end up getting arrested. Professor Rangabhashyam gets on mechanic Fakir’s nerves and gets thwacked by his friends leading to a revenge plan by Rangabashyam.

videos.title: Onaayum Aattukuttiyum
videos.overview: Saravanan chases Samaan’s squad but accidentally finds himself in conflict with the MLA’s illegitimate son. Saravanan’s brother Murugesan wrangles over the issue with MLA Mazhuvazh Nediyon and takes a fateful decision.

videos.title: Mandhiri Madiyil Sundhari
videos.overview: Mazhuvazh Nediyon’s second wife causes a ruckus in his funeral and hires inspector Thiyagarajan to kill Murugesan. Fakir accepts Augustine’s race request to pay Saravan’s hospital bills. Dawood is pushed to the corner in a grave situation.

videos.title: Payum Puli Pathungum Nagam
videos.overview: Fakir finds that someone has burnt his bike and suspects Augustine. Samaan warns Rangabashyam to lie low in his friend’s place. Drunk Rangabhashyam gets involved with an unexpected group of people.

videos.title: Nadunisi Naaigal
videos.overview: Drunk Rangabhashyam records the deeds of the group. Fakir is also kidnapped to Mazhuvazh’s house to threaten Dawood. Dawood equips himself with enough protection and goes to the MLA’s house.

videos.title: Mirattal Adi
videos.overview: All of them converge at MLA’s house for different reasons. Dawood shows up at MLA’s house to rescue his son. Hell breaks loose.

_verifiedMetadata.name: 9 Hours
_verifiedMetadata.description: Three prisoners on run try to rob three banks. They are well-prepared and know how to run away with the booty. Is someone handling them from behind the screens?

videos.title: Hour 1
videos.overview: Three prisoners escape from Hyderabad Central Jail to form three teams to loot three banks. While two teams execute the heist successfully, what happens to the third team?

videos.title: Hour 2
videos.overview: Hearing about the heist, journalist Chitralekha arrives at the bank and argues with Circle Inspector Pratap. Meanwhile, Nagendra has bad intentions towards one of the hostages.

videos.title: Hour 3
videos.overview: Inside the bank, the robbers receive a call with an offer to harm Chandra Sekhar. However, the hostages devise a plan to attack the robbers.

videos.title: Hour 4
videos.overview: As the situation gets tense when the robbers throw the body of one of the hostages outside the bank, Pratap decides to attempt a rescue.

videos.title: Hour 5
videos.overview: Chidambaram gets caught, and Pratap finds a lead in the investigation. An impossible situation brings someone to Nagendra's attention.

videos.title: Hour 6
videos.overview: Nandu and Shravani try to get in touch with the police. Meanwhile, Purushottam makes a secret deal with the robbers.

videos.title: Hour 7
videos.overview: The prisons in Andhra Pradesh receive an order to conduct an impromptu roll call. On hearing this, Vishwanath wants to stop it anyhow.

videos.title: Hour 8
videos.overview: The robbers successfully flee from the bank in a vehicle. However, chaos erupts as fire breaks out in the prison and a few prisoners are discovered to be missing.

videos.title: Hour 9
videos.overview: When the robbers get surrounded by the police in the market, they come up with a new plan. Meanwhile, an unknown chapter of Dasaradha's life comes into the light.
